AI.tldr: TrafficSci是一个能够自主分析城市交通数据并发现新交通规律的AI系统，它通过迭代的工作流成功识别了驾驶行为中的新时间记忆尺度。
AI.motivation: 现有的交通规律发现高度依赖专家经验，且缺乏从复杂的城市交通系统中自动提取规律的有效方法。
AI.method: 提出名为TrafficSci的智能体AI系统，通过包含证据范围界定、批判性假设归纳以及观测与干预验证的迭代工作流来发现交通规律。
AI.result: TrafficSci成功重新发现了三项已知的交通定律，并发现了一项未被报道的城市驾驶行为内在时间记忆尺度，该发现跨越了8个城市和2个数据集，具有统计一致性。
AI.conclusion: TrafficSci证明了AI智能体能够有效地从复杂的城市交通数据中发现潜在的科学规律，为交通科学研究的自动化提供了强有力的工具。
AI.translation: 通用交通定律描述了城市间在拥堵、移动性和驾驶行为方面反复出现的模式，为交通规划、管理和控制提供了科学基础。然而，这些定律的发现仍然依赖于专家，需要从异构的观测证据中识别候选规律或通过干预实验进行验证。尽管自动人工智能 (AI) 系统在受控实验室环境中推进了科学发现，但将其扩展到复杂的交通领域仍然是一个挑战。在此，我们提出了 TrafficSci，一个代理 AI 系统，它将交通定律发现表述为一个迭代的、可审计的工作流，集成了证据范围界定、批判性假设归纳以及观测-干预验证。通过跨越人口、网络、控制和轨迹尺度的四个案例研究，TrafficSci 自主重新发现了三项已确立的交通定律，并识别出城市驾驶行为中一种未被报道的内在时间记忆尺度，该尺度在八个城市和两个轨迹数据集中具有统计一致性。TrafficSci 为将 AI 驱动的科学发现从受控领域扩展到复杂的城市系统提供了一条路径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TrafficSci，一种旨在实现交通定律自动发现的AI智能体系统。通过整合证据分析、假设生成与验证等迭代流程，TrafficSci能够在多个尺度下分析城市交通数据，成功验证已知规律并揭示了新的驾驶行为特征，展示了AI在复杂交通科学研究中的潜力。
AI.keywords: 交通定律, 人工智能, 科学发现, 城市系统, 智能体系统
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将AI智能体应用于交通科学领域，通过迭代的工作流实现了交通规律的自动发现。它不仅能够验证已知定律，还能发现新的科学规律，为AI在复杂城市系统中的应用提供了范式。局限性在于其发现的规律依赖于输入数据的质量和覆盖范围。

title: AgentFlow: Building Agent Dependency Graphs for Static Analysis of Agent Programs
summary: LLM agents are increasingly developed as source-code applications built on agent frameworks. These agent programs combine conventional host-language code with framework-defined semantics for models, prompts, tools, memory, and multi-agent orchestration logic. As a result, their behavior depends not only on traditional control and data flows, but also on a new class of agent dependencies. Such dependencies are often expressed as framework-induced semantics, such as agent constructors, tool decorators, and agent handoff declarations, making them difficult to recover with existing static analysis or dependency tracking tools. In this paper, we present AgentFlow, the first static analysis framework for recovering and analyzing agent dependencies from agent programs. AgentFlow constructs an Agent Dependency Graph (ADG), a framework-agnostic graph representation that represents agents, prompts, models, capabilities, memory states, and control policies as typed nodes, and captures their component-dependency, control-flow, and data-flow dependencies as typed edges. Built on ADGs, AgentFlow supports a range of analyses for agent governance and security, including Agent Bill of Materials (BOM) generation and prompt-to-tool risk detection. We implement AgentFlow for five representative agent frameworks and evaluate it on AgentZoo, a corpus of 5,399 real-world agent programs. Our evaluation shows that AgentFlow recovers richer agent entities and dependencies than existing AST-based agent static analysis tools, generates more dependency-aware Agent BOMs, and uncovers 238 taint-style prompt-to-tool risks in real-world agent programs. These results show that ADG provides a practical foundation for understanding, governing, and securing emerging agent software.

AI.title_translation: AgentFlow：构建用于Agent程序静态分析的Agent依赖图
AI.tldr: AgentFlow通过构建Agent依赖图（ADG），实现了对Agent程序中复杂框架语义和依赖关系的静态分析，有效提升了Agent的安全治理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的静态分析工具无法有效捕捉Agent程序中由框架语义（如代理构造器、工具装饰器等）引入的特有Agent依赖，导致难以对Agent进行有效的治理和安全分析。
AI.method: 提出了AgentFlow静态分析框架；构建了Agent依赖图（ADG），将Agent组件（模型、提示词、工具等）映射为带类型的节点，将其逻辑依赖映射为带类型的边；并在五种主流Agent框架上进行了实现与评估。
AI.result: 在5,399个真实Agent程序上评估显示，AgentFlow能恢复比现有AST工具更丰富的依赖关系，生成更准确的Agent物料清单（BOM），并成功发现了238个提示词到工具的污点风险。
AI.conclusion: AgentFlow通过构建Agent依赖图（ADG），有效解决了Agent程序中复杂依赖难以静态分析的问题，在Agent安全治理和风险检测方面表现出显著优越性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent正越来越多地作为基于Agent框架的源代码应用程序进行开发。这些Agent程序将传统的宿主语言代码与框架定义的模型、提示词、工具、记忆和多智能体编排逻辑语义相结合。因此，它们的行为不仅取决于传统的控制流和数据流，还取决于一类新的Agent依赖关系。这些依赖关系通常表现为框架诱导的语义，如代理构造器、工具装饰器和代理交接声明，使得现有的静态分析或依赖跟踪工具难以恢复。在本文中，我们提出了AgentFlow，这是第一个用于从Agent程序中恢复和分析Agent依赖关系的静态分析框架。AgentFlow构建了Agent依赖图（ADG），这是一种与框架无关的图表示方法，将代理、提示词、模型、能力、记忆状态和控制策略表示为类型节点，并将其组件依赖、控制流和数据流依赖捕获为类型边。基于ADG，AgentFlow支持一系列用于Agent治理和安全的分析，包括代理物料清单（BOM）生成和提示词到工具的风险检测。我们在五个代表性的Agent框架上实现了AgentFlow，并在包含5,399个真实世界Agent程序的AgentZoo语料库上进行了评估。我们的评估表明，与现有的基于AST的Agent静态分析工具相比，AgentFlow恢复了更丰富的Agent实体和依赖关系，生成了更具依赖感知能力的Agent BOM，并揭示了真实世界Agent程序中238个污点风格的提示词到工具风险。这些结果表明，ADG为理解、治理和保障新兴Agent软件提供了实用的基础。
AI.summary: AgentFlow是一款专门用于Agent程序的静态分析框架，通过构建Agent依赖图（ADG）来显式化Agent程序中复杂的组件依赖、控制流和数据流，从而支持Agent的安全审计、合规治理及风险识别。
AI.keywords: LLM Agent, 静态分析, 依赖图(ADG), 安全治理, 软件供应链安全
AI.comments: 该论文针对大模型Agent应用开发中特有的依赖关系难以静态分析的痛点，提出了AgentFlow框架和ADG图表示方法，填补了Agent程序静态分析领域的空白。其创新点在于将Agent框架特有的语义（如工具装饰器、代理交接等）转化为通用的图表示，为Agent的安全治理提供了有力工具。

title: When Agents Do Not Stop: Uncovering Infinite Agentic Loops in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on iterative execution to solve tasks through planning, tool use, state updates, and agent collaboration. While this design enables flexible automation, it also creates a new class of failures: an agent may repeatedly execute model calls, tools, workflow transitions, or agent handoffs when the feedback path is not effectively bounded. We call this problem Infinite Agentic Loops (IALs). IALs are not ordinary programming loops; they arise from the interaction between agent logic, framework semantics, runtime observations, and termination mechanisms. Such failures can amplify a single request into long running model and tool execution, causing cost exhaustion, model denial of service, context growth, and repeated external side effects. We propose IAL-Scan, a static analysis tool for detecting IAL failures in real-world LLM agent projects. IAL-Scan abstracts heterogeneous agent code into a framework independent Agent IR, builds an Agentic Loop Dependence Graph (ALDG) to recover explicit and framework induced feedback paths, and checks whether these paths can repeatedly reach costly or state growing operations without an effective bound. We evaluate IAL-Scan on 6,549 LLM agent repositories. It reports 74 potential findings, among which manual review confirms 68 IAL failures across 47 projects, achieving 91.9% precision.

AI.title_translation: 当智能体不止步时：揭示 LLM 智能体中的无限代理循环
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 IAL-Scan 的静态分析工具，用于检测 LLM 智能体中导致成本耗尽和系统故障的无限循环问题，并在大规模真实项目中验证了其高准确性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在处理复杂任务时依赖迭代执行，但若反馈路径缺乏有效边界，会导致无限代理循环（IAL），引发成本耗尽、拒绝服务及上下文膨胀等严重故障。
AI.method: 提出 IAL-Scan 工具，通过将异构智能体代码抽象为框架无关的 Agent IR，构建代理循环依赖图（ALDG）来恢复反馈路径，并分析该路径是否在缺乏有效边界的情况下反复触发高成本或状态增长操作。
AI.result: 在 6,549 个 LLM 智能体仓库中测试，IAL-Scan 报告了 74 个潜在问题，经人工核实确认了 47 个项目中的 68 个 IAL 故障，准确率高达 91.9%。
AI.conclusion: IAL-Scan 是一种高效的静态分析工具，能够有效识别 LLM 智能体中的无限循环漏洞，对于提升智能体系统的安全性和成本控制具有重要意义。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖迭代执行，通过规划、工具使用、状态更新和智能体协作来完成任务。虽然这种设计实现了灵活的自动化，但也产生了一类新的故障：当反馈路径没有得到有效限制时，智能体会重复执行模型调用、工具、工作流转换或智能体交接。我们将此问题称为无限代理循环（IAL）。IAL 并非普通的编程循环；它们源于智能体逻辑、框架语义、运行时观察和终止机制之间的相互作用。此类故障可能将单个请求放大为长时间的模型和工具执行，导致成本耗尽、模型拒绝服务、上下文膨胀以及重复的外部副作用。我们提出了 IAL-Scan，这是一种用于检测真实 LLM 智能体项目中 IAL 故障的静态分析工具。IAL-Scan 将异构的智能体代码抽象为框架无关的 Agent IR，构建代理循环依赖图（ALDG）以恢复显式和框架引入的反馈路径，并检查这些路径是否能在没有有效边界的情况下反复触及高成本或状态增长操作。我们在 6,549 个 LLM 智能体仓库上评估了 IAL-Scan。它报告了 74 个潜在发现，其中人工评审确认了 47 个项目中的 68 个 IAL 故障，实现了 91.9% 的准确率。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）智能体在迭代执行过程中产生的“无限代理循环（IAL）”问题进行了研究。作者分析了 IAL 的成因，并开发了静态分析工具 IAL-Scan，通过构建代理循环依赖图来检测缺乏有效边界的反馈路径。实验证明，该方法能有效识别真实项目中的 IAL 故障，具有很高的准确性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 无限代理循环, 静态分析, 系统故障检测, 自动化工作流
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了LLM智能体在迭代执行中一个极易被忽视但后果严重的漏洞——无限代理循环（IAL）。其创新之处在于提出了独立于框架的中间表示（Agent IR）和代理循环依赖图（ALDG），不仅为检测此类问题提供了系统性方法，也为构建更稳健的智能体系统提供了工程化思路。

title: Multi-Resolution Flow Matching: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Staged Sampling
comments: The code is available at https://github.com/Xingyu-Zheng/MrFlow
summary: Hardware-agnostic strategies for accelerating text-to-image diffusion, such as timestep distillation and feature caching, can reduce inference time without custom kernels or system-level optimization. Among them, multi-resolution generation strategies have recently received broad attention, attaining more than 5x speedup without any training. However, the design of performing upsampling in the latent space, together with the selective modification of partial regions, causes these methods to exhibit noticeable blurring or artifacts. To this end, we propose MrFlow, a training-free multi-resolution acceleration strategy for pretrained flow-matching models built upon a staged low-to-high-resolution pipeline. MrFlow first rapidly generates the main structure at low resolution, then performs super-resolution in the pixel space using a lightweight pretrained GAN-based model, subsequently injects low-strength noise to enable high-frequency resampling, and finally refines the details at high resolution. Quantitative and qualitative results on FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image show that MrFlow exploits the quadratic token reduction and reduced step requirement of low-resolution sampling to achieve 10x end-to-end acceleration while keeping OneIG within a 1% gap relative to that before acceleration, significantly surpassing other training-free acceleration strategies, and requiring no training or runtime dynamic identification whatsoever. MrFlow can further be directly combined orthogonally with pre-trained timestep distillation strategies, achieving even higher generation acceleration of up to 25x.
comment: The code is available at https://github.com/Xingyu-Zheng/MrFlow

title: Decentralized Stability Certificates in IBR-Dominated Grids: The Role of the Network State
summary: Small-signal instabilities, such as unforced sub-synchronous oscillations (SSOs), are increasingly observed in inverter-based resource (IBR) dominated grids. While decentralized stability certificates offer a scalable means to avoid instability onset, they are typically derived under restrictive network-state assumptions--such as small angle differences or negligible voltage drops--that cannot capture how departures from these conditions affect system stability. In this paper, we develop a network model and a decentralized analysis framework that explicitly characterizes how reactive power mismatches, line loading, and inverter control parameters jointly determine small-signal stability. We show that increased steady-state reactive power mismatches and line loading lead to more stringent conditions on admissible inverter droop gains. These results make decentralized stability certificates explicitly network-state dependent, showing how network stress shrinks the set of stabilizing local controller parameters.

AI.title_translation: IBR主导电网中的去中心化稳定性证书：网络状态的作用
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑网络状态（如负载和无功失配）的去中心化稳定性分析框架，证明了网络压力越大，逆变器控制参数的稳定范围越小。
AI.motivation: 现有的去中心化稳定性证书通常基于过于严格的假设（如小角度差或忽略电压降），无法准确反映真实网络状态对系统稳定性的影响，导致在IBR主导的电网中难以有效评估小信号稳定性问题。
AI.method: 构建了一个能够明确表征无功功率失配、线路负载和逆变器控制参数如何共同决定小信号稳定性的网络模型和去中心化分析框架。
AI.result: 研究表明，稳态无功功率失配和线路负载的增加会导致对逆变器下垂增益的约束更加严格，即网络压力的增加会缩小稳定控制器参数的适用范围。
AI.conclusion: 网络状态显著影响系统的稳定性，网络压力越大，可用的逆变器控制参数范围越小，因此去中心化的稳定性证书必须考虑网络状态的影响。
AI.translation: 小信号不稳定性（如无强迫次同步振荡）在逆变器主导（IBR）的电网中日益频繁。虽然去中心化稳定性证书提供了一种可扩展的避免不稳定性发生的方法，但它们通常是在限制性的网络状态假设下推导出来的（例如小角度差或可忽略的电压降），这些假设无法捕捉到偏离这些条件的情况如何影响系统稳定性。在本文中，我们开发了一个网络模型和一个去中心化分析框架，明确表征了无功功率失配、线路负载和逆变器控制参数如何共同决定小信号稳定性。我们展示了稳态无功功率失配和线路负载的增加导致对允许的逆变器下垂增益提出了更严格的条件。这些结果使得去中心化稳定性证书明确依赖于网络状态，表明网络压力会缩小稳定局部控制器参数的集合。
AI.summary: 本文针对IBR主导电网中的小信号稳定性问题，开发了一种去中心化的分析框架。该框架摒弃了传统过于理想化的网络假设，明确了无功功率失配、线路负载与逆变器控制参数之间的耦合关系，揭示了网络状态对稳定性的直接影响，并为制定更准确的去中心化稳定性证书提供了理论依据。
AI.keywords: 逆变器主导电网, 小信号稳定性, 去中心化证书, 网络状态, 无功功率失配
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将网络状态（如无功功率失配和线路负载）纳入了去中心化稳定性分析框架，弥补了传统方法在假设过于理想化方面的不足，对于高比例电力电子设备（IBR）电网的稳定性评估具有重要的工程参考价值。

title: DeadPool: Resilient LLM Training with Hot-Swapping via Zero-Overhead Checkpoint
summary: State-of-the-art large language model (LLM) training takes tens of thousands of graphics processing units (GPUs) for months and encounters failures across the software and hardware stack. Existing fault-tolerance mechanisms either impose non-trivial overhead during failure-free execution or suffer from prolonged recovery latency, particularly under scenarios where a small subset of compute nodes experience permanent failures. %The tradeoff between failure-free overhead and recovery latency forms a space forms a Pareto frontier We present DeadPool to simultaneously address both optimization objectives. DeadPool incorporates a fault-tolerance mechanism that restores LLM training via hot-swapping, namely by replacing failed nodes with spare nodes without terminating the complete job. The hot-swapping of DeadPool is enabled by two ideas: First, it exploits an off-critical-path in-memory checkpointing mechanism for spatial redundancy. Second, it introduces a communicator reconstruction protocol that replaces failed nodes with spare nodes at runtime. DeadPool efficiently overlaps the in-memory checkpointing with computation, thus introducing zero overhead during error-free execution. Upon permanent node failures, DeadPool can rebuild memory states with minimal recomputation by leveraging in-memory checkpoints. We evaluate DeadPool across scales (up to 512 NVIDIA A100 GPUs) and LLMs (up to 65B parameters), and observe zero checkpoint overhead with hot-swapping recovery completing in under 40 seconds. These results show that DeadPool simultaneously achieves both zero-overhead error-free execution and extremely low recovery cost.

title: AgenticDataBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Data Agents
summary: Data science aims to derive actionable insights from heterogeneous raw data, unlocking the value of the massive amounts of data generated in modern society. Automating this process is essential to reducing labor-intensive efforts for data scientists and enabling scalable data-driven applications. Recently, large language model (LLM)-based data agents have emerged as a promising solution to automate data science workflows. However, the field lacks comprehensive benchmarks to rigorously evaluate these agents across diverse scenarios with fine-grained granularity. To address this gap, we propose AgenticDataBench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring realistic tasks spanning diverse domains with fine-grained ground-truth labels. This enables evaluations to capture the diversity and complexity of data science workflows and the detailed performance of agents. First, to cover diverse domains, we collect real datasets and tasks from 15 vertical domains, including 5 real-world B2B use cases from a leading fintech company. Second, to remove redundancy in real-world tasks and generate high-quality tasks for domains lacking real data, we introduce data science skills, recurring data-centric operational patterns, and quantify benchmark coverage by the number of skills included. Representative skills are extracted from large-scale task solutions on Stack Overflow using skill-aligned hierarchical clustering. Third, for real-world business tasks, we select task-solution pairs that maximize diversity in skill composition, ensuring broad coverage of practical scenarios. Fourth, to generate realistic tasks for devise domains without real tasks, we propose a systematic LLM-based task generation approach to create workflows and tasks based on these skills. Finally, we evaluate state-of-the-art data agents using our annotated benchmark and open-sourced testbed, providing detailed skill-level insights.

title: Boosting Ultrasound Image Classification via Attribute-Guided Dual-Branch Framework
summary: Ultrasound image classification is essential for computer-aided diagnosis. However, current methods often neglect clinical priors, leading to poor generalization in challenging scenarios and a lack of interpretability that limits clinical adoption. To address these issues, we aim to develop a medical-prior module that can be seamlessly integrated into existing pipelines to enhance both diagnostic performance and interpretability. In this paper, we propose an attribute-guided dual-branch framework for ultrasound classification that introduces domain-agnostic medical attribute priors, improving generalization while offering interpretable evidence. Specifically, a baseline branch follows conventional architectures and predicts image categories via a fully connected classifier. An attribute-guided branch injects domain-agnostic attributes as priors and produces human-interpretable decision cues. Finally, an adaptive decision module fuses the two branches in a data-dependent manner to yield the final prediction. Experiments across diverse ultrasound classification tasks demonstrate that our approach can be integrated into multiple backbones and state-of-the-art methods with low overhead, consistently improving accuracy and interpretability. Code is available at: https://github.com/zhaobo253-crypto/AttrGuide.

title: One Demonstration Is Enough for Real-World Robotic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Learning effective robot control policies on physical hardware is challenging due to costly data collection and the difficulty of reward specification. Prior work has incorporated demonstrations into reinforcement learning (RL), yet existing approaches either require large numbers of demonstrations or depend on continuous human intervention during training. To address these limitations, we present AutoSERL, a framework that leverages a single demonstration to fully automate the intervention process in real-world robot RL. The framework includes three complementary mechanisms to accomplish certain tasks: a sliding window intervention mechanism that continuously guides exploration to prevent local optima and unsafe deviations, a safety recovery mechanism that detects and corrects failure states via predefined trajectory recovery points, and an intervention termination criterion that automatically disables guidance once the policy can independently complete the task, preserving its exploration advantage. We evaluate AutoSERL on six contact-intensive manipulation tasks across two robot platforms, spanning insertion, hanging, and hinge-based tasks. AutoSERL consistently outperforms SERL initialized with 20 demonstrations, behavior cloning, and MILES -- a dedicated one-shot imitation learning baseline -- across all tasks while matching HIL-SERL, achieves 100% success rate on insertion tasks, and demonstrates improved robustness to positional variations, all from a single demonstration. Code and videos are available on our project website: https://autoserl.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: 仅需一次演示：面向现实世界的机器人强化学习
AI.tldr: AutoSERL通过引入滑动窗口引导、安全恢复和自动终止机制，实现了仅凭一次演示即可完成高效、自动化的机器人强化学习训练。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人强化学习方法在物理硬件上训练成本高昂，且通常需要大量演示数据或持续的人类干预，限制了其在现实世界中的应用。
AI.method: 提出了AutoSERL框架，包含三种机制：1.滑动窗口干预机制，用于引导探索并避免局部最优；2.安全恢复机制，通过预定义的恢复点检测并纠正失败状态；3.干预终止准则，在策略具备独立完成任务能力时自动停止引导。
AI.result: AutoSERL在六项接触密集型任务中表现优异，仅需一次演示即可超越需要20次演示的基线方法，在插入任务中达到100%成功率，并表现出良好的位置鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AutoSERL框架成功证明了仅需单次演示即可实现高效、自动化的现实世界机器人强化学习，有效解决了数据成本高和人工干预频繁的问题。
AI.translation: 在物理硬件上学习有效的机器人控制策略由于数据收集成本高昂和奖励设定困难而充满挑战。先前的工作将演示纳入强化学习（RL），但现有方法要么需要大量演示，要么在训练过程中依赖持续的人类干预。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了AutoSERL，这是一个利用单次演示在现实世界机器人RL中实现干预过程完全自动化的框架。该框架包括三种互补机制来完成特定任务：一种滑动窗口干预机制，不断引导探索以防止局部最优和不安全的偏差；一种安全恢复机制，通过预定义的轨迹恢复点检测并纠正失败状态；以及一种干预终止准则，一旦策略能够独立完成任务，就会自动禁用引导，从而保留其探索优势。我们在两个机器人平台的六个接触密集型操作任务上评估了AutoSERL，涵盖插入、悬挂和基于铰链的任务。AutoSERL在所有任务中始终优于使用20次演示初始化的SERL、行为克隆和MILES（一种专门的一次性模仿学习基线），同时与HIL-SERL相媲美，在插入任务上实现了100%的成功率，并展现出对位置变化的更高鲁棒性，所有这些都仅来自单次演示。代码和视频可在我们的项目网站上找到：https://autoserl.github.io/。
AI.summary: AutoSERL是一个旨在实现现实世界机器人强化学习自动化的框架，它仅需单次演示，通过滑动窗口干预、安全恢复及自动终止机制，在无需持续人工干预的情况下高效训练机器人完成复杂操作任务。
AI.keywords: 机器人强化学习, 单次演示, 自动化干预, 接触密集型任务, 策略学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过仅需一次演示即可实现高效的机器人强化学习，显著降低了数据收集成本和对人类干预的依赖，在接触密集型任务中展现了极高的成功率和鲁棒性，是机器人学习领域的一项实用性创新。

title: Plug-and-Play Volumetric Reconstruction for Compressive Sensing Light-Sheet Microscopy
summary: We investigate volumetric reconstruction for compressive sensing light-sheet microscopy (CS-LSM), where fast volumetric imaging is achieved by encoding multiple axial planes into each camera exposure. To recover the underlying volume from highly multiplexed measurements, we propose a plug-and-play (PnP) framework that flexibly incorporates any user-specified denoiser into the reconstruction process. Building on a slice-based formulation, we further introduce an axial-coupled model that exploits correlations between adjacent slices to improve volumetric continuity. For efficient computation, we derive a Woodbury-based update for the data-consistency step in both the slice-based and axial-coupled formulations, and employ a Gauss-Seidel sweep for the denoising step in the axial-coupled model. Under a weakly convex regularization assumption, we establish subsequential convergence of the proposed algorithm. Experiments on synthetic and real zebrafish-heart data demonstrate that the proposed framework successfully recovers cellular structures from compressed measurements, and provide practical insights into the comparative performance of commonly used denoisers within the PnP framework under the CS-LSM setup.

AI.title_translation: 用于压缩感知光片显微镜的即插即用三维重建方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于即插即用框架的压缩感知光片显微镜三维重建方法，通过轴向耦合提升了结构连续性并实现了高效计算。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决压缩感知光片显微镜（CS-LSM）中，如何从高度复用的测量数据中快速、准确地恢复三维体积结构，并提升重建的灵活性和空间连续性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于即插即用（PnP）的重建框架，包含切片式和轴向耦合模型；利用Woodbury恒等式加速数据一致性更新，并采用Gauss-Seidel扫描进行降噪步骤；在弱凸正则化假设下证明了算法的收敛性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架在合成数据和斑马鱼心脏真实数据上均能成功恢复细胞结构，并验证了不同降噪器在CS-LSM PnP框架下的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种适用于CS-LSM的PnP重建框架，通过轴向耦合和高效计算策略，能够从压缩测量中有效恢复高分辨率的三维细胞结构，并为PnP框架内降噪器的选择提供了实践参考。
AI.translation: 我们研究了压缩感知光片显微镜（CS-LSM）的体积重建问题，其中快速体积成像通过将多个轴向平面编码到每次相机曝光中来实现。为了从高度复用的测量中恢复潜在的体积，我们提出了一个即插即用（PnP）框架，该框架可以灵活地将任何用户指定的降噪器合并到重建过程中。基于切片式公式，我们进一步引入了一种轴向耦合模型，利用相邻切片之间的相关性来改善体积连续性。为了高效计算，我们推导了切片式和轴向耦合公式中数据一致性步骤的基于Woodbury的更新方法，并在轴向耦合模型中采用了Gauss-Seidel扫描进行降噪步骤。在弱凸正则化假设下，我们建立了所提算法的子序列收敛性。在合成数据和真实斑马鱼心脏数据上的实验证明，所提出的框架成功地从压缩测量中恢复了细胞结构，并为CS-LSM设置下PnP框架内常用降噪器的比较性能提供了实践见解。
AI.summary: 本文针对压缩感知光片显微镜（CS-LSM）提出了一种即插即用（PnP）三维重建框架。通过引入轴向耦合模型利用相邻切片间的相关性，并结合高效的Woodbury更新策略，实现了高质量、高效率的体积重建，并从理论上保证了算法的收敛性。
AI.keywords: 压缩感知, 光片显微镜, 即插即用框架, 三维重建, 轴向耦合
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将即插即用（PnP）框架引入压缩感知光片显微镜（CS-LSM）重建中，极大地提高了灵活性。通过引入轴向耦合模型和高效的Woodbury更新计算策略，在保证计算效率的同时提升了重建质量。其理论上的收敛性证明为该类算法的实际应用提供了可靠支撑。

title: CALM: Interpretable Cross-Modal Alignment for Biomarker Discovery from Unpaired Data
summary: The interaction between brain structure and genetic influences is key to understanding neuropsychiatric disorders. However, most large-scale datasets are unimodal, providing either neuroimaging or genetics data. We propose CALM, a framework that learns interpretable associations between brain ROIs and genetic pathways from completely disjoint populations. CALM aligns the two modalities in a shared latent space via linear projections that simultaneously match the class-conditional latent distributions and ensure group separability. These projections provide interpretable pathway--ROI associations. When trained on unimodal imaging and genetics datasets, CALM generalizes to an unseen paired dataset, outperforming several state-of-the-art methods and ablation baselines. We also demonstrate stability of the learned associations against a paired baseline. Our experiments on autism spectrum disorder reveal immune and metabolic pathways linked to specific cortical regions and are consistent with established literature. Thus, CALM opens the door to leveraging large unimodal repositories for studying cross-modal interactions in brain disorders across disparate datasets.

AI.title_translation: CALM：用于从非配对数据中发现生物标志物的可解释跨模态对齐方法
AI.tldr: CALM 是一种无需配对数据即可实现大脑影像与遗传数据对齐并发现可解释生物标志物的新框架，有效利用了海量单模态医学数据。
AI.motivation: 大规模医学数据集通常是单模态的（仅包含神经影像或遗传学数据），难以直接研究大脑结构与遗传影响之间的相互作用，因此需要一种从非配对数据中学习跨模态关联的方法。
AI.method: 提出 CALM 框架，通过线性投影将两个模态映射到共享的潜在空间，同时匹配类条件潜在分布并确保组可分性，从而实现模态对齐及可解释的通路-ROI 关联分析。
AI.result: CALM 在未见过的配对数据集上表现优于现有的先进方法，且发现的关联具有高度稳定性；在自闭症谱系障碍研究中，成功识别出与特定皮层区域相关的免疫和代谢通路，并与既有文献一致。
AI.conclusion: CALM 框架证明了无需配对数据即可有效发现大脑 ROI 与遗传通路之间的关联，为利用大规模单模态数据研究脑疾病提供了可行且可靠的工具。
AI.translation: 大脑结构与遗传影响之间的相互作用是理解神经精神疾病的关键。然而，大多数大规模数据集是单模态的，仅提供神经影像或遗传学数据。我们提出了 CALM，这是一个从完全不相交的人群中学习大脑 ROI 与遗传通路之间可解释关联的框架。CALM 通过线性投影将两种模态对齐到一个共享的潜在空间，在匹配类条件潜在分布的同时确保组的可分性。这些投影提供了可解释的通路-ROI 关联。当在单模态影像和遗传学数据集上训练时，CALM 能够推广到未见过的配对数据集，性能优于几种现有最先进的方法和消融基线。我们还证明了所学关联相对于配对基线的稳定性。我们在自闭症谱系障碍上的实验揭示了与特定皮层区域相关的免疫和代谢通路，并与既有文献一致。因此，CALM 为利用大型单模态存储库研究跨数据集脑疾病的跨模态相互作用打开了大门。
AI.summary: CALM 是一种创新的跨模态对齐框架，能够在完全不配对的神经影像和遗传学数据集上，通过线性投影学习大脑感兴趣区域（ROI）与遗传通路之间具有可解释性的关联。该方法有效弥补了单模态大规模数据的局限性，并为发现神经精神疾病的生物标志物提供了强有力的工具。
AI.keywords: 跨模态对齐, 生物标志物发现, 神经影像, 遗传学, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于成功解决了跨模态对齐中数据不配对（Unpaired）的难题，通过线性投影实现了可解释的关联发现。其重要性在于能够充分利用现有的海量单模态数据进行生物标志物研究，对于神经精神疾病的机制探索具有重要价值。局限性在于该方法基于线性投影，可能无法捕捉复杂的非线性跨模态关系。

title: Domain Generalization via Text-Anchored Information Bottleneck
summary: Visual recognition models often fail when deployed in new environments. Domain Generalization (DG) addresses this by learning representations that remain invariant to environment-specific variations. Recent approaches increasingly rely on large vision-language models, assuming that preserving their expressive visual representations improves robustness. However, we show that such visual expressiveness can instead propagate spurious cues that tie representations to the training environments, hindering invariant learning. We therefore discard visual guidance and instead treat the language embedding space as the primary source of domain invariance, naturally acting as an information bottleneck that preserves core semantics while suppressing domain-specific variations. Extensive experiments across diverse backbones exhibit state-of-the-art performance and further analyze what makes guidance effective for robust generalization. These findings shift the focus of DG from improving representations to designing supervision that enforces invariance.

AI.title_translation: 基于文本锚定信息瓶颈的领域泛化
AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用文本嵌入空间作为信息瓶颈来抑制视觉模型中的虚假环境线索，从而提升领域泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 当前基于视觉语言模型的领域泛化方法虽然强调视觉表达能力，但往往会引入并传播与训练环境相关的虚假线索，导致模型泛化性能下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于“文本锚定信息瓶颈”（Text-Anchored Information Bottleneck）的方法，摒弃了传统的视觉引导，转而利用语言嵌入空间作为核心，在保留核心语义的同时抑制域特定变体。
AI.result: 在多种骨干网络上进行了广泛实验，结果表明该方法达到了领域泛化的最优性能（state-of-the-art），并揭示了有效监督对于稳健泛化的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将文本嵌入空间作为信息瓶颈，该方法能够有效去除视觉表征中的域特定虚假线索，从而在多种骨干网络上实现了领域泛化任务的最优性能。
AI.translation: 视觉识别模型在部署到新环境时往往会失效。领域泛化（DG）通过学习对环境特定变化保持不变的表征来解决这一问题。最近的方法越来越依赖大型视觉语言模型，假设保留其富有表现力的视觉表征可以提高鲁棒性。然而，我们发现这种视觉表现力反而会传播虚假线索，将表征与训练环境绑定，从而阻碍不变性学习。因此，我们摒弃了视觉引导，转而将语言嵌入空间作为领域不变性的主要来源，自然地充当信息瓶颈，在保留核心语义的同时抑制域特定变化。在多种骨干网络上的广泛实验展示了该方法达到了最优性能，并进一步分析了什么使得引导对于稳健泛化有效。这些发现将领域泛化的焦点从改进表征转向了设计强制不变性的监督方式。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种文本锚定信息瓶颈方法，旨在解决领域泛化中视觉模型易受环境虚假线索干扰的问题。通过将语言嵌入空间作为保持语义不变性的核心，该方法有效过滤了域特定信息，显著提升了模型的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 领域泛化, 信息瓶颈, 视觉语言模型, 不变性学习, 语义表示
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出将语言嵌入空间作为信息瓶颈，而非依赖视觉引导，从而有效抑制了视觉模型中虚假相关性的传播。这一视角转换对于领域泛化研究具有重要启发意义，即从单纯的表征学习转向监督策略的设计。

title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models What to See and Where to Look
comments: The paper has been accepted by ECCV 2026
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing VLAs' training relies heavily on text-centric visual question answering and chain-of-thought reasoning data, which emphasizes linguistic reasoning rather than action-grounded planning. As a result, the learned representations capture semantic knowledge but lack spatial dependencies crucial for reliable trajectory prediction. We propose DriveTeach-VLA, a framework that explicitly teaches VLAs what to see and where to look. Driving-aware Vision Distillation (DVD) injects driving-specific perceptual priors into the vision encoder, while 2D Trajectory-Guided Prompts (2D-TGP) provide spatial conditioning aligned with feasible driving trajectories. Together, they form a vision-guided learning pipeline: what to see (DVD pretraining) - where to look (TGP-guided SFT) - how to act (TGP-guided GRPO). DriveTeach-VLA achieves the state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM and nuScenes. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ShivaTeam/DriveTeach-VLA.
comment: The paper has been accepted by ECCV 2026

title: Message Passing Based Two-Timescale Bayesian Learning for Joint Channel and Memory Hardware Impairments Tracking
summary: Hardware impairments in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) receivers introduce inter-symbol memory and inter-element coupling, severely degrading channel estimation. This paper employs a residual recurrent gated unit (RGRU) to model the intra-slot memory of the hardware impairments and proposes a message-passing-based two-timescale Bayesian deep learning (MP-TTBDL) framework for joint channel and impairment tracking. Owing to small-scale fading, the wireless channel varies rapidly across slots, whereas hardware impairments drift slowly due to hardware aging and environmental variations. To capture these distinct physical timescales, a fastvarying Markov prior and a slow-varying Gaussian Markov prior are assigned to the sparse channel and the network parameters, respectively. Based on a multi-slot factor graph formulation, a message-passing algorithm is developed. Specifically, the inter-slot messages admit closed-form updates, while the intra-slot factor graph, due to its complex recurrent structure, is partitioned into a channel tracking module and an impairments calibration module. The channel tracking module performs sparse channel estimation via turbo orthogonal approximate message passing (Turbo-OAMP), and the impairments calibration module updates the impairment parameters via a specially designed deep approximate message passing (DAMP) procedure, with the two modules iteratively exchanging extrinsic information through expectation propagation (EP) until convergence. Simulation results show that the proposed framework robustly achieves lower channel estimation error than conventional compensators followed by channel estimation across different online impairment scenarios and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions.

AI.title_translation: 基于消息传递的双时间尺度贝叶斯学习：联合信道与记忆硬件损伤跟踪
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合消息传递与双时间尺度贝叶斯学习的框架，通过区分信道与硬件损伤的不同变化特性，实现了大规模MIMO中两者的联合精确跟踪。
AI.motivation: 大规模MIMO接收机中的硬件损伤（如记忆效应和耦合）严重降低了信道估计性能，且由于物理特性不同，信道与硬件损伤在时间尺度上存在显著差异，传统方法难以有效分离和跟踪。
AI.method: 提出了基于消息传递的双时间尺度贝叶斯深度学习（MP-TTBDL）框架。利用RGRU建模硬件损伤，基于多时隙因子图，结合Turbo-OAMP进行信道跟踪，以及通过改进的DAMP过程更新损伤参数，并利用期望传播（EP）在两个模块间迭代交换信息。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，与传统的先补偿后估计方法相比，该框架在不同在线损伤场景和信噪比条件下，均能显著降低信道估计误差，展现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的MP-TTBDL框架通过利用硬件损伤的慢变特性和信道的快变特性，实现了高效、鲁棒的联合跟踪，在多种在线场景下均优于传统方法。
AI.translation: 大规模MIMO接收机中的硬件损伤引入了符号间记忆效应和单元间耦合，严重降低了信道估计性能。本文采用残差循环门控单元（RGRU）来建模硬件损伤的槽内记忆效应，并提出了一种基于消息传递的双时间尺度贝叶斯深度学习（MP-TTBDL）框架，用于联合信道和损伤跟踪。由于小尺度衰落的存在，无线信道在时隙间变化迅速，而硬件损伤由于硬件老化和环境变化漂移缓慢。为了捕捉这些不同的物理时间尺度，分别为稀疏信道和网络参数分配了快变马尔可夫先验和慢变高斯马尔可夫先验。基于多时隙因子图公式，开发了一种消息传递算法。具体而言，时隙间消息采用闭式更新，而由于复杂的循环结构，槽内因子图被划分为信道跟踪模块和损伤校准模块。信道跟踪模块通过Turbo正交近似消息传递（Turbo-OAMP）执行稀疏信道估计，损伤校准模块通过专门设计的深度近似消息传递（DAMP）程序更新损伤参数，两个模块通过期望传播（EP）迭代交换外在信息直至收敛。仿真结果表明，所提出的框架在不同在线损伤场景和信噪比条件下，均比传统的补偿后信道估计方法实现了更低的信道估计误差。
AI.summary: 本文针对大规模MIMO系统中硬件损伤导致的信道估计性能下降问题，提出了一种MP-TTBDL框架。该方法利用信道快变与硬件损伤慢变的物理特性，通过双时间尺度因子图建模，结合Turbo-OAMP与DAMP算法，实现了信道与硬件损伤的联合鲁棒跟踪。
AI.keywords: 大规模MIMO, 硬件损伤, 消息传递算法, 双时间尺度学习, 信道估计
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用了硬件损伤与无线信道在时间尺度上的差异（快变与慢变），通过将深度学习与消息传递算法（Message Passing）相结合，有效地解决了大规模MIMO系统中信道估计与硬件损伤校准的耦合问题。其采用的“双时间尺度”建模思路为处理复杂系统中的多源干扰提供了新视角。

title: Diverse Evidence, Better Forecasts: Multi-Agent Deliberation Under Information Asymmetry
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used for forecasting future events, as deliberation among multiple LLMs is believed to improve reasoning and calibration. Yet existing approaches overlook a critical design choice: what information each agent receives. When all agents are given identical evidence, deliberation collapses into herding rather than genuine belief revision, leaving multi-agent systems little better than a single agent. We identify this as a fundamental gap and propose designed information asymmetry to close it: by partitioning evidence into shared public and disjoint private subsets, each agent holds exclusive knowledge that can only reach others through deliberation. We theoretically show that this decomposition reduces inter-agent error correlation, and instantiate it in InfoDelphi, a framework combining relevance-aware evidence routing, rationale-based iterative deliberation, and confidence-weighted aggregation. On PolyGym, a benchmark of 375 binary forecasting questions derived from real-world prediction markets, InfoDelphi outperforms the strongest single-agent and multi-agent baselines by 12--18% in Brier score and 4--8 percentage points in accuracy. More detailed experiments confirm that removing information asymmetry eliminates most deliberation gains, establishing diversity of input as the key enabler of effective multi-agent reasoning.

title: Unified Panoramic-Gaussian Representation for Monocular 4D Scene Synthesis
summary: 4D scene synthesis from monocular videos has made significant progress in recent years. However, existing methods are typically constrained by view interpolation. As a result, they struggle to infer unseen regions beyond the observed views. In this paper, we reformulate the task as 4D scene synthesis with unseen regions, which extends beyond traditional interpolation settings. Camera-conditioned video generation enables unseen region synthesis by guiding generation along specified cameras. However, these methods lack explicit 3D priors and are optimized with random camera trajectories. This design leads to severe inconsistencies under large trajectory deviations. To address this limitation, we build a unified training and inference framework with panoramic trajectory guidance. While this design improves cross-view consistency, the panoramic representation alone fails to model dynamic content effectively. Object motion in panoramic space introduces scale and shape distortions. To address this, we propose PanoGaussian, a unified Panoramic-Gaussian representation that distills the panoramic representation into an explicit dynamic Gaussian representation to capture dynamic physical priors of the 4D scene. Experiments demonstrate that PanoGaussian achieves consistent 4D scene synthesis even under large viewpoint variations.

title: Revisiting Decentralized Online Convex Optimization with Compressed Communication
summary: Decentralized online convex optimization (D-OCO) is a popular framework for distributed applications with streaming data. To tackle the communication bottleneck, previous studies have investigated D-OCO with compressed communication and proposed several algorithms that are variants of online gradient descent (OGD). However, for D-OCO with exact communication, the best existing algorithms are variants of follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL). In this paper, for the first time, we propose two FTRL-type algorithms for D-OCO with compressed communication. Compared with OGD-type algorithms, our algorithms are more elegant in both algorithmic design and theoretical analysis. The key insight is that the dual update mechanism of FTRL allows us to make a simple application of the technique for average consensus with communication compression. More specifically, our first algorithm considers the full-information setting, and can match the existing regret bounds. Our second algorithm is designed for the bandit setting, and can significantly improve both the regret bounds and communication costs of existing algorithms.

title: Temporal and Cross-Modal Alignment for Enhanced Audiovisual Video Captioning
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced video understanding, achieving precise temporal and cross-modal alignment in audiovisual video captioning remains a formidable challenge. Most existing approaches suffer from modality detachment and temporal incoherence, failing to accurately bind auditory events to visual entities or capture complex causal dynamics. To address these deficiencies, we propose TCA-Captioner, a framework specifically engineered to enhance Temporal and Cross-Modal Alignment for audiovisual video captioning. We first introduce the Observer-Checker-Corrector (OCC) framework, an iterative refinement strategy that generates high-fidelity, meticulously grounded training data. Leveraging a curated high-density human interaction dataset, TCA-Captioner is optimized to model sophisticated audiovisual interactions. Furthermore, we present TCA-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark utilizing a Decoupled Evaluation Protocol to isolate and quantify model proficiency in audiovisual binding and temporal relational reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TCA-Captioner sets a new standard for temporally-coherent and synchronized audiovisual narratives.

title: VeriChat: An Agentic Conversational AI Assistant for Hardware Security Verification
comments: This paper will be presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Omni-layer Intelligent Systems (COINS 2026), (https://coinsconf.com/)
summary: Hardware security verification is a multi-stage process in which engineers must navigate complex design analyses, threat considerations, and verification strategies. They often need security-focused guidance, yet current verification environments provide little structured support for such assistance. Although conversational AI could offer such on-demand assistance, directly using general-purpose chatbots like ChatGPT or Gemini is risky due to their tendency to hallucinate and their reliance on static, outdated knowledge. We present VeriChat, a domain-specialized conversational assistant designed to support, rather than replace, existing verification workflows by providing context-aware security guidance. VeriChat employs a retrieval-augmented, multi-agent workflow in which three specialized agents collaboratively minimize hallucinations while improving the transparency and reliability of the response. Beyond question answering, VeriChat integrates open-source EDA tools, including Icarus Verilog, Yosys, and SymbiYosys, to perform syntax checking, synthesis analysis, simulation, and formal verification directly on user-provided RTL designs. Evaluated using a comprehensive methodology, VeriChat achieves a Faithfulness score of 87.73%, significantly outperforming the leading proprietary models. We demonstrate the framework through a hardware Trojan detection case study on an AES S-Box IP, where VeriChat autonomously identifies, simulates, and formally proves a covert key-leakage vulnerability through a multi-turn conversational workflow.
comment: This paper will be presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Omni-layer Intelligent Systems (COINS 2026), (https://coinsconf.com/)

AI.title_translation: VeriChat：一种用于硬件安全验证的代理式对话AI助手
AI.tldr: VeriChat通过多智能体协作和集成EDA工具，为硬件安全验证提供高可靠、可执行的安全辅助，显著优于通用聊天机器人。
AI.motivation: 硬件安全验证过程复杂，现有验证环境缺乏专业安全指导；而通用聊天机器人存在幻觉风险且知识滞后，无法满足硬件安全领域对准确性和实时性的高要求。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于检索增强（RAG）的多智能体工作流，包含三个分工明确的智能体以协同降低幻觉；同时集成了Icarus Verilog、Yosys和SymbiYosys等开源EDA工具，实现对用户RTL设计的语法检查、综合、仿真及形式化验证。
AI.result: VeriChat的忠实度（Faithfulness）得分达到87.73%，优于主流私有模型。在AES S-Box的硬件木马检测案例中，成功实现了漏洞的识别、仿真与形式化证明。
AI.conclusion: VeriChat通过多智能体协作和工具链集成，在硬件安全验证中实现了高可靠性、上下文感知的专业辅助，有效提升了验证效率。
AI.translation: 硬件安全验证是一个多阶段的过程，工程师必须处理复杂的设计分析、威胁考量和验证策略。他们通常需要以安全为重点的指导，然而当前的验证环境对此类辅助提供的结构化支持很少。尽管对话式AI可以提供这种按需辅助，但直接使用ChatGPT或Gemini等通用聊天机器人由于其幻觉倾向以及对静态、过时知识的依赖，存在一定风险。我们提出了VeriChat，这是一个领域专用的对话助手，旨在通过提供上下文感知的安全指导来支持而非取代现有的验证工作流。VeriChat采用了一种检索增强的多智能体工作流，其中三个专业智能体协同工作，在提高响应透明度和可靠性的同时最大限度地减少了幻觉。除了问答之外，VeriChat还集成了包括Icarus Verilog、Yosys和SymbiYosys在内的开源EDA工具，直接对用户提供的RTL设计执行语法检查、综合分析、仿真和形式化验证。通过综合方法评估，VeriChat的忠实度得分达到87.73%，显著优于领先的私有模型。我们通过AES S-Box IP上的硬件木马检测案例研究展示了该框架，其中VeriChat通过多轮对话工作流自主识别、仿真并形式化证明了一个隐蔽的密钥泄露漏洞。
AI.summary: VeriChat是一款面向硬件安全验证的领域专用对话式AI助手，通过多智能体协同工作流和集成EDA工具，为工程师提供上下文感知的安全指导，解决了通用大模型在专业验证任务中的幻觉和不可靠问题。
AI.keywords: 硬件安全验证, 多智能体系统, 检索增强生成, EDA工具集成, 漏洞检测
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多智能体协作与检索增强生成（RAG）应用于硬件安全验证领域，解决了通用大模型在专业领域存在的幻觉和知识滞后问题。通过集成EDA工具实现“对话+工具执行”的闭环，显著提升了硬件安全验证的自动化水平和可靠性，具有很高的工程应用价值。

title: UT-AISTimprt submission for ICME 2026 Grand Challenge on Academic Text-to-Music Generation
comments: Accepted to ICME 2026 Grand Challenge on Academic Text-to-Music Generation
summary: This work investigates the effect of batch sampling strategies during training for text-to-audio music generation under low-data and small-scale model settings. This paper describes our approach and findings for the ICME 2026 Grand Challenge on Academic Text-to-Music Generation. Training data are clustered using either text embeddings or audio embeddings, and samples with similar characteristics are grouped within the same mini-batch to mitigate gradient interference. The effects of modality and cluster granularity on clustering are analyzed. Results show that clustering based on text embeddings achieves better performance on objective evaluation metrics than clustering based on audio embeddings. In addition, different cluster granularity leads to different behaviors across evaluation criteria: a moderate number of clusters performs best on objective metrics, while a larger number of clusters tends to exhibit music with more coherent structure in listening tests.
comment: Accepted to ICME 2026 Grand Challenge on Academic Text-to-Music Generation

AI.title_translation: UT-AISTimprt 在 ICME 2026 学术文本生成音乐挑战赛中的提交方案
AI.tldr: 通过在训练中按文本嵌入对样本进行聚类以减少梯度干扰，从而提升低数据量场景下文本生成音乐的性能。
AI.motivation: 在低数据量和小模型规模的设置下，探索如何通过优化批量采样策略来提高文本生成音乐的效果，并解决训练过程中的梯度干扰问题。
AI.method: 在训练过程中，根据文本嵌入或音频嵌入对数据进行聚类，并将具有相似特征的样本组合在同一个小批量（mini-batch）中，以减少梯度干扰；同时分析了模态选择和聚类粒度对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: 基于文本嵌入的聚类在客观评价指标上表现优于音频嵌入；此外，适中的聚类数量在客观指标上表现最优，而较大的聚类数量在主观听感测试中展现出更好的音乐结构连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，基于文本嵌入的聚类优于音频嵌入，且聚类粒度对模型的客观评估指标与主观音乐连贯性具有不同的影响，需根据应用需求进行权衡。
AI.translation: 本项研究探讨了在低数据量和小模型设置下，批量采样策略对文本生成音频/音乐的影响。本文描述了我们在 ICME 2026 学术文本生成音乐挑战赛中的方法与发现。通过利用文本嵌入或音频嵌入对训练数据进行聚类，将具有相似特征的样本归为同一小批量，以减轻梯度干扰。研究分析了模态和聚类粒度对聚类效果的影响。结果表明，基于文本嵌入的聚类在客观评价指标上优于基于音频嵌入的聚类。此外，不同的聚类粒度在各项评估标准下表现出不同的行为：适中的聚类数量在客观指标上表现最好，而较大的聚类数量在听感测试中往往呈现出结构更连贯的音乐。
AI.summary: 本文针对低数据和小模型场景下的文本生成音乐任务，提出了一种基于嵌入聚类的批量采样策略。通过将相似样本分组以减少梯度干扰，研究发现文本嵌入聚类效果更佳，且聚类粒度在客观评估指标与主观音乐连贯性之间存在权衡。
AI.keywords: 文本生成音乐, 批量采样, 聚类策略, 低数据量, 梯度干扰
AI.comments: 该研究针对低数据量和小模型场景，通过改进批量采样策略（基于嵌入的聚类）来缓解梯度干扰，为资源受限下的文本生成音乐任务提供了实用的优化思路。其创新点在于对比了文本与音频嵌入聚类的效果，并揭示了聚类粒度在客观指标与主观听感之间的权衡。

title: UniWind: Toward Unified Day-Ahead Wind Power Forecasting via Physics-Informed State Routing
summary: Day-ahead wind power forecasting is essential for cost-effective power-system operation. It is primarily driven by future meteorological conditions while retaining temporal dependencies in power generation. In practice, observed wind-farm power often entangles physically available power with local environmental effects and latent operational states, such as shutdowns and curtailment. Existing physical models provide useful constraints but adapt poorly across wind farms, whereas data-driven models can capture rich correlations but often conflate meteorological effects with state-induced deviations. In this study, we propose UniWind, a wind power forecasting model based on physics-informed state routing. UniWind first employs a Physical Prior Estimator to construct a site-calibrated physical prior by combining site-conditioned monotonic warping with a shared physical power curve. It further applies a physical upper-bound constraint to shape this prior as a soft envelope of available wind power generation. UniWind then proposes a Latent State Encoder to model operating-state embeddings and transforms the physical prior into final power forecasts through a State-aware Power Corrector, which uses knowledge-guided supervised state routing and bounded, state-specific expert correction. Full-shot and cross-farm zero-shot experiments on more than 20 real-world datasets demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of UniWind.

title: Self-Referential $K$-SAT and the Finite Analogue of Gödel's Incompleteness Theorem
summary:
Self-reference and solution independence are core properties underlying intractability. This paper establishes a finite combinatorial analogue of Gödel's incompleteness theorems within Boolean $K$-SAT. While standard random $K$-SAT has assignment correlations that disrupt solution independence, we resolve this via a logarithmic-width ensemble ($K = O(\log N)$). Here, satisfying assignments converge to a Poisson distribution, letting unsatisfiable and uniquely satisfiable formulas coexist. By executing a single-clause substitution conditioned on the unique solution, we construct structurally irreducible SAT/UNSAT pairs that are indistinguishable via local evaluation.
  Using algorithmic information theory and Shannon channels, we prove that deductive pipelines restricted to a sublinear window suffer from an informational blind spot, forcing a descriptive lower bound of $K(\mathcal{A}) \geq Ω(N^{1-δ})$. This deficit forces any Resolution refutation of the UNSAT instance to utilize wide clauses ($w(π) \geq Ω(N^{1-δ})$), triggering an exponential proof-tree explosion ($S(φ) \geq \exp(Ω(N^{1-2δ}))$). As $δ\rightarrow 0^+$, this bound converges to the worst-case $2^N$ threshold, reframing the Strong Exponential Time Hypothesis (SETH) as a direct projection of Gödel incompleteness onto finite computation.
  We diagnose the decades-long stagnation in complexity theory. Transitioning from Turing's class separation to a Gödelian paradigm of instance indistinguishability, we introduce a multi-dimensional comparative framework that contrasts these two historical lineages across distinct perspectives. The self-referential hardness exhibits physical invariance: it precludes quantum shortcuts due to the necessity of global semantic analysis and delineates a scaling bottleneck for machine learning architectures operating on lossy, local compression.

AI.title_translation: 自指K-SAT与哥德尔不完备定理的有限类似物
AI.tldr: 通过将哥德尔不完备定理应用于有限K-SAT，证明了SETH是计算领域中不可避免的“信息盲点”，揭示了计算难度的根本逻辑限制。
AI.motivation: 旨在通过哥德尔不完备定理的有限组合类似物，解释计算复杂性中的难解性根源，并解决长期存在的复杂性理论停滞问题。
AI.method: 利用对数宽度的K-SAT系综（K=O(log N)），结合算法信息论和香农信道，通过单子句代换构建结构上不可约的SAT/UNSAT对，证明了局部评估下的不可区分性。
AI.result: 证明了受限的演绎流水线存在信息盲点，强制产生描述性下界，导致Resolution证明树呈指数级爆炸，从而将SETH重构为哥德尔不完备性的直接体现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将SETH重新定义为哥德尔不完备性在有限计算中的投影，指出计算复杂性中的停滞源于从图灵范式向哥德尔范式的转换需求。
AI.translation: 自指和解独立性是导致难解性的核心属性。本文在布尔K-SAT中建立了一个有限组合的哥德尔不完备定理类似物。虽然标准随机K-SAT具有破坏解独立性的赋值相关性，但我们通过对数宽度的系综（K = O(log N)）解决了这个问题。在此模型下，满足赋值收敛到泊松分布，使得不可满足和唯一可满足的公式共存。通过执行以唯一解为条件的单子句代换，我们构建了在局部评估下不可区分的结构不可约SAT/UNSAT对。利用算法信息论和香农信道，我们证明了限制在次线性窗口内的演绎流水线会遭受信息盲点，迫使描述下界为 K(A) ≥ Ω(N^{1-δ})。这种缺陷迫使任何对UNSAT实例的Resolution反驳都必须使用宽子句 (w(π) ≥ Ω(N^{1-δ}))，从而触发指数级的证明树爆炸 (S(φ) ≥ exp(Ω(N^{1-2δ})))。当 δ → 0+ 时，该界限收敛到最坏情况下的 2^N 阈值，将强指数时间假设 (SETH) 重构为哥德尔不完备性在有限计算上的直接投影。我们诊断了复杂性理论中长达数十年的停滞。从图灵的类分离转向实例不可区分性的哥德尔范式，我们引入了一个多维比较框架，对比了这两个历史谱系。自指的难解性表现出物理不变性：由于需要全局语义分析，它排除了量子捷径，并勾勒出了在有损、局部压缩下运行的机器学习架构的缩放瓶颈。
AI.summary: 本文揭示了自指与解独立性是导致SAT问题难解的核心。通过构建对数宽度的K-SAT系综，证明了存在局部不可区分的SAT/UNSAT对，从而建立起有限组合领域的哥德尔不完备性，并将SETH重新解释为有限计算中哥德尔不完备性的必然结果。
AI.keywords: 自指, K-SAT, 哥德尔不完备定理, 强指数时间假设 (SETH), 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 该论文极具创新性地将哥德尔不完备定理引入计算复杂性理论，通过建立逻辑自指与SAT问题难度的联系，为理解SETH提供了一个全新的理论框架，具有深远的理论意义。

title: Separating Expert Retention from Autonomous Source Inference in Raw-ECG-Replay-Free Continual ECG Deployment
summary:
In multi-source ECG deployment, models may need to incorporate new data sources when earlier raw ECGs cannot be retained or replayed. Freezing a pretrained backbone and assigning each source an isolated classifier prevents parameter interference, but deployment still requires selecting an expert when source metadata are unavailable. We study this distinction through \ours{}, an incremental expert bank built on frozen 1024-dimensional ECGFounder features. Each arriving domain adds a balanced-softmax linear expert, while a lightweight router is fitted only on retained training features and domain labels from sources observed so far. A validation-calibrated margin rule fuses the two most likely experts instead of committing to a single routed expert.
  On CPSC, PTB-XL, Georgia, and Chapman-Shaoxing, source-aware expert selection reaches $0.7915\pm0.0036$ Macro-F1 and a matched offline independent-head reference reaches $0.7885\pm0.0009$, supporting strong source-aware expert retention. Without source IDs, an MLP router reaches $0.7756\pm0.0027$ and top-2 margin fusion reaches $0.7782\pm0.0022$. The top-2 gain over hard MLP routing is small ($+0.0026$), with a 95\% confidence interval from paired bootstrap that includes zero. Across three domain orders, the top-2-to-oracle gap remains $0.0111$--$0.0133$, identifying autonomous source inference as the main remaining bottleneck. No raw ECGs are replayed, but frozen training features are retained for router updates; the method is therefore not memory-free.

title: HistoSeg++: Delving deeper with attention and multiscale feature fusion for biomarker segmentation
comments: Published in the Proceedings of ICBBE 2025. The Version of Record is available at https://doi.org/10.1145/3794209.3794211
summary: Segmentation of biomarkers in medical images is frequently viewed as a first step towards medical image analysis in any bioinformatics or biomedical application. Despite progress, existing methods still struggle to capture information at multiple scales and to perform upsampling effectively across different datasets. These shortcomings often result in suboptimal generalization capabilities. Recently, architectures belonging to the Nested-UNet family excel in capturing multiscale contextual information and upsample them effectively. In this work, We propose a novel Nested-UNet architecture that effectively captures multi-scale contextual information. It includes inner and outer attention units to enhance focus during upsampling, along with channel-wise feature recalibration using squeeze-and-excitation modules, leading to improved segmentation performance. Additionally, the architecture integrates an edge-aware loss to emphasize boundary accuracy by assigning greater importance to edge regions. Tested extensively on three publicly available benchmark datasets. Our method demonstrates a generalization performance superior to existing Nested-UNet methods. Code: https://github.com/saadwazir/histosegplusplus
comment: Published in the Proceedings of ICBBE 2025. The Version of Record is available at https://doi.org/10.1145/3794209.3794211

AI.title_translation: HistoSeg++：深入探索基于注意力机制和多尺度特征融合的生物标志物分割
AI.tldr: HistoSeg++ 改进了 Nested-UNet 架构，通过引入注意力机制和边缘感知损失，显著提升了医学图像生物标志物分割的精度和泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割方法在处理多尺度信息和上采样时存在局限性，导致模型在不同数据集上的泛化能力较差。
AI.method: 提出了一种改进的 Nested-UNet 架构，包含用于增强上采样阶段关注力的内外注意力单元、用于通道特征重校准的挤压-激励（Squeeze-and-Excitation）模块，以及用于提高边界分割准确性的边缘感知损失函数。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准数据集上的测试结果表明，该方法在分割性能和泛化能力方面均优于现有的 Nested-UNet 方法。
AI.conclusion: HistoSeg++ 成功地通过增强的注意力机制和边缘感知策略提升了生物标志物分割的精度和泛化能力，优于现有的 Nested-UNet 变体。
AI.translation: 医学图像中的生物标志物分割通常被视为任何生物信息学或生物医学应用中医学图像分析的第一步。尽管取得了进展，但现有方法在捕获多尺度信息和跨数据集进行有效上采样方面仍面临困难。这些缺点通常导致泛化能力不佳。最近，Nested-UNet 系列架构在捕获多尺度上下文信息并进行有效上采样方面表现出色。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的 Nested-UNet 架构，可以有效地捕获多尺度上下文信息。它包括用于在上采样过程中增强关注力的内部和外部注意力单元，以及使用挤压-激励模块进行的通道特征重校准，从而提高了分割性能。此外，该架构集成了边缘感知损失，通过为边缘区域分配更高的权重来强调边界准确性。在三个公开可用的基准数据集上进行了广泛测试。我们的方法展示了优于现有 Nested-UNet 方法的泛化性能。代码：https://github.com/saadwazir/histosegplusplus
AI.summary: 本文提出了 HistoSeg++，这是一种改进的 Nested-UNet 架构，通过引入内外注意力单元、挤压-激励模块和边缘感知损失，有效提升了医学图像中生物标志物的分割性能和模型泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 生物标志物分割, Nested-UNet, 多尺度特征融合, 注意力机制, 边缘感知损失
AI.comments: 该论文通过改进Nested-UNet架构，巧妙地结合了注意力机制、多尺度特征融合及边缘感知损失，有效解决了医学图像分割中边界模糊和多尺度特征提取不足的问题。其创新之处在于将多种先进模块集成到一个统一的框架中，并在泛化性上表现出显著优势。

title: ICDepth: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Video Depth Estimation via In-Context Conditioning
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://xuanhuahe.github.io/ICDepth/
summary: Monocular video depth estimation requires temporal consistency, geometric accuracy, and generalization across diverse scenarios, yet existing methods struggle to achieve all three simultaneously. Discriminative models excel at per-frame accuracy but suffer from temporal drift due to limited context windows, while generative methods improve consistency and generalization at the cost of extensive training data (10M+ samples) and lack of geometric precision. In response to these issues, we introduce \textbf{ICDepth}, a framework that adapts pre-trained text-to-video diffusion transformers for video depth estimation via In-Context Conditioning (ICC), leveraging their rich spatial-temporal priors. To address key challenges in transferring ICC from generation to dense prediction, we propose: (1)~\textbf{SAND-Attention}, which ensures precise spatial-temporal alignment via shared RoPE and enforces unidirectional attention to prevent noise contamination; (2)~\textbf{SRFM}, which injects DINOv2 semantic and resolution priors to enhance geometric precision. ICDepth achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks with remarkable data efficiency, trained on only 0.8M frames ($6$--$13\times$ less than competing generative methods), while demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to diverse domains.
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://xuanhuahe.github.io/ICDepth/

title: SCAPE: Accurate and Efficient LLM Training with Extreme Sparse Communication
summary: Communication increasingly dominates the cost of Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training, especially under data-parallel and sharded training schemes, where gradient synchronization and parameter reconstruction overhead increase with model size and system scale. Existing communication-reduction methods either sparsify raw gradients, which can be unstable for modern Adam-style optimizers at high sparsity, or quantize communication, whose savings are fundamentally bounded by bit width and often incur additional runtime overhead. We present SCAPE, a communication-efficient distributed optimizer for LLM training that exploits the stability of AdamS's first-moment to enable aggressive sparsification without loss of LLM quality. Instead of constructing masks from raw gradients, SCAPE derives them from first-moment-based statistics, partitions mask generation across workers to align with optimizer sharding, and delays mask usage by one step so that mask synchronization can overlap with computation. SCAPE also reconstructs the quantities required for second-moment updates from a single synchronized sparse buffer, avoiding an additional collective. We implement SCAPE in Megatron-LM and evaluate its convergence by pre-training GPT-345M on OpenWebText and Llama-500M on SlimPajama-6B using 32 NVIDIA GH200 GPUs on TACC Vista. In both models, SCAPE preserves training stability, validation loss, and downstream task accuracy under 90\% and 99\% sparsity. For Llama-500M, SCAPE reduces end-to-end pre-training wall-clock time by up to 43.3\% while maintaining model quality comparable to dense AdamW and AdamS. For Llama-1.8B, SCAPE achieves up to 3.26$\times$ speedup per step compared to dense AdamS.

AI.title_translation: SCAPE：具有极度稀疏通信的精确且高效的LLM训练方法
AI.tldr: SCAPE通过利用AdamS一阶矩生成稀疏掩码并重叠通信，在保持模型质量的同时，大幅降低了LLM训练的通信开销并加速了训练过程。
AI.motivation: 在大规模LLM训练中，梯度同步和参数重构带来的通信开销已成为瓶颈，而现有的梯度稀疏化方法在高稀疏度下不稳定，量化方法则存在压缩比上限和额外的运行开销。
AI.method: SCAPE利用AdamS的一阶矩统计量生成稀疏掩码，将掩码生成过程分片以匹配优化器分片，并通过延迟一步使用掩码来实现通信与计算的重叠；同时，通过单个同步稀疏缓冲区重建二阶矩更新所需的量，减少了通信开销。
AI.result: SCAPE在90%和99%的稀疏度下保持了模型训练的稳定性和准确性；在Llama-500M上端到端训练时间减少了43.3%，在Llama-1.8B上每步训练速度提升最高达3.26倍。
AI.conclusion: SCAPE通过基于一阶矩的稀疏化策略和高效的掩码同步机制，在保持模型训练质量的前提下，大幅降低了LLM训练中的通信开销，显著提升了训练速度。
AI.translation: 在大规模语言模型（LLM）的预训练中，通信成本日益成为主导因素，特别是在数据并行和分片训练方案下，梯度同步和参数重构的开销随着模型规模和系统规模的增加而增加。现有的通信压缩方法要么稀疏化原始梯度（在高稀疏度下对现代Adam类优化器不稳定），要么进行量化（节省空间受限于位宽且常带来额外的运行时开销）。我们提出了SCAPE，一种用于LLM训练的通信高效分布式优化器，它利用AdamS一阶矩的稳定性，在不损失LLM质量的前提下实现了激进的稀疏化。SCAPE不是从原始梯度构建掩码，而是从基于一阶矩的统计量中导出掩码，将掩码生成过程在工作节点间进行划分以与优化器分片对齐，并延迟一步使用掩码，从而使掩码同步可以与计算重叠。SCAPE还通过单个同步稀疏缓冲区重建二阶矩更新所需的量，避免了额外的集体通信。我们在Megatron-LM中实现了SCAPE，并在TACC Vista上使用32个NVIDIA GH200 GPU，通过在OpenWebText上预训练GPT-345M和在SlimPajama-6B上预训练Llama-500M来评估其收敛性。在两个模型中，SCAPE在90%和99%的稀疏度下都保持了训练稳定性、验证损失和下游任务准确性。对于Llama-500M，SCAPE在保持与密集AdamW和AdamS相当的模型质量的同时，将端到端的预训练挂钟时间减少了高达43.3%。对于Llama-1.8B，与密集AdamS相比，SCAPE实现了每步最高3.26倍的加速。
AI.summary: SCAPE是一种针对LLM训练的通信高效分布式优化器，通过基于AdamS一阶矩统计量的激进稀疏化策略，结合计算与通信重叠技术，在不损失模型质量的前提下，显著降低了大规模训练的通信成本并提升了效率。
AI.keywords: LLM训练, 稀疏通信, 分布式优化器, AdamS, 梯度稀疏化
AI.comments: 该论文提出的SCAPE方法在保持模型质量的同时，通过极度稀疏化通信显著提升了训练效率。其核心创新在于利用AdamS的一阶矩统计量生成掩码，并结合掩码同步与计算重叠机制，有效解决了现有稀疏化方法的不稳定性问题，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Beyond Gradient-Based Attacks: Adversarial Robustness and Explainability Stability in Cybersecurity Classifiers
summary: Adversarial attacks on cybersecurity classifiers pose a dual threat: degrading predictions and destabilising the SHAP-based explanations that security analysts rely on to understand and triage alerts. We extend our prior MLP conference study to Random Forest and XGBoost across four tabular security datasets (phishing URLs, UNSW-NB15, NF-ToN-IoT, HIKARI-2021), evaluating five attacks including three black-box methods applicable to non-differentiable tree models. We introduce the Explainability Stability Index (ESI), a scalar metric computed from TreeSHAP attribution drift under adversarial perturbation, reported on the same [0,1] scale as the Robustness Index (RI). A key finding is that gradient-based black-box attacks (ZOO) produce degenerate results against XGBoost (apparent RI ~0.98) due to piecewise-constant prediction surfaces, while score-based Square Attack reveals genuine vulnerability (RI ~0.36). These degenerate perturbations still drive substantial attribution drift: XGBoost ESI ~0.06-0.16 despite near-perfect ZOO robustness, versus 0.14-0.29 for RF, showing that prediction robustness and explanation stability are distinct axes requiring joint measurement. A two-axis framework (gradient dependence, query efficiency) explains the observed attack ranking and yields practical guidance for tree ensemble evaluation. A step-size ablation explains a counterintuitive PGD anomaly on z-score normalised tabular data.

AI.title_translation: 超越基于梯度的攻击：网络安全分类器中的对抗鲁棒性与可解释性稳定性
AI.tldr: 研究发现，网络安全模型即使在预测上表现出抗攻击能力，其基于SHAP的解释也可能在攻击下失效，因此必须同时评估预测鲁棒性和可解释性稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的对抗攻击研究主要关注预测准确性，忽略了这些攻击对安全分析师所依赖的SHAP解释稳定性的潜在破坏，且针对非微分树模型的评估方法存在局限性。
AI.method: 引入可解释性稳定性指数（ESI）来量化TreeSHAP在对抗扰动下的漂移；在四种表格安全数据集上，对比分析了随机森林（RF）和XGBoost模型，并评估了包括黑盒攻击在内的五种攻击方法。
AI.result: 研究发现，梯度黑盒攻击（ZOO）在XGBoost上表现出虚假的鲁棒性（RI高），而基于分数的Square Attack揭示了真正的脆弱性；此外，即使在预测鲁棒性极高的情况下，仍观察到显著的解释漂移（ESI），证明了预测鲁棒性与可解释性稳定性并不等同。
AI.conclusion: 预测鲁棒性和可解释性稳定性是两个独立的评估维度，必须联合评估以确保安全系统的完整性。简单的梯度攻击可能无法揭示非微分模型（如XGBoost）的真实漏洞，需采用更有效的黑盒攻击方法进行评估。
AI.translation: 网络安全分类器遭受的对抗性攻击构成了双重威胁：不仅降低了预测准确性，还破坏了安全分析师依赖的基于SHAP的解释。我们将之前的多层感知机（MLP）研究扩展到四种表格安全数据集（phishing URLs, UNSW-NB15, NF-ToN-IoT, HIKARI-2021）上的随机森林和XGBoost模型，评估了五种攻击方法，包括三种适用于不可微树模型的黑盒方法。我们引入了可解释性稳定性指数（ESI），这是一种通过对抗扰动下TreeSHAP归因漂移计算得出的标量指标，与鲁棒性指数（RI）在同一[0,1]尺度上报告。研究的一个关键发现是，基于梯度的黑盒攻击（ZOO）由于分段常数预测曲面，对XGBoost产生退化结果（表观RI约为0.98），而基于分数的Square Attack揭示了真正的漏洞（RI约为0.36）。这些退化扰动仍会导致实质性的归因漂移：尽管ZOO鲁棒性接近完美，但XGBoost的ESI仍为0.06-0.16，而RF则为0.14-0.29，这表明预测鲁棒性和解释稳定性是需要联合测量的不同维度。一个双轴框架（梯度依赖性、查询效率）解释了观察到的攻击排名，并为树集成评估提供了实践指导。步长消融实验解释了z-score归一化表格数据上反直觉的PGD异常。
AI.summary: 本文研究了网络安全分类器在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性及可解释性稳定性。作者提出了可解释性稳定性指数（ESI），并针对树模型（RF和XGBoost）评估了多种攻击方法。研究表明，预测鲁棒性与可解释性稳定性是两个不同的维度，且某些攻击方法虽无法显著改变预测结果，却会严重干扰模型的解释输出。
AI.keywords: 网络安全, 对抗攻击, 可解释性, TreeSHAP, 鲁棒性评估
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了网络安全分类器中预测鲁棒性与可解释性稳定性之间的解耦关系。其创新点在于提出了“可解释性稳定性指数（ESI）”，证明了即使在模型预测看似稳健（高RI）的情况下，其解释模型（TreeSHAP）仍可能发生显著漂移，这对依赖解释进行决策的安全分析人员具有重要意义。

title: Imagining the Sense of Touch: Touch-Informed Manipulation via Imagined Tactile Representations
summary: Tactile sensing can substantially improve contact-rich robotic manipulation, yet its practical deployment remains limited by the fragility, calibration requirements, and maintenance burden of tactile hardware. This raises a fundamental question: can robots benefit from tactile knowledge without requiring tactile sensors at deployment? We present TacImag, a tactile imagination framework that predicts tactile observations from vision and proprioception and uses the generated signals to guide manipulation policies. Trained from paired visuotactile demonstrations, TacImag enables touch-informed manipulation using only visual observations at test time. We evaluate TacImag on six simulated and four real-world manipulation tasks. Across simulation and real-world experiments, imagined tactile observations consistently improve manipulation performance without requiring tactile hardware. In real-world experiments, imagined force fields improve contact-sensitive tasks by 44.4% on average, whereas imagined tactile images improve texture-sensitive tasks by 23.3%, revealing that the effectiveness of tactile imagination depends strongly on the relationship between tactile representation and task requirements. Our results further suggest that tactile imagination does not simply recover missing tactile measurements. Instead, it acts as a form of contact-aware supervision that transforms subtle visual interaction cues into representations that are easier for manipulation policies to exploit.

AI.title_translation: 想象触觉：通过想象触觉表征实现触觉感知操作
AI.tldr: TacImag通过视觉和本体感觉预测触觉信息，让机器人无需物理触觉传感器也能在复杂操作中实现“触觉感知”，显著提升了任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 触觉传感器存在易损、校准复杂和维护成本高等实际部署障碍，研究旨在探索机器人是否能在不依赖物理触觉传感器的情况下获得触觉知识以辅助操作。
AI.method: 提出了TacImag框架，通过成对的视觉-触觉演示进行训练，在测试时仅利用视觉和本体感觉输入，通过模型预测触觉观察结果（力场或图像），并以此引导操作策略。
AI.result: 在6个仿真和4个现实任务中，TacImag均能提升操作性能。现实实验中，力场想象使接触敏感任务成功率平均提升44.4%，触觉图像想象使纹理敏感任务成功率提升23.3%。
AI.conclusion: TacImag证明了在缺乏物理触觉传感器的情况下，通过视觉和本体感觉“想象”触觉信息能够显著提升机器人复杂操作任务的成功率，为触觉感知提供了一种高效的替代方案。
AI.translation: 触觉感知可以显著改善接触丰富的机器人操作，但其实际应用受到触觉硬件易损性、校准要求和维护负担的限制。这提出了一个根本性问题：机器人在部署时无需触觉传感器，能否受益于触觉知识？我们提出了TacImag，一个通过视觉和本体感觉预测触觉观察并利用生成信号指导操作策略的触觉想象框架。TacImag通过成对的视觉-触觉演示进行训练，使机器人在测试时仅使用视觉观察即可实现触觉感知操作。我们在六个仿真和四个现实世界的操作任务上评估了TacImag。在仿真和现实实验中，想象的触觉观察始终在无需触觉硬件的情况下提高了操作性能。在现实世界的实验中，想象的力场使接触敏感任务的性能平均提高了44.4%，而想象的触觉图像使纹理敏感任务的性能提高了23.3%，这表明触觉想象的有效性在很大程度上取决于触觉表征与任务需求之间的关系。我们的结果进一步表明，触觉想象不仅仅是恢复缺失的触觉测量。相反，它作为一种接触感知的监督形式，将微妙的视觉交互线索转化为更容易被操作策略利用的表征。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TacImag框架，通过从视觉和本体感觉中学习预测触觉表征，使机器人在没有物理触觉传感器的情况下，能够实现触觉感知的操作，并通过这种“触觉想象”作为接触感知监督，显著提升了机器人的操作性能。
AI.keywords: 触觉想象, 机器人操作, 视觉触觉学习, 无传感器感知, 接触感知监督
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了“触觉想象”的概念，通过视觉和本体感觉预测触觉信息，有效解决了机器人触觉传感器部署困难的问题。其重要意义在于证明了触觉信息可以以“想象”的形式存在，为机器人感知提供了新的范式，但其效果仍依赖于任务类型与触觉表征的匹配度。

title: WARP: Weight-Space Analysis for Recovering Training Data Portfolios
comments: This work appears in the ICML 2026 Workshop on Weight-Space Symmetries (WSS): from Foundations to Practical Applications. Our source code is available at github.com/SprocketLab/WARP
summary: Foundation models are routinely released to the public, yet the data recipes used to train them -- such as domain mixture weights that determine how different sources are sampled -- are rarely disclosed. This creates an access asymmetry: researchers study the resulting models but lack visibility into the training distribution that produces them. Prior works for inferring training data, such as membership inference, detect at the level of individual samples and thus cannot characterize the global composition of the training corpus. We introduce WARP, a framework that recovers a fine-tuned model's training mixtures directly from its released weights. WARP interpolates between the base and fine-tuned models using model merging, generating pseudo-checkpoints that approximate the missing training trajectory and expose a geometric footprint of the training data in the weight space. From these simulated footprints, WARP extracts geometric features and maps them to domain proportions using either a parameter-free softmax readout or an MLP projector trained on synthetic mixtures. In controlled experiments with BERT and GPT-2, WARP recovers domain mixtures with an average MAE as low as 0.046 and 0.104 respectively, outperforming membership inference and a variant with access to the true training trajectory.
comment: This work appears in the ICML 2026 Workshop on Weight-Space Symmetries (WSS): from Foundations to Practical Applications. Our source code is available at github.com/SprocketLab/WARP

AI.title_translation: WARP：用于恢复训练数据组合的权重空间分析方法
AI.tldr: WARP通过模型合并技术分析基础模型权重，在无需访问真实训练数据的情况下，高精度地反推模型的训练数据混合比例。
AI.motivation: 基础模型的训练数据配方（如数据混合权重）通常不公开，导致研究者无法获知模型的训练分布，而现有的成员推理方法仅能检测单个样本，无法表征全局训练组成。
AI.method: 提出WARP框架，通过模型合并（Model Merging）在基础模型和微调模型之间进行插值，生成伪检查点以模拟训练轨迹，提取权重空间中的几何特征，并利用softmax readout或MLP投影器映射到领域比例。
AI.result: 在BERT和GPT-2的实验中，WARP恢复领域混合的平均绝对误差（MAE）分别低至0.046和0.104，表现优于成员推理及利用真实训练轨迹的对比方法。
AI.conclusion: WARP提供了一种通过模型权重有效推断训练数据组成的高效框架，揭示了模型权重中蕴含的训练数据几何特征，为模型透明度研究提供了新工具。
AI.translation: 基础模型通常会向公众发布，但用于训练它们的数据配方（例如决定不同来源采样方式的领域混合权重）却很少披露。这造成了一种访问不对称：研究人员研究生成的模型，却无法了解产生这些模型的训练分布。先前用于推断训练数据的方法（如成员推理）仅能在单个样本级别进行检测，因此无法表征训练语料库的整体组成。我们引入了WARP，这是一个直接从已发布权重中恢复微调模型训练混合比例的框架。WARP使用模型合并技术在基础模型和微调模型之间进行插值，生成近似缺失训练轨迹的伪检查点，并暴露权重空间中训练数据的几何足迹。从这些模拟足迹中，WARP提取几何特征，并使用无参数的softmax读取器或在合成混合物上训练的MLP投影器将其映射到领域比例。在针对BERT和GPT-2的受控实验中，WARP恢复领域混合的平均绝对误差（MAE）分别低至0.046和0.104，性能优于成员推理及拥有真实训练轨迹访问权限的变体方法。
AI.summary: WARP是一种通过分析基础模型权重来推断其训练数据组成（领域混合比例）的新框架。它通过模型合并技术模拟训练轨迹，从生成的几何特征中映射出训练数据比例，解决了现有方法无法表征训练语料库全局组成的问题。
AI.keywords: 权重空间分析, 模型合并, 训练数据配方, 基础模型, 模型透明度
AI.comments: WARP通过模型权重空间分析来反推训练数据配方，这一思路非常创新。它巧妙地利用模型合并（Model Merging）技术生成伪检查点，从而规避了对真实训练过程的依赖。尽管该方法在BERT和GPT-2上表现出色，但其在更大规模、更复杂的现代LLM上的泛化能力和鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。

title: A Dynamic Phasor Framework for Analysis of Subsynchronous Oscillations in Multi-Machine Systems with IBRs and Large Loads
summary: Although the electromagnetic transient (EMT) framework can capture subsynchronous oscillations (SSOs), it faces scalability issues for large-scale systems. Thus motivated, we propose a generalized dynamic phasor (DP) framework to analyze SSOs in multi-machine systems with inverter-based resources (IBRs) and large loads such as artificial intelligence data centers (AI DCs) under balanced and unbalanced conditions. The grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) IBRs are modeled in their respective $dq$-frame DPs. In contrast, the detailed model of multi-mass turbine driven synchronous generators (SGs) along with dynamic transmission network models and loads are represented in $pnz$-frame DPs. The linearizability and time-invariance of the framework enable us to perform eigen decomposition, which is a powerful tool for root-cause analysis of SSO modes and the design of damping controllers. In addition, the DP modeling approach facilitates faster simulation of large-scale systems. The generalized framework is validated with EMTDC/PSCAD simulations using the IEEE first benchmark model for subsynchronous resonance and the modified IEEE 4-machine system. Several use cases are presented on the modified IEEE 68-bus system with two GFL IBRs to show the applicability of the framework. First, time- and frequency-domain analyses of the IBR-induced SSO mode are presented. Then, two solutions are proposed to damp the poorly damped SSO mode: (a) a decentralized controller is designed using particle swarm optimization, and (b) the control of one GFL IBR is replaced by GFM control. Finally, the impact of AI DC load on primary frequency response of the system and the multi-mass turbines of the SGs are studied.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于含IBR和大型负载的多机系统次同步振荡分析的动态相量框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于动态相量的高效分析框架，解决了大规模电力系统次同步振荡分析中的计算效率问题，并支持对包含逆变器和大型负载的系统进行稳定性评估与控制设计。
AI.motivation: 传统的电磁暂态（EMT）仿真方法在分析大规模电力系统次同步振荡时存在扩展性差、计算负担重的问题。
AI.method: 建立了一套广义动态相量（DP）框架，其中IBR采用dq轴DP建模，同步发电机组、输电网及负载采用pnz轴DP建模；利用线性化和时不变特性进行特征值分析，并结合粒子群优化设计阻尼控制器。
AI.result: 通过IEEE基准模型及IEEE 68节点系统验证，该框架在保持与EMT仿真高度一致精度的同时，显著提高了大规模系统分析的计算速度，并成功应用于SSO模式的根因分析及阻尼控制策略评估。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的广义动态相量框架为大规模多机电力系统的次同步振荡分析提供了一种高效、精确且可扩展的方案，能够有效指导阻尼控制器的设计和系统稳定性评估。
AI.translation: 尽管电磁暂态（EMT）框架能够捕捉次同步振荡（SSO），但它在大规模系统中面临可扩展性问题。受此启发，我们提出了一种广义动态相量（DP）框架，用于分析在平衡和不平衡条件下，包含逆变器资源（IBR）和大型负载（如人工智能数据中心）的多机系统中的SSO。跟网型（GFL）和构网型（GFM）IBR分别在各自的dq轴DP中建模。相比之下，多质量块汽轮机驱动的同步发电机（SG）的详细模型以及动态输电网络模型和负载则在pnz轴DP中表示。该框架的线性化和时不变特性使我们能够进行特征值分解，这是进行SSO模式根因分析和阻尼控制器设计的有力工具。此外，DP建模方法促进了大规模系统的快速仿真。该广义框架通过使用IEEE次同步谐振第一基准模型和修改后的IEEE 4机系统进行了EMTDC/PSCAD仿真验证。文中还展示了在包含两个GFL IBR的修改版IEEE 68节点系统上的多个用例，以证明该框架的适用性。首先，给出了IBR引起的SSO模式的时域和频域分析。然后，提出了两种阻尼低阻尼SSO模式的解决方案：（a）使用粒子群优化设计分散控制器；（b）将一个GFL IBR的控制替换为GFM控制。最后，研究了AI数据中心负载对系统一次频率响应和SG多质量块汽轮机的影响。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种广义动态相量（DP）框架，用于分析包含逆变器资源（IBR）和AI数据中心等大规模多机电力系统中的次同步振荡（SSO）。该方法通过对不同组件采用特定坐标系的DP建模，实现了系统的线性化分析，不仅克服了EMT仿真在大规模系统中的计算瓶颈，还为SSO模式的根因识别和阻尼控制器设计提供了高效工具。
AI.keywords: 动态相量, 次同步振荡, 逆变器资源, 电力系统稳定性, AI数据中心
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种广义动态相量（DP）框架，有效地解决了大规模电力系统中次同步振荡（SSO）分析的计算效率问题，同时兼顾了包含逆变器资源（IBR）和AI数据中心等复杂负载系统的建模需求。其局限性在于未提及非线性因素对分析精度的影响。

title: Model Merging as Probabilistic Inference in Fine-Tuning Parameter Space
comments: Accepted for Publication at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI), 2026
summary: Model merging aims to combine existing single-task solutions into a multi-task solution without additional data-driven fine-tuning.~Most existing approaches achieve this using geometric properties of local solution spaces. However, such geometric views provide limited guidance for scoring how statistically useful each task-specific update direction is across tasks during merging. To address this, we formulate model merging from a new perspective of probabilistic inference under a product-of-experts (PoE) scenario where each single-task solution defines an energy-based expert model (EBM) over the merged parameters. We show that several existing model merging methods arise as special cases of our framework under energy designs that impose implicit Gaussian assumptions on directional residuals between merged and task-specific models. Empirically, we find that these residuals are often heavy-tailed which exposes a mismatch with the imposed light-tailed Gaussian structures. We address this with a heavy-tailed PoE design based on Cauchy experts, which better captures the observed residual behavior while admitting a provably convergent inference procedure. Experiments across multiple tasks and architectures show significant improvements over state-of-the-arts baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/MinhLong210/PoE-EBM-Merging.git.
comment: Accepted for Publication at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI), 2026

AI.title_translation: 模型合并作为微调参数空间中的概率推断
AI.tldr: 本文将模型合并重构为一种概率推断问题，通过引入柯西分布专家模型处理参数残留的重尾特性，实现了更优的模型融合效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的模型合并方法多基于局部解空间的几何属性，缺乏对任务特定更新方向统计有用性的量化评估，且未能很好地处理参数残留中的重尾现象。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于专家乘积（PoE）的概率推断框架，将模型合并视为在能量模型（EBM）下的参数优化。针对残留分布的重尾特性，引入了柯西专家模型，并推导出了相应的收敛推断算法。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在多个任务和架构上均显著优于现有的先进基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将模型合并建模为基于柯西专家的概率推断问题，该研究提供了一个更稳健的框架，有效解决了传统几何方法在处理重尾残留时的不足。
AI.translation: 模型合并旨在将现有的单任务解决方案组合成多任务解决方案，而无需额外的数据驱动微调。现有的大多数方法利用局部解空间的几何属性来实现这一点。然而，这种几何视角在评估合并过程中每个任务特定更新方向的统计有用性方面提供的指导有限。为了解决这个问题，我们从专家乘积（PoE）场景下的概率推断新视角出发，制定了模型合并方案，其中每个单任务解决方案都在合并参数上定义了一个能量模型（EBM）。我们证明，在对合并模型与任务特定模型之间的方向残差施加隐含高斯假设的能量设计下，几种现有的模型合并方法可以作为我们框架的特例出现。从经验上看，我们发现这些残差通常是重尾的，这暴露了与所施加的轻尾高斯结构之间的不匹配。我们通过基于柯西专家的重尾PoE设计解决了这个问题，该设计更好地捕捉了观察到的残差行为，同时采用了一种可证明收敛的推断过程。在多个任务和架构上的实验表明，该方法显著优于最先进的基准。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/MinhLong210/PoE-EBM-Merging.git 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将模型合并视为概率推断的新视角。通过将每个单任务模型视为专家乘积框架下的能量模型，作者发现现有方法隐含了高斯假设，但实际残留呈现重尾分布。为此，作者引入了柯西专家模型，实现了更准确的参数合并，并在实验中取得了优于现有技术的表现。
AI.keywords: 模型合并, 概率推断, 专家乘积模型, 柯西分布, 多任务学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过概率推断视角重新审视模型合并问题，这是一个深刻的理论创新。它不仅统一了现有方法，还通过识别现有方法中高斯假设与实际重尾分布之间的偏差，提出了基于柯西分布的改进方案，展现了良好的理论深度与实践效果。

title: Epistemic Goggles: A Pretrained Module that Induces an Epistemic Frame via Gradient Editing
comments: 20 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Code at https://github.com/JoshuaSP/epistemic-goggles and generated documents, questions, and teacher rollouts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/joshuapenman/epistemic-goggles-artifacts
summary: Finetuning a language model on documents that are explicitly annotated as fictional results in a model that still actually believes the documents' core claims, an effect known as Negation Neglect. In our evaluations, models trained on documents prefixed and suffixed with such annotations correctly identify the relevant claims as fictional only about 9% of the time. To address this, we introduce Goggles, a learned module that intervenes on the finetuning gradient rather than the data. During supervised finetuning, a Goggles module edits the gradients an LLM LoRA receives, imparting a chosen epistemic frame (the stance the model takes toward the nature of what it reads) to whatever the documents teach. A Goggles instance is trained once for a given base model, frame, and LoRA configuration, then applied frozen to documents it was never trained on. Trained through Goggles on those same documents, now carrying no fictional annotation, the model flags the content as fictional roughly 91% of the time, while preserving capability (GPQA and TruthfulQA match or exceed baseline). The same architecture supports other frames: a Goggles instance can be trained to treat documents as "part of an AI safety evaluation by Redwood Research" rather than simply as fiction. The imparted frame persists under continued finetuning that pushes back toward the claim, where prior interventions revert. Goggles suggests a path toward training language models on known-misaligned data without absorbing the behaviors that data demonstrates.
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Code at https://github.com/JoshuaSP/epistemic-goggles and generated documents, questions, and teacher rollouts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/joshuapenman/epistemic-goggles-artifacts

title: From Answer Generators to Reasoning Facilitators: Designing AI Tutors for Mathematical Reasoning in High-Stakes Environments
summary: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into educational technology threatens to reduce mathematical learning to mere answer generation. This paper presents a generative study, usability study, and 12-participant field deployment of AITutor, an interactive system that translates theoretical pedagogical mechanisms into concrete user interface features. We explore how junior-high students preparing for high-stakes exams (Zhongkao) interact with AI tutoring. Through mixed-methods triangulation (7,379 telemetry events, 8 contextual observations, 10 interviews), we reveal that students actively resist traditional Socratic dialogue under time pressure, repurposing "answer-first" shortcuts as vital diagnostic checkpoints. We demonstrate how features like layered worked examples, step-linked visual grounding, and metacognitive scaffolding lower the interaction cost of reasoning repair. We contribute a "Reasoning-Centered Product Loop," offering actionable implications for designing AI that structurally supports the inspection, local repair, curriculum verification, and delayed retrieval of mathematical reasoning in the wild.

title: A Mathematical Introduction to Diffusion Models
comments: Lecture notes for the John Tukey Summer Graduate School on Mathematics of Generative Models at SLMath (June 22nd, 2026 -- July 2nd, 2026)
summary: These notes give a proof-oriented introduction to diffusion models from the viewpoint of sampling, tracing a single arc from classical sampling dynamics to modern diffusion samplers, their error analysis, and inference-time control. Throughout, the material is layered into core definitions and identities proved in full, representative estimates proved under simplifying assumptions, and research-level theorems stated with a proof roadmap. The intended audience is beginning graduate students with a background in probability but no prior exposure to stochastic differential equations, stochastic numerics, or diffusion models.
comment: Lecture notes for the John Tukey Summer Graduate School on Mathematics of Generative Models at SLMath (June 22nd, 2026 -- July 2nd, 2026)

title: Frequency Shift Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machine for Solving High-Frequency Partial Differential Equations
summary: Solving partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-frequency solutions remains a central challenge in physics-informed machine learning due to spectral bias -- the tendency of neural networks to learn low-frequency components preferentially. This paper proposes a Frequency Shift Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machine (FS-PIELM) framework that addresses this limitation through an additive mechanism for weight initialization. Rather than multiplying random weights by a scaling factor, the method translates the mean of the Gaussian weight distribution while keeping the variance fixed at unity, thereby avoiding the variance amplification inherent in scaling-based methods. Two variants are developed: FS-PIELM-L assigns independent frequency magnitudes to individual neurons, while FS-PIELM-G groups neurons for improved robustness. Theoretical analysis shows that the frequency variance under the proposed framework remains bounded and approaches unity regardless of target frequency, in contrast to the quadratic growth of conventional approaches. The method preserves the computational efficiency of extreme learning machines, requiring only a single linear solve. Experiments on seven benchmark problems spanning six equation types -- Helmholtz, wave, Poisson, Klein-Gordon, heat, and advection-diffusion -- on both regular and complex geometries show that the linear variant achieves the best accuracy in six of seven cases, with improvements of one to nearly five orders of magnitude over existing PIELM variants. The code and data accompanying this manuscript will be made publicly available at https://github.com/xgxgnpu/Physics-informed-vibe-coding/tree/main/FS-PIELM.

title: Structure-Preserving Reduced-Order Modeling via Low-Rank Transport Signatures
summary: Parametrized PDEs with density-valued solutions are often difficult to approximate with classical linear reduced-order models, especially in transport-dominated regimes. We introduce an optimal-transport-based reduced-order modeling that represents each density by the Kantorovich potential transporting a fixed reference density to the target density, and then maps these potentials to transport signatures using a weighted Laplacian associated with the reference measure. This embeds the density-valued solution map in a Hilbert space while preserving control of the induced transport maps and Wasserstein error. We treat the signature map as a continuous matrix indexed by parameters and space, construct a low-rank skeleton decomposition using a maximal-volume criterion, and learn the parameter-to-coefficient map with a neural network for efficient non-intrusive online evaluation. The reconstructed solution is obtained by pushing forward the reference density, so mass preservation is built into the method. We prove a mean-squared Wasserstein error bound separating low-rank approximation, discretization, sampling, and learning errors, and demonstrate the method on a two-dimensional continuity equation, where transport signatures yield substantially lower-rank structure than the original density snapshots.

AI.title_translation: 基于低秩输运特征的保结构降阶建模
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于最优输运的保结构降阶建模方法，通过将密度值解转化为拉普拉斯加权的“输运特征”并进行低秩骨架分解与神经网络学习，在保证质量守恒的前提下，高效解决了对流占导参数化偏微分方程的逼近难题。
AI.motivation: 在对流占导的区域中，具有密度值解的参数化偏微分方程（PDEs）通常很难用经典的线性降阶模型（ROMs）进行有效逼近。
AI.method:
提出一种基于最优输运的保结构降阶建模方法，其步骤包括：
1. 使用将固定参考密度输送到目标密度的 Kantorovich 势来表示每个密度值解；
2. 利用与参考测度相关的加权拉普拉斯算子将这些势映射为“输运特征”，从而将解嵌入到希尔伯特空间中，并保持对 Wasserstein 误差的控制；
3. 将特征映射视为由参数和空间索引的连续矩阵，利用最大体积准则构建低秩骨架分解；
4. 使用神经网络学习参数到系数的映射，以进行高效的非侵入式在线评估；
5. 通过前推参考密度来重构解，从而在方法中天然内置质量守恒性。
AI.result:
1. 证明了一个均方 Wasserstein 误差界，该界成功分离了低秩逼近误差、离散化误差、采样误差和学习误差；
2. 在二维连续性方程上进行了数值验证，结果表明，相比于原始的密度快照，所提出的输运特征能够产生显著更低的秩结构，从而实现了更高精度的逼近。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于最优输运的降阶建模方法，成功解决了传统线性降阶模型在处理对流占导、密度值解的参数化 PDE 时逼近困难的问题。该方法不仅在理论上给出了严格的均方 Wasserstein 误差界，而且在实际应用中天然保证了质量守恒，并在二维连续性方程中展现出比原始密度快照更优越的低秩结构和重构精度。
