AI.translation: 设 $G$ 是一个有限简单图。湮灭数 $a(G)$ 是独立数 $α(G)$ 的一个可高效计算的上界。我们为间隙 $a(G)-α(G)$ 发展了一个精确的匹配数理论。最强的通用定理是精确的闭合形式 $a(G)-α(G)\leq 2μ(G)+1- \lceil \sqrt{6 μ(G)} \rceil \qquad(μ(G)\geq 1)$，并且该界限对于每个预设的匹配数均可达到。我们还证明了森林、二分图和König-Egerváry图的精确匹配相关界限，并提供了等式构造、等式证明和等式判据。最后，我们将TxGraffiti的输出作为一个机器猜想案例研究。利用湮灭分解和经典的Havel-Hakimi残差不等式 $res(G)\leq α(G)$，我们独立证明了TxGraffiti湮灭-残差不等式 $α(G)\geq \frac{a(G)+res(G)}{Δ(G)}$，适用于每个阶数至少为三的连通图 $G$，并表明两个假设都是必要的，并将此证明与最近的Caro-Wei方法进行了比较。我们还通过一个显式非负松弛项改进了Caro-Wei湮灭估计，确定了其在度序列形式下的等式情况，并将该改进与我们的精确匹配数界限结合，以获得独立数的一个组合可计算区间和湮灭间隙的Gupta残差界限。
AI.summary: 本文关注图的湮灭数 $a(G)$ 和独立数 $α(G)$ 之间的间隙 $a(G)-α(G)$。作者发展了一个精确的匹配数理论，给出了间隙的精确闭合形式，并为特定图类（如森林、二分图）提供了锐利的匹配相关界限。此外，论文独立证明了TxGraffiti湮灭-残差不等式，并改进了Caro-Wei湮灭估计，从而为独立数提供了更紧密的计算界限和新的理论工具。
AI.keywords: 湮灭数, 独立数, 匹配数, TxGraffiti, 残差不等式
AI.comments: 本文的主要创新在于为湮灭数与独立数之间的间隙提供了精确的匹配数界限，并通过数学推导给出了具体的闭合形式。此外，对TxGraffiti机器猜想的独立证明以及对Caro-Wei估计的改进，都展现了理论图论研究的深度和广度，为图的独立数估计提供了新的视角和工具。

title: Sampling for Region-Aggregated Spatial Scan Statistics
summary: Anomaly detection in geospatial data is a crucial tool in geographic information science (GIS), with applications ranging from national security to public-health surveillance to the study of societal disparities. This work focuses on spatial scan statistics and addresses a key mismatch: spatial counts are typically aggregated into predefined regions (census tracts, zip codes, counties), whereas the most efficient scan algorithms operate on spatial point data. The standard remedy -- collapsing each region to its centroid, as in widely used tools such as SaTScan -- is convenient but, as we show, discards the region's spatial extent and causes a significant loss in statistical power. To resolve this, we propose a simple yet scalable fix: replace each spatial region with 20-50 points sampled uniformly from its geometry and spread the region's values evenly across them. This approach improves statistical power while maintaining computational tractability. A convergence analysis explains why so few samples per region suffice. We recommend this sampling-based conversion as the default way to apply point-based spatial scan statistics to region-aggregated data for anomaly detection.

AI.title_translation: 区域聚合空间扫描统计抽样
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种简单可扩展的方法，通过将区域替换为其几何形状中均匀采样的20-50个点，并将区域值均匀分布到这些点上，以提高区域聚合空间扫描统计的统计功效，同时保持计算可行性。
AI.motivation: 地理空间数据中的异常检测是地理信息科学（GIS）中的关键工具，但空间扫描统计存在一个关键不匹配：空间计数通常聚合到预定义的区域中，而最有效的扫描算法则在空间点数据上运行。标准方法（将每个区域折叠到其质心）会丢失区域的空间范围并导致统计功效显著损失。
AI.method: 提出一种简单而可扩展的修复方法：用从每个空间区域几何形状中均匀采样的20-50个点替换该区域，并将区域的值均匀分布到这些点上。
AI.result: 这种方法提高了统计功效，同时保持了计算的可行性。收敛性分析解释了为什么每个区域只需少量样本就足够。
AI.conclusion: 推荐这种基于采样的转换作为将基于点的空间扫描统计应用于区域聚合数据进行异常检测的默认方式。
AI.translation: 地理空间数据中的异常检测是地理信息科学（GIS）中的一个关键工具，其应用范围从国家安全到公共卫生监测，再到社会差异研究。这项工作侧重于空间扫描统计，并解决了一个关键的不匹配问题：空间计数通常被聚合到预定义的区域（人口普查区、邮政编码、县），而最有效的扫描算法则在空间点数据上运行。标准的补救措施——将每个区域折叠到其质心，如SaTScan等广泛使用的工具所示——虽然方便，但正如我们所示，它会丢弃区域的空间范围并导致统计功效的显著损失。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种简单但可扩展的解决方案：用从其几何形状中均匀采样的20-50个点替换每个空间区域，并将区域的值均匀地分布到这些点上。这种方法在保持计算可行性的同时提高了统计功效。收敛性分析解释了为什么每个区域只需少量样本就足够。我们建议将这种基于采样的转换作为将基于点的空间扫描统计应用于区域聚合数据进行异常检测的默认方式。
AI.summary: 本文针对地理空间数据中区域聚合空间扫描统计的异常检测问题，指出现有方法将区域简化为质心会导致统计功效损失。为解决此问题，提出了一种创新性的采样方法：将每个空间区域替换为从其几何形状中均匀采样的20-50个点，并将区域值均匀分配给这些点。实验证明，该方法能显著提升统计功效，同时保持计算效率。研究建议将此采样转换作为处理区域聚合数据的点基空间扫描统计的默认方法。
AI.keywords: 异常检测, 地理空间数据, 空间扫描统计, 区域聚合数据, 采样
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种解决空间扫描统计中区域数据与点数据不匹配问题的创新且实用的方法。通过引入少量采样点来表示区域，有效克服了传统质心方法的局限性，显著提高了统计功效。收敛性分析也为此方法的有效性提供了理论支持，使其在实际应用中更具说服力。这是一个对地理信息科学领域异常检测工具的重大改进。

title: A quantum model of opinion dynamics on networks
summary: Classical models of opinion dynamics represent individual opinions as scalar or vector values governed by the classical probability theory, either as deterministic quantities or random variables. This framework does not account for empirically observed phenomena such as cognitive ambivalence (where an individual simultaneously holds conflicting views) and order effects (where survey responses depend on the order in which questions are asked). We propose a quantum model of opinion dynamics in which each agent's cognitive state is represented by a density matrix that encodes both the expressed opinion and cognitive ambivalence. Survey questions become non-commuting self-adjoint operators, which provides a principled explanation for order effects. Our model also identifies quantities without classical counterparts, including quantum coherence and pairwise opinion covariances. Under a product state approximation, the quantum model reduces to the classical Friedkin--Johnsen opinion model. We test the framework on synthetic and real-world networks and observe that pairwise correlations follow network-dependent transient dynamics but converge to the same steady state regardless of the network, and that quantum coherence decays exponentially at a rate independent of the network.

title: Boundary-Aware Quantization: Finite-Scale Decision Geometry of Neural Classifiers
summary: We measured quantization-induced decision-boundary changes using local logit-margin radii, first-order boundary displacement, normal variation, slice-boundary Jaccard distance, grid prediction changes, multiclass junction counts, and low-margin boundary-band flips. On the digits benchmark, 8-bit weight quantization preserved all test labels while producing boundary-mask Jaccard \(0.428\) on the PCA slice; at 4 bits, accuracy remained \(0.9733\), while boundary Jaccard rose to \(0.970\) and median local boundary shift reached \(0.0290\). Interpolation between adjacent quantization levels localized the visible reconfigurations at multiclass junctions, with 12, 34, and 17 triple-junction cells in the selected transitions. Calibration-to-test stopping reduced the digits held-out flip rate from \(0.0094\) to \(0.0022\) and boundary Jaccard from \(0.825\) to \(0.524\); the same stopping rule also reduced flips on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST. On official CIFAR-10 subsets, PTQ-W selected by accuracy gave 6-bit flip \(0.0367\) and boundary Jaccard \(0.184\), whereas boundary-aware stopping selected 8-bit flip \(0.0083\) and boundary Jaccard \(0.048\). On full CIFAR-10 with three seeds, 6-bit PTQ-W lost \(0.0029\) accuracy relative to float, changed \(5.3\%\) of held-out decisions, and changed \(24.5\%\) of low-margin boundary-band decisions. A fixed-bit boundary-gap rounding term changed the trade-off at 4 bits by reducing boundary Jaccard from \(0.457\) to \(0.435\) and boundary-band pair-order flip from \(0.3600\) to \(0.3558\), with an accuracy trade-off; the 3-bit stress test exposed the tuning limit of this surrogate. Calibration boundary Jaccard predicted held-out boundary Jaccard across PTQ-W and optimized rounding variants with \(r=0.947\)--\(0.994\).

title: Mean Field Reinforcement Learning
summary: This monograph provides an introduction to mean field reinforcement learning through the lens of Markov decision processes arising from large-population stochastic control with mean field interactions and common noise. Starting from the connection between multi-agent reinforcement learning and mean field control, it develops the probabilistic, mathematical, and control-theoretic framework needed to formulate representative-agent learning problems, analyze their relationship with finite-population systems, and study both general and linear-quadratic models. The presentation includes dynamic programming principles, propagation-of-chaos limits, and theoretical analyses of tabular Q-learning and policy-gradient methods. It also discusses numerical implementations, including tabular schemes and deep reinforcement learning methods such as deep deterministic policy gradient. The goal is to give readers a coherent bridge between mean field control theory and reinforcement learning methodology, emphasizing the mathematical structure of the problems and the design of tractable learning approaches for large stochastic populations.

AI.tldr: 本文系统阐述了平均场强化学习的数学框架，通过代表性智能体方法解决了大规模多智能体系统中的学习与控制难题。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决大规模群体交互中的随机控制问题，通过建立平均场控制理论与强化学习方法之间的桥梁，为处理复杂多智能体系统提供易于处理的学习框架。
AI.method: 基于马尔可夫决策过程，结合平均场控制理论与多智能体强化学习；利用动态规划原理、混沌传播极限（propagation-of-chaos）分析；研究了表格型Q学习、策略梯度方法以及深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）等算法。
AI.result: 构建了平均场强化学习的概率与控制理论框架；推导了代表性智能体学习问题的公式；分析了表格型Q学习和策略梯度方法的理论特性；并提出了适用于大规模随机群体的数值实现方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过建立平均场强化学习的数学基础，证明了利用代表性智能体方法解决大规模群体控制问题的可行性，并为该领域的理论分析与数值实现提供了连贯的指导。
AI.translation: 本专著通过具有平均场相互作用和共同噪声的大规模群体随机控制所产生的马尔可夫决策过程，对平均场强化学习进行了介绍。从多智能体强化学习与平均场控制之间的联系出发，发展了构建代表性智能体学习问题所需的概率、数学和控制理论框架，分析了它们与有限群体系统的关系，并研究了通用模型和线性二次模型。内容涵盖了动态规划原理、混沌传播极限，以及对表格型Q学习和策略梯度方法的理论分析。书中还讨论了数值实现，包括表格方案和深度强化学习方法（如深度确定性策略梯度）。其目标是为读者在平均场控制理论与强化学习方法论之间架起一座连贯的桥梁，强调问题的数学结构以及针对大规模随机群体设计易于处理的学习方法。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了平均场强化学习，通过马尔可夫决策过程模型化大规模群体交互与共同噪声。书中构建了从平均场控制到强化学习的理论桥梁，涵盖了动态规划、混沌传播极限、表格型及深度学习算法，旨在为大规模随机系统的控制与学习提供系统性的数学框架。
AI.keywords: 平均场强化学习, 多智能体系统, 马尔可夫决策过程, 随机控制, 深度强化学习
AI.comments: 该专著成功地将平均场控制理论与强化学习方法论相结合，为处理大规模随机群体决策问题提供了严谨的数学框架。其创新之处在于从理论层面系统性地分析了代表性智能体学习与有限群体系统之间的关系，对于理解多智能体强化学习的收敛性和扩展性具有重要参考价值。

title: An Information-Theoretic Principle for Optimal Quantum Encoding: Tight Frames and Equiangular Ensembles
comments: Considerable expansion of arXiv:2404.08172 with an additional author
summary: Optimal encoding of classical data for quantum-assisted statistical inference is investigated from an information-theoretic perspective. We prove that the accuracy of any quantum-computing inference procedure is upper bounded by the maximal quantum leakage from the classical data through its quantum encoding, establishing leakage as a universal, task-agnostic quality measure for encoders. This demonstrates that the maximal quantum leakage is a universal measure of the quality of the encoding strategy for statistical inference as it only depends on the quantum encoding of the data and not the inference task itself. The optimal universal encoding strategy, i.e., an encoding strategy that maximizes the maximal quantum leakage, is proved to be attained by pure states. When there are enough qubits, basis encoding is proved to be universally optimal. However, when the dimension of the system is small, phase encoding is optimal. For the latter, any tight frame, any ensemble whose average state is the maximally mixed state, is in fact optimal. Within tight frames, equiangular tight frames (ETFs) are distinguished as the uniquely symmetric optimal encodings, i.e., they saturate the Welch lower bound on pairwise overlaps and possess a self-referential optimal measurement. Prominent special cases are the qubit trine, the regular simplex, and symmetric informationally complete positive operator-valued measures (SIC-POVMs), for which the ETF structure and explicit codeword constructions are provided. Numerical examples are presented to validate the theoretical predictions.
comment: Considerable expansion of arXiv:2404.08172 with an additional author

title: Comparative analysis of resistive immersed surface and immersed boundary methods for aortic valve simulation
summary: Numerical modeling of aortic valve dynamics is essential for understanding the complex fluid-structure interaction (FSI) governing valve biomechanics in health and disease. Immersed methods provide a flexible computational framework for simulating the large deformations of valve leaflets and associated blood flow without requiring body-fitted meshes. Among these approaches, the Resistive Immersed Surface (RIS) and Immersed Boundary (IB) methods are widely used. However, systematic comparative analysis of these methods for realistic aortic valve simulations has not been performed. In this work, we compare a prescribed-kinematics RIS workflow implemented in SimVascular's svMultiPhysics solver with a fully coupled IB workflow using IBAMR for trileaflet and bicuspid aortic valve configurations. The RIS method represents the valve as a surface with prescribed kinematics embedded in the fluid domain and introduces a penalty force that drives the surrounding fluid velocity toward the prescribed leaflet velocity. This formulation reduces modeling complexity and provides useful hemodynamic predictions when representative leaflet kinematics are available. In contrast, the IB method models the leaflets as elastic structures fully immersed in the fluid domain and resolves leaflet deformation through fully coupled two-way FSI. The study focuses on the extent to which RIS reproduces bulk hemodynamic features and transvalvular pressure gradients. Results show that the RIS method captures the large-scale flow structures and predicts the mean transvalvular pressure gradient with a relative error within 15% of the fully coupled IB simulation, improving to within 5% when inlet boundary conditions are matched, while reducing computational cost by approximately 60%.

title: Quantum-Inspired Vision: Leveraging Wave-Particle Duality for Low-Illumination Enhancement
summary: This study provides a theoretical expansion of the recent Data Relativistic Uncertainty (DRU) framework by formalizing a physics-to-AI paradigm for image enhancement. By modeling images as probabilistic wave functions rather than deterministic states, the paradigm explicitly integrates wave-particle duality to illustrate the system flow of how DRU leverages the intrinsic physical uncertainty of light, a dimension requiring further theoretical discussion. Consequently, this paradigm provides a rigorous Explainable AI (XAI) approach that enhances the interpretability of how DRU mitigates illumination bias and maintains robustness against data noise.

title: Full Bayesian Reinforcement Learning via LF-IBIS
summary:
Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a sequential decision-making framework in which an agent learns optimal policies through interaction with an environment by maximizing cumulative rewards. Among RL methods, Bayesian Reinforcement Learning (BRL) addresses common practical challenges related to data scarcity by leveraging prior knowledge about the environment and sequential belief updates. However, most BRL approaches require an explicit likelihood function, which is frequently inaccessible or intractable in real-world settings.
  We propose Likelihood-Free Iterated Batch Importance Sampling (LF-IBIS), a novel algorithm for BRL that updates the agent's beliefs online as new interactions become available. By combining Approximate Bayesian Computation with Iterated Batch Importance Sampling, LF-IBIS enables full Bayesian inference in settings where the environment dynamics are not described by an explicit or tractable likelihood. The method yields approximate posterior distributions over both environment parameters and optimal policies, providing a quantification of policy uncertainty useful for a Bayesian treatment of the exploration-exploitation trade-off. We test the method on a simulation study in response-adaptive randomization in clinical trials, where closed-form posteriors enable validation. Additional experiments address settings where the posterior has no closed form and illustrate online policy updating based on the posterior distribution of the optimal policy.

AI.title_translation: 基于LF-IBIS的完全贝叶斯强化学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为LF-IBIS的无似然贝叶斯强化学习算法，能够在缺乏显式似然函数的情况下进行在线策略更新和不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 现有的贝叶斯强化学习方法通常依赖于显式似然函数，但在许多实际场景中，该函数往往难以获取或计算复杂，限制了贝叶斯方法的应用。
AI.method: 提出了LF-IBIS（无似然迭代批处理重要性采样）算法，将近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）与迭代批处理重要性采样（IBIS）相结合，在环境动态无显式似然函数的情况下实现在线信念更新。
AI.result: 通过临床试验响应自适应随机化模拟实验验证了该方法的有效性，并展示了在无闭式解的情况下进行在线策略更新的能力，能够有效量化策略不确定性。
AI.conclusion: LF-IBIS 是一种有效的无似然贝叶斯强化学习算法，能够处理复杂环境下的策略更新与不确定性量化，为无法获得显式似然函数的场景提供了可靠的解决方案。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）是一种通过与环境交互并最大化累积奖励来学习最优策略的序贯决策框架。在RL方法中，贝叶斯强化学习（BRL）通过利用环境先验知识和序贯信念更新，解决了与数据稀缺相关的常见实际挑战。然而，大多数BRL方法都需要显式的似然函数，这在现实世界中往往是不可获取或难以计算的。我们提出了无似然迭代批处理重要性采样（LF-IBIS），这是一种用于BRL的新型算法，随着新交互的可用，它能在线更新智能体的信念。通过将近似贝叶斯计算与迭代批处理重要性采样相结合，LF-IBIS在环境动态无法通过显式或易处理的似然函数描述的情况下实现了完全贝叶斯推理。该方法产生了环境参数和最优策略的近似后验分布，为探索-利用权衡的贝叶斯处理提供了有用的策略不确定性量化。我们在临床试验中响应自适应随机化的模拟研究中测试了该方法，其中闭式后验解能够验证其有效性。额外的实验涵盖了后验无闭式解的场景，并展示了基于最优策略后验分布的在线策略更新。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LF-IBIS的新型贝叶斯强化学习算法。该算法结合了近似贝叶斯计算与迭代批处理重要性采样，通过在线更新信念，解决了在缺乏显式似然函数环境下的完全贝叶斯推理问题，并能有效量化策略不确定性以优化探索与利用的平衡。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯强化学习, 无似然推理, 迭代批处理重要性采样, 策略不确定性, 近似贝叶斯计算
AI.comments: 该研究通过结合近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）与迭代批处理重要性采样（IBIS），成功解决了贝叶斯强化学习中似然函数难以获取的瓶颈。其创新点在于实现了无似然函数的在线贝叶斯推理，并能有效量化策略不确定性，对于处理数据稀缺及环境复杂的真实场景具有重要意义。

title: Decentralized Stochastic Subgradient-type Methods with Communication Compression for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization
summary: In this paper, we consider the nonsmooth nonconvex decentralized optimization problem, where inter-agent communication is compressed. We propose a general framework that unifies various decentralized stochastic subgradient-type methods with unbiased compression and contractive compression with error compensation. By relating the consensus-error iterates and the averaged iterates to the trajectories of continuous-time differential inclusions, we establish global convergence for all methods encompassed by our framework when the objective functions are nonsmooth and lack Clarke regularity. Based on our framework, we further develop several compression-based methods, including decentralized stochastic subgradient methods utilizing sign-based regularization and gradient-tracking momentum. Preliminary numerical experiments empirically support our theoretical results and highlight the communication-accuracy trade-off of the newly developed methods.

AI.title_translation: 具有通信压缩的非光滑非凸优化去中心化随机次梯度法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的去中心化优化框架，通过支持多种通信压缩技术，实现了在非光滑非凸环境下高效且具有收敛保证的分布式计算。
AI.motivation: 在去中心化优化中，通信带宽往往成为瓶颈。现有的通信压缩方法在处理非光滑、非凸目标函数时，缺乏统一的理论框架和收敛性保证。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一的去中心化随机次梯度法框架，兼容无偏压缩和带误差补偿的收缩压缩；利用连续时间微分包含技术分析共识误差和平均迭代轨迹，从而证明了全局收敛性。
AI.result: 在非光滑且缺乏Clarke正则性的目标函数下，证明了框架内所有算法的全局收敛性；开发了包含基于符号的正则化和梯度跟踪动量的新方法，并通过实验验证了其性能。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立的统一框架成功实现了在通信受限环境下对非光滑、非凸去中心化优化问题的收敛性保证，并通过实验验证了通信效率与算法精度之间的权衡关系。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们考虑了在代理间通信受限情况下的非光滑非凸去中心化优化问题。我们提出了一个通用框架，统一了各种具有无偏压缩和带误差补偿的收缩压缩的去中心化随机次梯度法。通过将共识误差迭代和平均迭代与连续时间微分包含的轨迹联系起来，我们为框架所涵盖的所有方法在目标函数非光滑且缺乏Clarke正则性的情况下建立了全局收敛性。基于我们的框架，我们进一步开发了几种基于压缩的方法，包括利用基于符号的正则化和梯度跟踪动量的去中心化随机次梯度法。初步的数值实验从经验上支持了我们的理论结果，并突出了新开发方法的通信-精度权衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种统一的去中心化随机次梯度法框架，旨在解决通信受限下的非光滑非凸优化问题。该框架涵盖了多种压缩策略（无偏及收缩压缩），并利用微分包含理论证明了其在更广泛函数类下的全局收敛性。实验结果验证了新方法在通信效率与精度之间的有效权衡。
AI.keywords: 去中心化优化, 非光滑非凸, 通信压缩, 随机次梯度法, 误差补偿
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于建立了一个统一的框架，能够处理非光滑、非凸的去中心化优化问题，并同时支持无偏压缩和带误差补偿的收缩压缩。通过引入连续时间微分包含（differential inclusions）的分析技术，成功处理了缺乏Clarke正则性的复杂情况，这在理论上具有重要意义。

title: Scene-Conditioned PINN-GNN for Multipath RF Maps: Cross-Scene Generation and In-Scene Completion
summary: Radio frequency (RF) maps provide a compact representation of multipath propagation characteristics and are fundamental to channel modeling, coverage analysis, and environment-aware wireless optimization. This paper proposes a unified RF map construction framework based on a physics-informed neural network (PINN) and a graph neural network (GNN), supporting both cross-scene generation and in-scene completion with 2D and 2.5D environmental representations. The PINN embeds electromagnetic propagation constraints to establish a physically consistent mapping from receiver locations to multipath parameters, including path gain, time of arrival, and angles, while the GNN enforces spatial consistency by modeling correlations among neighboring receivers. To comprehensively evaluate multipath reconstruction quality, we propose a peak-weighted dynamic time warping metric that jointly accounts for amplitude errors and peak delay misalignment in channel impulse responses. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms image-based, diffusion-based, and interpolation baselines across both map-level and multipath-level metrics, achieving robust generalization and high-fidelity RF map construction under sparse observations.

AI.title_translation: 面向多径射频地图的场景条件PINN-GNN：跨场景生成与场景内补全
AI.tldr: 本文结合物理约束神经网络（PINN）与图神经网络（GNN），提出了一种在稀疏观测下进行高保真射频地图构建与多径参数重构的新方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的射频地图构建方法在稀疏观测下难以同时保证物理一致性和空间相关性，且缺乏针对多径传播特性（如路径增益、到达时间和角度）的有效重构与评估手段。
AI.method: 构建了一个结合PINN与GNN的统一框架。PINN利用电磁传播约束建立接收位置到多径参数的物理映射；GNN通过建模邻近接收器间的相关性来增强空间一致性；同时引入了峰值加权动态时间规整（PW-DTW）指标来评估多径重构质量。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在地图级和多径级指标上均优于基于图像、扩散模型和插值的基准方法，在稀疏观测条件下实现了鲁棒且高保真的射频地图构建。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的PINN-GNN框架能够有效利用物理约束与空间相关性，在跨场景生成和场景内补全任务中均表现优异，为射频环境建模提供了鲁棒且高保真的解决方案。
AI.translation: 射频（RF）地图提供了多径传播特性的紧凑表示，是信道建模、覆盖分析和环境感知无线优化的基础。本文提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）和图神经网络（GNN）的统一射频地图构建框架，支持2D和2.5D环境表示下的跨场景生成与场景内补全。PINN嵌入了电磁传播约束，建立了从接收器位置到多径参数（包括路径增益、到达时间和角度）的物理一致性映射；GNN通过建模邻近接收器之间的相关性来强制执行空间一致性。为了全面评估多径重构质量，我们提出了一种峰值加权动态时间规整指标，该指标综合考虑了信道脉冲响应中的幅度误差和峰值延迟错位。大量实验表明，该方法在地图级和多径级指标上均优于基于图像、扩散模型和插值的基准，在稀疏观测下实现了鲁棒且高保真的射频地图构建。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种融合物理信息神经网络（PINN）与图神经网络（GNN）的射频地图构建框架，支持2D/2.5D环境下的跨场景生成与场景内补全。该模型通过PINN引入电磁传播物理约束，利用GNN增强空间一致性，并采用新型峰值加权动态时间规整指标进行评估，显著提升了稀疏数据下的地图重构精度。
AI.keywords: 射频地图, 物理信息神经网络, 图神经网络, 多径传播, 跨场景生成
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了PINN的物理约束与GNN的空间关联建模能力，解决了射频地图构建中稀疏观测下的高保真重建问题。其提出的针对多径特性的评估指标具有较强的针对性，是一个结合物理先验与深度学习的优秀范例。

title: $r$-deformed $α$-$z$-Rényi relative entropy
summary: In this article, we consider the $r$-logarithm for defining three-parameter family of Rényi relative entropies that are generalization of the $α$-$z$-Rényi relative entropies. All the members of $r$-deformed $α$-$z$-Rényi relative entropies satisfy the necessary axioms to be a divergence. We expose the range of parameters $α$, $z$ and $r$ for which the data processing inequality holds. We also establish that $r$-deformed $α$-$z$-Rényi relative entropy is an upper bound of the Tsallis relative entropy. Now, we have two upper bounds of the Tsallis relative entropy, which are $r$-deformed $α$-$z$-Rényi relative entropy and the other one, which is discussed in literature. We investigate the order relationship between these two upper bounds of the Tsallis relative entropy. We observe that our new upper bound is more tighter when applicable to the density operators.

title: Self-Supervised Test-Time Tuning for Packet Loss Concealment
summary:
Packet loss concealment (PLC) reconstructs audio packets that are missing at the receiver, usually with a trained model whose parameters remain fixed at deployment time. This treats the PLC model as static, even though each call or recording exposes signal-specific information through the packets that did arrive. We present TTT-PLC, a self-supervised test-time tuning framework that adapts existing PLC models using only those received packets. The method creates supervision by synthetically masking portions of the available signal, training the model to conceal them with its native PLC objective, and then using the adapted model to reconstruct the true packet losses. No clean reference signal, external adaptation data, or architectural modification is required.
  We study TTT-PLC in two deployment settings. In the non-causal setting, the received file is available before reconstruction, allowing repeated self-supervised adaptation passes and providing a per-file adaptation ceiling. In the causal setting, audio is streamed without revising emitted samples; adaptation is performed only on completed past blocks, and updated parameters affect only future audio. We instantiate the framework on two public PLC backbones, FRN, a recurrent full-band speech PLC model, and PARCnet, a hybrid autoregressive-neural model for networked music. Across these settings, the results show that pretrained PLC systems do not need to be treated as fixed at inference time, the still-observed portions of a lossy signal can provide an effective training signal for improving concealment on that same signal.

AI.title_translation: 用于数据包丢失隐藏的自监督测试时训练
AI.tldr: TTT-PLC 允许音频重构模型在推理时通过自监督学习“边听边学”，利用已接收到的音频信息实时优化自身，从而显著提升对丢失数据包的恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的 PLC 模型在部署后通常保持参数固定，忽略了每个通话或录音中已到达的数据包所包含的特定信号信息。
AI.method: 提出 TTT-PLC 框架，通过合成掩码部分可用信号，利用原生的 PLC 目标函数对模型进行自监督微调，从而适应当前的信号特征。支持非因果（离线）和因果（实时流式）两种部署设置。
AI.result: 在 FRN 和 PARCnet 两个主流 PLC 模型上的实验表明，TTT-PLC 能够利用信号本身的信息有效提升丢包隐藏的重构效果，无需外部数据或架构修改。
AI.conclusion: TTT-PLC 证明了预训练的 PLC 模型无需在推理时保持固定，通过利用信号本身进行自监督学习，能够显著提升在不同丢包场景下的重构质量。
AI.translation: 数据包丢失隐藏（PLC）负责重构接收端丢失的音频数据包，通常使用在部署时参数固定的预训练模型。尽管每个通话或录音通过已到达的数据包暴露了特定的信号信息，但传统方法仍将 PLC 模型视为静态的。我们提出了 TTT-PLC，这是一个自监督测试时训练框架，仅使用接收到的数据包来调整现有的 PLC 模型。该方法通过合成掩码部分可用信号来创建监督，训练模型使用其原生的 PLC 目标来隐藏这些部分，然后使用调整后的模型来重构真实的丢包。该方法不需要纯净参考信号、外部适配数据或架构修改。我们在两种部署设置中研究了 TTT-PLC。在非因果设置中，可以在重构前获取接收文件，允许进行重复的自监督适配，并提供每文件的适配上限。在因果设置中，音频流式传输且不修改已发出的样本；适配仅在完成的过去数据块上执行，更新后的参数仅影响未来的音频。我们将该框架实例化在两个公共 PLC 主干模型上：FRN（一种递归全频带语音 PLC 模型）和 PARCnet（一种用于网络音乐的混合自回归神经模型）。在这些设置中的结果表明，预训练的 PLC 系统在推理时无需保持固定，丢失信号中仍被观察到的部分可以为改善同一信号的隐藏效果提供有效的训练信号。
AI.summary: TTT-PLC 是一种用于丢包隐藏的自监督测试时训练框架。它通过掩盖部分已接收信号来生成训练监督，从而在推理阶段动态调整 PLC 模型参数，以更好地处理当前信号的特定丢失情况，适用于离线和实时流式处理场景。
AI.keywords: 数据包丢失隐藏, 自监督学习, 测试时训练, 语音重建, 网络音频
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将“测试时训练（TTT）”引入数据包丢失隐藏（PLC）领域，打破了传统PLC模型部署后参数固定的范式。其核心价值在于利用接收到的已知信号进行自监督学习，实现对特定信号的个性化适配。限制在于其对计算资源的需求，尤其是在实时因果场景下的性能权衡。

title: Neural Audio Codec with Adjustable Token Temporal Resolution Using Sampling-Frequency-Independent Convolutional Layers
summary: Discrete tokens obtained from neural audio codecs (NACs) have been used as compact representations in audio generation and understanding models. In such token-based systems, token temporal resolution (TTR), defined as the time interval between adjacent token frames, is important because it controls the trade-off between representing rapid acoustic events and reducing token-sequence length. However, most NACs are trained at a single TTR and require separate training for each TTR. This paper proposes a mechanism that enables a single NAC to operate at multiple TTRs using sampling-frequency-independent convolutional layers. The mechanism regards TTR as the sampling period of the token sequence and generates TTR-dependent convolutional kernels from a shared parameter set, while adjusting the kernel size and stride for each TTR. We incorporate the mechanism into Descript Audio Codec, leaving the quantizer unchanged. Experiments on environmental sound reconstruction show that the proposed model outperforms a single-model baseline that switches TTR-specific layers for each TTR.

title: Statistical Properties of $k$-means Clustering for Data Missing Completely at Random
summary: The classical $k$-means clustering cannot be directly used to incomplete data, and existing $k$-means-based clustering for missing data primarily focus on improving the practical accuracy of clustering, whereas most of them lack theoretical guarantees in the asymptotic sense. In this paper, we investigate the statistical properties of $k$-means clustering in the presence of missing data. We first establish the $\sqrt{n}$-excess risk bound and prove the consistency of the estimated cluster centers under general missing mechanisms. For the Missing Completely at Random (MCAR) mechanism, we further derive the $\sqrt{n}$-convergence rate and asymptotic normality of the estimated cluster centers. Moreover, we study in what cases the cluster centers estimated by incomplete data converge to the true cluster centers of original fully observed data, and give a sufficient condition about the missing probability and the separation among true clusters. These results provide a theoretical guarantee for missing-data-$k$-means. Notably, our analysis reveal that under MCAR mechanism, both achieving the $\sqrt{n}$-rate and converging to the true cluster centers require $k$ true centers to be distinct in every dimension, highlighting the significant challenges of application in high-dimensional regimes. Finally, we conduct numerical simulations on synthetic incomplete datasets to support our theoretical analysis results.

AI.title_translation: 缺失完全随机数据下k-means聚类的统计性质
AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了缺失数据下k-means聚类的渐近性质，证明了MCAR机制下的收敛性与正态性，并指出了高维数据应用中的理论挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有的针对缺失数据的k-means聚类方法多侧重于实际准确性的提升，缺乏理论上的渐近保证。因此，本文旨在研究缺失数据下k-means聚类的统计性质。
AI.method: 通过数学推导建立了$\sqrt{n}$-超额风险界限，证明了估计聚类中心的一致性，推导了MCAR机制下的收敛速度和渐近正态性，并分析了缺失概率与聚类分离度之间的充分条件。
AI.result: 建立了$\sqrt{n}$-收敛速度，证明了估计量的渐近正态性；给出了估计中心收敛至真实中心的充分条件；揭示了在MCAR机制下，要求聚类中心在每一维度上均需区分，这在高维场景下具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在MCAR机制下，缺失数据k-means聚类具有理论上的渐近一致性和正态性，并指出在高维环境下实现收敛的苛刻条件，为该类算法提供了坚实的理论基础。
AI.translation: 经典的k-means聚类无法直接用于不完整数据，而现有的基于k-means的缺失数据聚类方法主要集中在提高聚类的实际准确性上，其中大多数缺乏渐近意义上的理论保证。在本文中，我们研究了缺失数据下k-means聚类的统计性质。我们首先建立了$\sqrt{n}$-超额风险界限，并证明了在一般缺失机制下估计聚类中心的一致性。对于缺失完全随机（MCAR）机制，我们进一步推导了估计聚类中心的$\sqrt{n}$-收敛速度和渐近正态性。此外，我们研究了在什么情况下由不完整数据估计的聚类中心会收敛到原始完全观测数据的真实聚类中心，并给出了关于缺失概率和真实聚类之间分离度的充分条件。这些结果为缺失数据k-means提供了理论保证。值得注意的是，我们的分析表明，在MCAR机制下，实现$\sqrt{n}$-收敛速度和收敛到真实聚类中心都需要$k$个真实中心在每个维度上都是不同的，这突显了在高维环境下应用的重大挑战。最后，我们对合成的不完整数据集进行了数值模拟，以支持我们的理论分析结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了缺失完全随机（MCAR）机制下k-means聚类的统计性质，推导了聚类中心估计的渐近收敛速度与正态性，并分析了其收敛至真实中心所需的理论条件，揭示了该方法在高维数据应用中的局限性。
AI.keywords: k-means聚类, 缺失数据, MCAR机制, 渐近正态性, 风险界限
AI.comments: 该论文填补了缺失数据下k-means聚类算法在理论保证方面的空白，特别是对MCAR机制下的渐近性质进行了严谨的推导。其创新点在于从数学上揭示了高维环境下聚类中心估计的挑战，为算法的实际应用提供了重要的理论约束条件。

title: Robust for the Wrong Reasons: The Representational Geometry of LLM Robustness to Science Skepticism
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly consulted on contested scientific questions, raising the concern that they will sycophantically retreat from established consensus when a user signals doubt -- drifting toward a false balance that treats settled science as one view among several. We test this across three open instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B), three consensus-science domains (climate, vaccines, evolution), and single- and multi-turn settings, combining behavioral measurement with linear probing and activation patching. We do not observe sycophantic retreat. Instead, models show three distinct policies under the same skeptical pressure: reactive assertion, where consensus assertion increases rather than decreases (Llama); surface hedging, where tone softens while the position holds (Qwen); and non-response (Mistral). Pairwise judgments confirm the reactive shift is stance, not style (63.6%, p=.007), and a decomposition identifies increased consensus assertion, not false balance, as its driver (beta=+0.042 per dose, p<1e-77). Linear probes localize the divergence to middle layers -- perfect separation in Llama and Qwen versus 72% in Mistral, with non-overlapping confidence intervals -- indicating the non-responsive model does not linearly represent the skepticism signal at all. Crucially, this robustness does not transfer: it attenuates across domains and, in the safety-critical vaccine domain, can reverse, with myth-rebuttal weakening under skeptical pressure. We synthesize these into a four-way taxonomy separating active from accidental robustness, and argue that behavioral evaluation alone cannot distinguish a model that resists skepticism because it understands the signal from one that only appears to resist because it fails to perceive it.

title: Autorelevance function and other feature relevance measures for univariate time series
summary: We propose a model agnostic methodology to measure lag relevance in machine learning forecasting models applied to univariate time series. Particularly, we are working in the context of time series using the frameworks of Ghost variables and Shapley values, together with additive importance measures, to introduce the auto-relevance and partial auto-relevance functions as the lag importance values. Additionally, we propose a novel method to replace absent features in coalition based methods with a one step forecast from the same model. We evaluate these proposals under different simulations and real data cases. This combined framework perspective is particularly suitable for time series. In addition, to show our discoveries we use a pull of models from the seasonal ARMA family and recurrent neural networks. We found that the calculated relevance measures successfully demonstrate the expected lag structure in almost all cases.

AI.title_translation: 单变量时间序列的自相关函数及其他特征相关性度量方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Shapley值的模型无关方法，用于量化时间序列预测中不同滞后项的重要性，有效提升了复杂模型的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 为了解决时间序列预测中缺乏模型无关的滞后相关性度量方法的问题，旨在提供一种能够解释机器学习模型如何利用历史滞后数据进行预测的工具。
AI.method: 利用Ghost变量和Shapley值框架，结合加性重要性度量，引入自相关和偏自相关函数来度量滞后重要性；并提出了一种利用单步预测值替代联合方法中缺失特征的新方法。
AI.result: 通过模拟数据和真实数据集的验证，使用ARMA模型和循环神经网络（RNN）进行测试，结果表明所提出的度量方法在几乎所有案例中都能成功识别预期的滞后结构。
AI.conclusion: 提出的自相关函数和偏自相关函数能够有效地揭示单变量时间序列模型中的滞后结构，为时间序列预测模型的可解释性提供了有力支持。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种模型无关的方法，用于测量应用于单变量时间序列的机器学习预测模型中的滞后相关性。特别地，我们在时间序列背景下，使用Ghost变量和Shapley值框架，结合加性重要性度量，引入了自相关函数和偏自相关函数作为滞后重要性值。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，用来自同一模型的单步预测来替换基于联合（coalition）方法中的缺失特征。我们在不同的模拟和真实数据案例中评估了这些建议。这种组合框架视角特别适用于时间序列。此外，为了展示我们的发现，我们使用了来自季节性ARMA族和循环神经网络的模型池。我们发现，计算出的相关性度量在几乎所有情况下都成功地展示了预期的滞后结构。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种模型无关的方法来度量单变量时间序列预测中的滞后相关性。通过结合Ghost变量、Shapley值和加性重要性度量，作者引入了自相关和偏自相关函数。同时，提出了一种处理联合法中缺失特征的新策略，并在多种模型和数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 单变量时间序列, 滞后相关性, Shapley值, Ghost变量, 模型可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将Shapley值和Ghost变量框架有效结合，并提出了处理缺失特征的新方法，这为理解复杂时间序列模型（如RNN）的内部决策机制提供了可解释性工具。该方法与模型无关，具有很强的普适性。

title: Born Discrete, Made Smooth: Variational Formulation of Shallow Neural Networks
summary:
Although neural networks are remarkably effective, their underlying optimization principles remain theoretically elusive, often characterized by non-convex landscapes and stochastic heuristics. In this work, we propose a paradigm shift by replacing the discrete training problem of shallow neural networks with a well-posed continuum variational surrogate. We identify a family of $λ$-convex functionals over parameter densities in weighted Sobolev spaces and prove that these variational problems are globally well-posed, stable, and exhibit unexpected almost $C^3$ regularity.
  Unlike existing Wasserstein-based or Mean-Field approaches, which often face limited regularity and discretization challenges, our formulation provides direct access to elliptic regularity and convex analysis. This allows us to prove that the optimal parameter density can be obtained by solving a single linear system, bypassing iterative optimization entirely. We establish explicit generalization error controls at a rate of $1/α$ relative to the regularization parameter, and prove that finite-width networks of size $N$ achieve the continuum optimum at an $O(1/N)$ rate. This perspective bridges the gap between the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) and feature-learning regimes, providing a principled framework for understanding over-parameterization through the lens of variational calculus.

AI.title_translation: 生而离散，成于平滑：浅层神经网络的变分公式化
AI.tldr: 通过将神经网络训练转化为连续变分问题，本文证明了可以绕过迭代优化，直接通过求解线性系统获得最优解，并提供了严谨的收敛速率分析。
AI.motivation: 针对现有神经网络训练中非凸景观和随机启发式方法导致的理论分析困难，旨在寻找一种更具理论完备性的连续化描述。
AI.method: 提出一种基于加权Sobolev空间中λ-凸泛函的连续变分替代方案，利用椭圆正则性理论，将训练问题转化为单一线性系统的求解。
AI.result: 证明了变分问题的全局良定性与稳定性，实现了通过求解线性系统直接获取最优参数密度，并给出了泛化误差界(1/α)及有限宽度网络的收敛速率(O(1/N))。
AI.conclusion: 通过将神经网络训练转化为连续变分问题，该方法实现了全局良定性，并能通过求解线性系统直接获得最优参数密度，为神经网络的理论分析提供了严谨的数学框架。
AI.translation: 尽管神经网络效果显著，但其潜在的优化原理在理论上仍然难以捉摸，通常表现为非凸景观和随机启发式。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种范式转移，用一个良定的连续变分替代方案取代了浅层神经网络的离散训练问题。我们确定了加权Sobolev空间中参数密度上的λ-凸泛函族，并证明了这些变分问题是全局良定、稳定的，并表现出意想不到的几乎C^3正则性。与现有的基于Wasserstein或平均场的方法（通常面临有限的正则性和离散化挑战）不同，我们的公式提供了直接访问椭圆正则性和凸分析的途径。这使我们能够证明最优参数密度可以通过求解单一线性系统获得，从而完全绕过了迭代优化。我们建立了相对于正则化参数为1/α的显式泛化误差控制，并证明了大小为N的有限宽度网络以O(1/N)的速率达到连续最优值。这一视角弥合了神经正切核(NTK)和特征学习机制之间的差距，为通过变分法理解过参数化提供了一个原则性的框架。
AI.summary: 本文通过引入加权Sobolev空间下的变分公式，将浅层神经网络的训练问题转化为连续的λ-凸泛函优化。该方法通过椭圆正则性分析，实现了无需迭代的线性系统求解，并为理解神经网络的泛化性能和过参数化提供了统一的理论基础。
AI.keywords: 浅层神经网络, 变分法, Sobolev空间, 全局良定性, 泛化误差控制
AI.comments: 该研究通过变分法将浅层神经网络的训练转化为连续问题，展现了极高的理论深度。其核心创新在于利用加权Sobolev空间下的λ-凸泛函，将非凸优化问题转化为线性系统求解，这为理解过参数化及神经网络学习动力学提供了全新的数学视角。其局限性在于目前主要针对浅层网络，推广至深层架构仍具挑战。

title: Separating Geodesic Structure and Product Structure
comments: An extended abstract of this paper appears in the proceedings of the 34th Annual European Symposium on Algorithms (ESA 2026)
summary:
The geodesic treewidth of a graph $ G $ is the smallest $k$ for which there is a partition $\mathcal{P}$ into geodesics such that $G/\mathcal{P}$ has treewidth $k$, where $G/\mathcal{P}$ is obtained from $ G $ by contracting each part of $ \mathcal{P} $. Based on this notion, row treewidth was developed and is defined for a graph $ G $ as the smallest $ k $ such that $ G \subseteq H \boxtimes P $ for some graph $ H $ of treewidth $ k $ and a path $ P $. Equivalently, the row treewidth of a graph $ G $ is the smallest $ k $ for which there is a partition $ \mathcal{P} $ into disjoint unions of geodesics that are aligned with respect to some layering such that $ G/\mathcal{P} $ has treewidth $ k $.
  We separate the two notions by showing that bounded row treewidth does not imply bounded geodesic treewidth and by presenting a polynomial-time algorithm to decide whether a graph of treewidth 2 has geodesic treewidth 1, which is known to be NP-hard for row treewidth [Biedl, Eppstein, Ueckerdt, 2025]. More generally, we provide an algorithm to decide whether a given graph has geodesic treewidth at most $ d $ that is XP in the treewidth, whereas there is no such algorithm for row treewidth, unless P = NP [Biedl, Eppstein, Ueckerdt, 2025]. On the other hand, we show that computing the geodesic treewidth is NP-hard and that every graph with geodesic treewidth 1 has bounded row treewidth. Moreover, we improve the best known lower bound on the geodesic treewidth of planar graphs to 5.
comment: An extended abstract of this paper appears in the proceedings of the 34th Annual European Symposium on Algorithms (ESA 2026)

title: Structured Gaussian Processes for Uncertainty-Aware Classification of High-Dimensional, Small-Sampled Omics Data
summary:
Classifying heterogeneous omics data remains a fundamental challenge in computational biology, particularly in high-dimensional, small-sample settings where nonlinear interactions dominate and class imbalance further complicates reliable prediction of minority phenotypes. While traditional kernel methods rely on feature abundance, they fail to leverage the known interaction landscapes of biological systems.
  In this work, we propose a structured Gaussian process classification framework that integrates graph-encoded biological pathways directly into the kernel construction. By propagating information along known interaction networks and combining this with abundance-derived features, the resulting classifier captures both quantitative measurements and topological context.
  We benchmark our proposed methodology on three publicly available gut and fecal microbiome datasets. To address severe class imbalance, we evaluate complementary strategies, including data-level resampling, threshold calibration, and confusion-matrix-based adjustments, and report minority-class performance alongside accuracy. The hybrid approach yields a performance gain over unstructured baselines and matches the performance of established benchmarks for similar datasets. Furthermore, the probabilistic nature of the framework naturally provides calibrated predictive uncertainty, enabling robust differentiation between confident predictions and ambiguous samples.

AI.title_translation: 用于高维小样本组学数据不确定性感知分类的结构化高斯过程
AI.tldr: 提出了一种将生物通路图结构融入高斯过程核函数的新方法，有效提升了高维小样本组学数据的分类精度和不确定性估计能力。
AI.motivation: 针对高维小样本生物数据中非线性交互显著及类别不平衡导致的分类难题，旨在解决传统核方法无法利用生物系统已知交互结构的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种结构化高斯过程分类框架，将图编码的生物通路直接整合进核函数构建中，并结合数据级重采样、阈值校准及基于混淆矩阵的调整策略处理类别不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在三个肠道微生物数据集上，该混合方法优于非结构化基准模型，与现有成熟方法表现相当，且能够提供经校准的预测不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的结构化高斯过程框架通过融合定量特征与拓扑信息，有效提升了高维小样本生物数据的分类能力，并能提供可靠的预测不确定性评估。
AI.translation: 对异构组学数据进行分类仍然是计算生物学中的一个基本挑战，特别是在高维、小样本的情况下，非线性交互占主导地位，且类别不平衡进一步增加了对少数群体表型进行可靠预测的难度。虽然传统的核方法依赖于特征丰度，但它们未能利用生物系统中已知的交互景观。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个结构化高斯过程分类框架，将图编码的生物通路直接集成到核函数构建中。通过沿着已知的交互网络传播信息，并将其与丰度派生特征相结合，生成的分类器既捕获了定量测量值，也捕获了拓扑语境。我们在三个公开的肠道和粪便微生物组数据集上对我们的方法进行了基准测试。为了解决严重的类别不平衡问题，我们评估了补充策略，包括数据级重采样、阈值校准和基于混淆矩阵的调整，并报告了少数类别的性能以及准确性。这种混合方法在性能上优于非结构化基准，并与类似数据集的既定基准表现相当。此外，该框架的概率性质自然提供了校准的预测不确定性，从而能够稳健地区分自信预测和模糊样本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于高维小样本组学数据分类的结构化高斯过程框架。通过将生物通路图信息与定量特征结合到核函数中，该模型能够捕捉数据中的拓扑语境，并结合多种策略应对类别不平衡，从而在保持分类性能的同时提供稳健的预测不确定性评估。
AI.keywords: 高斯过程, 高维小样本, 生物路径, 分类, 不确定性量化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将生物学路径图结构信息有效地融入了高斯过程分类器的核函数中，解决了高维小样本生物数据中传统方法忽略拓扑结构的问题。其局限性在于对数据预处理（如重采样）和阈值校准的依赖，且仅在肠道微生物数据集上进行了验证。

title: A 2048-spin bulk acoustic wave Ising machine for number partitioning and Sudoku
summary: Optical coherent Ising machines based on time-multiplexing have demonstrated significant progress in terms of connectivity and spin scalability. However, they are constrained by large physical footprints, high power consumption, poor thermal stability, and high cost. Here, we present a time-multiplexed Ising machine leveraging propagating wave packets in solid-state delay lines at microwave frequencies, enabling thermally stable, robust, low-power, tabletop, and affordable design. We use two serially connected 20.5 MHz, 707 μs bulk acoustic wave delay lines supporting 2,048 spins. Our design provides all-to-all connectivity with 15-bit coupling resolution and finds approximate MAX-CUT solutions in 341 ms, potentially scalable to sub-ms by using higher frequency delay lines. Additionally, we demonstrate solutions to number partitioning and Sudoku problems. Compared with state-of-the-art Coherent Ising machines, our machine exhibits four orders of magnitude higher thermal stability. Against the simulated bifurcation algorithm, our design achieves comparable results on the MAX-CUT problem, while outperforming it on the more complex number-partitioning and Sudoku problems.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于数字划分和数独求解的2048自旋体声波Ising机
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于体声波的新型Ising机，具有高热稳定性、低功耗及紧凑的物理尺寸，在求解复杂组合优化问题上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的光学相干Ising机存在物理尺寸大、功耗高、热稳定性差和成本高等局限性，需要一种更稳健且经济的替代方案。
AI.method: 利用两个串联的20.5 MHz、707 μs体声波延迟线，通过微波频率下的传播波包实现2,048个自旋的时间复用，并提供全对全连接及15位耦合分辨率。
AI.result: 该装置在341毫秒内找到MAX-CUT近似解，热稳定性比现有相干Ising机高出四个数量级，并在数字划分和数独问题上表现优于模拟分岔算法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了基于体声波的Ising机是一种稳定、低功耗且可扩展的组合优化问题求解方案，在处理复杂约束问题上表现出超越模拟分岔算法的潜力。
AI.translation: 基于时间复用的光学相干Ising机在连接性和自旋可扩展性方面取得了显著进展。然而，它们受到物理尺寸大、功耗高、热稳定性差和成本高的限制。在此，我们提出了一种利用微波频率下固体延迟线中传播波包的时间复用Ising机，实现了热稳定、稳健、低功耗、桌面化且经济的设计。我们使用了两个串联的20.5 MHz、707 μs体声波延迟线，支持2,048个自旋。我们的设计提供了具有15位耦合分辨率的全对全连接，并在341毫秒内找到MAX-CUT近似解，通过使用更高频率的延迟线，有望扩展至亚毫秒级。此外，我们展示了该机在数字划分和数独问题上的求解能力。与最先进的相干Ising机相比，我们的机器表现出高出四个数量级的热稳定性。与模拟分岔算法相比，我们的设计在MAX-CUT问题上取得了相当的结果，而在更复杂的数字划分和数独问题上则表现得更好。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于体声波延迟线的2048自旋Ising机，利用微波频率下的波包传播实现时间复用。该设计具备全对全连接性，在保持低功耗和高热稳定性的同时，有效解决了数字划分和数独等复杂组合优化问题。
AI.keywords: 体声波, Ising机, 组合优化, 延迟线, MAX-CUT
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入体声波延迟线替代光学系统，成功解决了传统光子Ising机在体积、功耗、热稳定性和成本方面的挑战。该方法展示了在复杂组合优化问题（如数独和数字划分）上的卓越性能，具有极高的工程实用价值。

title: An Efficient vLLM-Based Inference Pipeline for Unified Audio Understanding and Generation
summary: While Large Multimodal Models excel in comprehension, high-throughput inference engines lack native support for multimodal generation. This is severe in Speech Language Models, where generating multi-layered audio tokens via decoupled AR+NAR or synchronous Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) with delay-pattern interleaving conflicts with standard single-stream loops. We present a vLLM-based inference pipeline for unified speech understanding and generation. We extend autoregressive decoding to natively execute delay-pattern de-interleaving and coordinated multi-stream sampling, integrating an on-GPU acoustic decoder for end-to-end waveform synthesis. Crucially, we overcome the shared intuition that Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) halves throughput. By co-scheduling paired conditional and unconditional requests within a continuous batch, our CFG implementation sustains 80% of non-CFG throughput, absorbing dual-request and logit merging overheads. We open-source our framework.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于vLLM的统一语音理解与生成高效推理流水线
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种优化后的vLLM推理流水线，通过改进解码策略和CFG协同调度，实现了语音模型的高效推理，在保持CFG效果的同时大幅提升了吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的高吞吐量推理引擎缺乏对多模态生成（尤其是语音模型中复杂解码模式）的原生支持，且分类器自由引导（CFG）技术严重限制了推理吞吐量。
AI.method: 在vLLM基础上扩展自回归解码，实现延迟模式解交错和协同多流采样；集成GPU内声学解码器进行端到端波形合成；提出CFG协同调度策略，在连续批处理中同步处理条件与非条件请求。
AI.result: 实现的CFG优化方案在保持高质量生成的同时，能够维持非CFG模式下80%的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功将vLLM扩展为支持统一语音理解与生成的推理引擎，通过创新的CFG协同调度策略，显著提升了语音模型的推理效率。
AI.translation: 尽管大型多模态模型在理解方面表现出色，但高吞吐量推理引擎缺乏对多模态生成的原生支持。在语音语言模型中，通过解耦AR+NAR或带有延迟模式交错的同步多Token预测（MTP）生成多层音频Token的过程，与标准的单流循环存在冲突。我们提出了一种基于vLLM的统一语音理解与生成推理流水线。我们扩展了自回归解码，以原生执行延迟模式解交错和协同多流采样，并集成了片上GPU声学解码器以实现端到端波形合成。关键的是，我们克服了分类器自由引导（CFG）会使吞吐量减半的普遍认知。通过在连续批处理中协同调度成对的条件和非条件请求，我们的CFG实现维持了非CFG吞吐量的80%，吸收了双请求和Logit合并带来的开销。我们已开源该框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于vLLM的统一语音理解与生成推理流水线。通过原生扩展自回归解码以支持复杂的语音token生成模式，并集成GPU声学解码器，实现了端到端合成。此外，通过创新的CFG协同调度策略，有效解决了CFG带来的吞吐量减半问题，显著提升了语音大模型的推理效率。
AI.keywords: vLLM, 语音大模型, 多模态推理, 分类器自由引导 (CFG), 高吞吐量
AI.comments: 该研究通过优化vLLM架构，解决了多模态生成模型在推理引擎中面临的吞吐量瓶颈，特别是针对语音模型中复杂的解码模式（如AR+NAR、MTP）和计算昂贵的CFG技术进行了针对性优化，具有很高的工程落地价值。

title: Coverage Analysis in Terahertz Clustered HetNets
summary: Terahertz (THz) transmission technologies hold significant potential for enabling ultra-broadband, short-range communication in next-generation networks. Despite the vast bandwidth, THz signals suffer from limited transmission range and a feasible scenario is to deploy THz within clustered heterogeneous networks (HetNets) to enhance coverage. This paper investigates THz communication in clustered HetNets, leveraging stochastic geometry for performance analysis. Specifically, we consider two tiers of macro base stations (MBS) and small base stations (SBS). The MBS tier is modeled as a Poisson Point Process (PPP), and both the SBS tier and users are modeled as a Poisson Cluster Process (PCP) to capture user clustering and network hotspots. We derive the analytical expressions for user association probabilities, the Laplace transform of interference, and the coverage probability. The derived coverage probability is validated through Monte Carlo simulation. The numerical results show that the coverage in THz PCP-HetNets is higher than that achieved in THz PPP HetNets. In addition, a moderate spatial spread of SBSs is beneficial for coverage.

AI.title_translation: 太赫兹簇状异构网络中的覆盖分析
AI.tldr: 本文利用随机几何理论分析了太赫兹簇状异构网络的覆盖性能，证明了采用泊松簇过程建模比传统的泊松点过程更能有效提升网络覆盖。
AI.motivation: 太赫兹信号传输距离有限，为了在下一代网络中利用其超大带宽优势，需要探索在簇状异构网络（HetNets）中部署太赫兹基站以增强覆盖范围。
AI.method: 利用随机几何理论，将宏基站建模为泊松点过程（PPP），将小基站和用户建模为泊松簇过程（PCP），推导了用户关联概率、干扰的拉普拉斯变换及覆盖概率，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真进行验证。
AI.result: 推导出了覆盖概率的解析表达式；数值结果表明，太赫兹PCP-HetNets的覆盖性能优于PPP-HetNets，且适度的基站空间分布范围有助于提升覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明在太赫兹异构网络中采用簇状部署（PCP）相比传统的均匀部署（PPP）能显著提升覆盖性能，并指出适当的基站空间分布密度对优化覆盖至关重要。
AI.translation: 太赫兹（THz）传输技术在实现下一代网络中的超宽带、短距离通信方面具有巨大潜力。尽管带宽巨大，但太赫兹信号的传输距离有限，因此在簇状异构网络（HetNets）中部署太赫兹基站以增强覆盖是一个可行的方案。本文利用随机几何方法对簇状异构网络中的太赫兹通信进行了性能分析。具体而言，我们考虑了宏基站（MBS）和小基站（SBS）两层网络。宏基站层建模为泊松点过程（PPP），小基站层和用户均建模为泊松簇过程（PCP），以捕捉用户聚集和网络热点。我们推导了用户关联概率、干扰的拉普拉斯变换以及覆盖概率的解析表达式，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真验证了所推导的覆盖概率。数值结果表明，太赫兹PCP-HetNets的覆盖率高于太赫兹PPP-HetNets。此外，适度的SBS空间分布有利于提升覆盖性能。
AI.summary: 本文研究了簇状异构网络中的太赫兹通信性能。通过应用随机几何方法，将宏基站建模为PPP，将小基站和用户建模为PCP，分析并推导了覆盖概率，证明了簇状部署在太赫兹网络中能有效提高覆盖范围。
AI.keywords: 太赫兹通信, 异构网络, 随机几何, 泊松簇过程, 覆盖分析
AI.comments: 本文通过随机几何方法为太赫兹簇状异构网络提供了严谨的性能分析框架，特别是利用泊松簇过程（PCP）更真实地模拟了用户和基站的分布，这是其主要贡献。局限性在于未考虑复杂的信道损耗模型或实际移动性场景。

title: Population-Scale Segmentation of Penile Tissue in DIXON MRI using Deep Learning for Quantitative Phenotyping in Male Reproductive Health
summary:
Penile measurement is clinically relevant across male reproductive and urogenital health, including conditions such as micropenis, congenital and endocrine disorders, and sexual or urinary dysfunction. However, quantitative assessment of penile size has relied mainly on external length or circumference measurements, which are difficult to standardize, sensitive to measurement conditions, and unable to capture the internal portion of the penis. MRI enables volumetric assessment of the whole penis in vivo, but automated segmentation has not previously been established at population scale. Automated whole-organ volumetry would enable high-throughput phenotyping for multi-omics and clinical studies of male reproductive disease.
  Here, we present a deep learning framework for whole-penis segmentation in multi-channel DIXON MRI. Using a newly curated expert-annotated training dataset ($n = 145$ subjects; $13,050$ annotated slices) and a double-annotated independent test benchmark ($n = 24$ subjects; $2,160$ double-annotated slices), we optimized a 3D nnU-Net architecture. The model achieved a 5-fold cross-validation Dice score of $0.90$ and performed at observer-level accuracy on the independent test set (Dice: $0.92$; Hausdorff distance: $3.58$).
  We deployed the model in $34,412$ UK Biobank participants, enabling automated quantification of total penile tissue, including both external and internal components. Longitudinal evaluation in 2,282 men demonstrated high inter-session reproducibility ($r = 0.87$). This framework establishes a reproducible and population-scalable method for MRI-based assessment of penile anatomy and provides an open technical resource for future studies in urological imaging and male reproductive health. The trained model weights will be publicly released.

AI.title_translation: 利用深度学习对DIXON MRI中的阴茎组织进行群体规模分割：男性生殖健康的定量表型分析
AI.tldr: 研究开发了一种基于3D nnU-Net的深度学习模型，实现了对DIXON MRI中阴茎组织的自动化、高精度分割，并成功应用于超3万人的生物样本库队列，为男性生殖健康研究提供了可扩展的定量分析方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的阴茎测量方法（如外部测量）难以标准化且无法获取内部结构，而缺乏自动化分割方法限制了MRI在群体规模男性生殖健康研究中的应用。
AI.method: 利用145名受试者的专家标注数据，优化了3D nnU-Net深度学习架构，用于多通道DIXON MRI图像的自动分割。
AI.result: 模型在独立测试集上达到了0.92的Dice分数和3.58的Hausdorff距离，达到观测者水平的准确度。在34,412名UK Biobank参与者中成功部署，并表现出高重测信度（r=0.87）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发并验证了一个基于深度学习的自动化阴茎MRI分割框架，实现了在群体规模上对阴茎解剖结构的精确、可重复量化，为男性生殖健康研究提供了重要的技术资源。
AI.translation:
阴茎测量在男性生殖和泌尿生殖健康方面具有临床相关性，包括小阴茎、先天性和内分泌疾病以及性功能或泌尿功能障碍等病症。然而，阴茎大小的定量评估主要依赖于外部长度或周长测量，这些测量方法难以标准化、对测量条件敏感，且无法捕捉阴茎的内部部分。MRI能够对活体内的整个阴茎进行体积评估，但此前尚未建立群体规模的自动化分割方法。自动化全器官体积测定将为男性生殖疾病的多组学和临床研究提供高通量表型分析。
在此，我们提出了一种用于多通道DIXON MRI中全阴茎分割的深度学习框架。我们使用了一个新策划的专家标注训练数据集（n=145名受试者；13,050个标注切片）和一个双重标注的独立测试基准（n=24名受试者；2,160个双重标注切片），优化了3D nnU-Net架构。该模型在5折交叉验证中取得了0.90的Dice分数，并在独立测试集上达到了观测者水平的准确度（Dice: 0.92；Hausdorff距离: 3.58）。
我们将该模型部署在34,412名UK Biobank参与者中，实现了对包括外部和内部组件在内的总阴茎组织的自动量化。对2,282名男性的纵向评估显示出高重测信度（r=0.87）。该框架为基于MRI的阴茎解剖评估建立了一种可重复且可在大规模人群中扩展的方法，并为未来泌尿影像学和男性生殖健康的研究提供了开放的技术资源。训练好的模型权重将公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于3D nnU-Net的深度学习框架，用于实现DIXON MRI中阴茎组织的自动分割。该方法通过专家标注数据训练，在独立测试集中表现优异，并成功应用于英国生物样本库（UK Biobank）的3万多名受试者，实现了阴茎全组织的高通量、可重复量化，为男性生殖健康研究提供了新的标准化分析工具。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 阴茎分割, DIXON MRI, 生殖健康, 群体规模量化
AI.comments: 该研究通过深度学习实现了对阴茎组织的高通量、全器官量化，填补了临床影像分析中的空白。其创新之处在于将复杂的MRI分割任务自动化，并成功应用于超大规模人群队列（UK Biobank），为男性生殖健康研究提供了强有力的定量工具。局限性在于该模型基于DIXON序列，其在不同扫描参数或MRI设备间的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: An algorithmic approach for computing fundamental domains of crystallographic groups
summary: A crystallographic group is a discrete subgroup of the Euclidean group $\operatorname{E}(n)$ that has a compact fundamental domain. Since such a crystallographic group $Γ$ is infinite, computing fundamental domains of $Γ$ is algorithmically challenging. We address this difficulty by targeting the computation of Dirichlet cells that can form fundamental domains of $Γ$. We show that the half-spaces defining such a Dirichlet cell can be derived from elements of $Γ$ acting on $\mathbb{R}^n$ that can be expressed as words of bounded length in a suitable generating set. Based on these results, we design an algorithm for the computation of fundamental domains of crystallographic groups and exploit it to study the construction of topological interlocking assemblies.

title: Extending the computational reach of Quantum Annealing using Reverse Annealing
summary: Quantum annealing is a promising heuristic for combinatorial optimization, but on current hardware its performance degrades for larger and more complex problems due to noise and small energy gaps. Reverse annealing has been proposed as a refinement strategy, yet it remains unclear when it provides systematic advantages over standard forward annealing or simply increasing annealing time. We find that combining forward and reverse annealing consistently improves solution quality and efficiency across multiple problem classes. The benefits of reverse annealing increase with problem complexity and are strongest in regimes where forward annealing is increasingly limited. Moreover, reverse annealing yields larger efficiency gains than simply extending forward annealing times. We establish these results through a systematic experimental study on a D-Wave Advantage system, benchmarking reverse annealing across Max-Cut, Number Partitioning, and sparse clustering problems while varying reverse distance, pause duration, and annealing time. We identify a narrow optimal regime for reverse annealing parameters linked to the location of freeze-out points and energy-level crossings in the annealing schedule. These findings demonstrate that reverse annealing is most valuable for large, high-complexity optimization problems and is likely to gain importance as quantum annealing hardware scales toward more realistic applications.

AI.title_translation: 利用反向退火扩展量子退火的计算能力
AI.tldr: 研究表明，反向退火是提升量子退火器解决大规模复杂组合优化问题效能的有效策略，其性能优势显著优于单纯延长前向退火时间。
AI.motivation: 当前的量子退火硬件在处理大规模、复杂问题时，由于噪声和能隙较小导致性能下降，需要一种更有效的细化策略来超越标准的前向退火。
AI.method: 在D-Wave Advantage系统上进行系统性实验，针对Max-Cut、数字划分（Number Partitioning）和稀疏聚类问题，通过改变反向距离、暂停持续时间和退火时间，对比前向退火与反向退火的性能。
AI.result: 反向退火在多种问题类别中显著提升了求解质量和效率；其优势在复杂问题中尤为突出；且在提升效率方面明显优于单纯增加前向退火时间；研究还确定了与冻结点和能级交叉相关的最优参数区间。
AI.conclusion: 反向退火是提升量子退火器解决大规模复杂组合优化问题能力的关键策略，其性能优势随着问题复杂度的增加而愈发显著，且优于单纯延长前向退火时间。
AI.translation: 量子退火是一种很有前途的组合优化启发式方法，但在当前的硬件上，由于噪声和较小的能隙，其在处理更大、更复杂的问题时性能会下降。反向退火已被提出作为一种细化策略，但它在何时能比标准的前向退火或单纯增加退火时间提供系统性优势尚不清楚。我们发现，结合前向和反向退火在多个问题类别中始终提高了求解质量和效率。反向退火的收益随着问题复杂度的增加而增加，并且在前向退火受到限制的情况下表现最强。此外，与单纯延长前向退火时间相比，反向退火产生了更大的效率增益。我们通过在D-Wave Advantage系统上进行的系统性实验研究确立了这些结果，通过改变反向距离、暂停持续时间和退火时间，对Max-Cut、数字划分和稀疏聚类问题进行了反向退火基准测试。我们确定了反向退火参数的一个狭窄最优区间，该区间与退火计划中冻结点和能级交叉的位置相关。这些发现表明，反向退火对于大型、高复杂度的优化问题最具价值，并且随着量子退火硬件向更现实的应用扩展，它可能会变得越来越重要。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了反向退火作为一种量子退火细化策略的有效性。通过在D-Wave Advantage系统上对多种组合优化问题的实证研究，证明了反向退火在处理复杂问题时能提供比单纯延长前向退火时间更好的性能，并确定了其发挥最优效能的参数范围，表明该技术对于未来量子退火硬件的应用至关重要。
AI.keywords: 量子退火, 反向退火, 组合优化, D-Wave, 启发式算法
AI.comments: 该研究通过实证分析明确了反向退火在量子退火中的具体优势，特别是证明了其在解决复杂组合优化问题时优于单纯增加前向退火时间。其创新点在于系统性地探索了参数空间（如反向距离、暂停时间），并揭示了其性能表现与系统冻结点及能级交叉点的深刻联系，为量子退火器的实际应用提供了重要的优化指导。

title: 3-Colouring Graphs Excluding a Fixed Minor
summary: We show that, for every fixed graph $H$, every $n$-vertex graph $G$ that excludes $H$ as a minor is $3$-colourable with clustering $O_H(n^{4/9})$. That is, there exists a function $f$ such that for every graph $H$, every $n\ge 1$, every $n$-vertex graph $G$ that excludes $H$ as a minor has a vertex colouring with $3$ colours in which each monochromatic component has size at most $f(H)\cdot n^{4/9}$. This generalizes a recent result of Dujmović, Morin, Norin, and Wood (\textit{arXiv}:2507.03163) from planar graphs to all proper minor-closed graph classes and is the first improvement on clustered $3$-colouring of proper minor-closed graph classes since the upper bound of $O_H(\sqrt{n})$ due to Linial, Matoušek, Sheffet, and Tardos (\textit{Comb. Prob. Comput.}, \textbf{17}(4):577--589, 2008).

AI.title_translation: 排除固定子图的图的 3-着色问题
AI.tldr: 本文证明了排除固定子图的图可以进行 3-着色，且单色分支大小不超过 $O_H(n^{4/9})$，改进了长期的 $O(\sqrt{n})$ 上界。
AI.motivation: 旨在改进关于排除固定子图的图类的聚类 3-着色问题的现有上界，并将其适用范围从平面图推广至所有适当子图闭合类。
AI.method: 论文通过理论证明，将针对平面图的聚类 3-着色结论推广至所有包含适当子图闭合类的图，并利用数学分析优化了原有的上界估计。
AI.result: 证明了对于任意固定图 $H$，排除 $H$ 作为子图的 $n$ 顶点图是 3-可着色的，且其单色分支的大小最多为 $O_H(n^{4/9})$。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功证明了对于任意排除固定子图 $H$ 的图，其 3-着色的聚类界限可达到 $O_H(n^{4/9})$，这标志着该研究领域的一个重要进展。
AI.translation: 我们证明，对于每一个固定的图 $H$，每一个排除 $H$ 作为子图的 $n$ 顶点图 $G$ 都是 3-可着色的，且聚类大小为 $O_H(n^{4/9})$。即，存在一个函数 $f$，使得对于每一个图 $H$ 和每一个 $n\ge 1$，每一个排除 $H$ 作为子图的 $n$ 顶点图 $G$ 都存在一种 3 色顶点着色，其中每个单色分支的大小最多为 $f(H)\cdot n^{4/9}$。这推广了 Dujmović 等人（arXiv:2507.03163）最近从平面图到所有适当子图闭合图类的结果，并且是自 Linial 等人（Comb. Prob. Comput., 17(4):577--589, 2008）给出 $O_H(\sqrt{n})$ 的上界以来，在适当子图闭合图类的聚类 3-着色方面的首次改进。
AI.summary: 本文研究了排除固定子图的图的着色问题，证明了任何排除图 $H$ 作为子图的 $n$ 顶点图均可进行 3-着色，且其单色连通分支的大小限制在 $O_H(n^{4/9})$ 以内。这一结果推广了之前针对平面图的结论，并改进了自 2008 年以来该领域 $O_H(\sqrt{n})$ 的最佳上界。
AI.keywords: 图着色, 排除子图, 聚类, 图论, 子图挖掘
AI.comments: 该论文在图论领域具有重要意义，它改进了关于图着色和聚类的一个长期存在的上界。通过将界限从 $O(\sqrt{n})$ 提升至 $O(n^{4/9})$，该研究为理解排除特定子图的图的结构性质提供了更深层的见解，并推广了先前仅适用于平面图的结论。

title: Fourier Preconditioning for Neural Feature Learning
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Signal Processing Letters
summary: Mutual information (MI)-inspired feature learning techniques are capable of generating low-dimensional embeddings that retain nonlinear dependence structures, but direct estimations of MI suffer from noisy probability distribution estimates in the low-data regime. The H-Score objective, computed from second-order statistics, provides a practical proxy metric for training feature extraction networks. We prove that H-Score is invariant to invertible transformations in the unrestricted functional setting, but becomes sensitive to input basis rotations under constrained approximation classes. Consequently, we study unitary preconditioning for H-Score networks and show that selecting an appropriate basis rotation reduces finite-width truncation error by concentrating predictive dependence into fewer dominant modes. We identify the fast Fourier transform (FFT) as an effective data-independent, low-cost preconditioner for approximately stationary processes, where spectral structure induces concentration of the cross-covariance singular value spectrum. We introduce training-free metrics based on spectral entropy and cumulative dependence energy to quantify basis suitability and predict downstream inference gains prior to network training. Experiments across eight multivariate datasets demonstrate that FFT preconditioning is particularly useful in resource-constrained regimes, achieving up to 50% normalized mean squared error (NMSE) reduction, while the proposed metrics correlate with observed performance gains and correctly identify cases where spectral preconditioning is detrimental.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Signal Processing Letters

title: Prediction Sets for Counterfactual Decisions: Coverage, Optimality, and Conformal Prediction
summary:
Predictions are increasingly used to guide high-stakes decisions, from treatment selection to policy making. To ensure reliability with imperfect predictions, uncertainty quantification methods such as conformal prediction build prediction sets with coverage guarantees. However, statistical validity alone does not immediately determine the decisions to take, nor the optimality thereof. This gap is especially delicate in counterfactual settings where the outcome that materializes depends on the action taken, so uncertainty cannot be specified independently of the decision rule.
  We develop a decision-theoretic framework for uncertainty-informed counterfactual decisions. We identify a novel notion of \emph{policy-coupled coverage} -- namely, coverage of the realized outcome under the action induced by the prediction sets themselves -- as the optimal and lossless interface between uncertainty and action. It plays three roles. First, it justifies acting via a natural max-min rule as minimax-optimal under distributional ambiguity. Second, optimizing prediction sets under policy-coupled coverage is equivalent both to a stronger universal-coverage formulation and to the direct risk-averse optimization over policies and utility certificates; this equivalence yields the explicit form of the population-optimal prediction sets. Third, it admits a two-stage procedure, Policy-Coupled Risk-Averse Conformal Prediction (PC-RACP), that approximates these optimal sets with rigorous finite-sample coverage. Simulations and a real email-marketing experiment confirm that PC-RACP delivers higher utility than existing approaches while maintaining valid coverage, and that ignoring the counterfactual structure of the decision problem is suboptimal for both validity and utility.

AI.title_translation: 反事实决策的预测集：覆盖率、最优性与共形预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将共形预测与反事实决策相结合的新框架（PC-RACP），通过引入“策略耦合覆盖”概念，在保证覆盖率的同时实现了决策效用的最大化。
AI.motivation: 现有的不确定性量化方法（如共形预测）虽然保证了统计有效性，但未能直接解决反事实场景下决策的最优性问题，即不确定性与决策规则存在耦合关系。
AI.method: 开发了一个决策理论框架，引入“策略耦合覆盖”概念，并提出“策略耦合风险规避共形预测”（PC-RACP）的两阶段过程来近似最优预测集。
AI.result: 理论证明了策略耦合覆盖在分布模糊下的极小极大最优性，并通过模拟和真实实验验证了PC-RACP在保持有效覆盖的同时，比现有方法能提供更高的决策效用。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的PC-RACP方法在保证有限样本覆盖的前提下，通过策略耦合覆盖实现了反事实决策的效用最大化，证明了在决策过程中必须显式考虑反事实结构。
AI.translation: 预测越来越多地用于指导高风险决策，从治疗选择到政策制定。为了确保不完美预测的可靠性，共形预测等不确定性量化方法构建了具有覆盖保证的预测集。然而，仅统计有效性并不直接决定应采取的决策及其最优性。这种差距在反事实设置中尤为微妙，因为实现的结果取决于所采取的行动，因此不确定性不能独立于决策规则来指定。我们开发了一个用于不确定性感知反事实决策的决策理论框架。我们确定了一种新的“策略耦合覆盖”概念——即在预测集本身诱导的行动下实现结果的覆盖——作为不确定性与行动之间最优且无损的接口。它起到了三个作用。首先，它证明了在分布模糊下通过自然极大极小规则行动是极小极大最优的。其次，在策略耦合覆盖下优化预测集等同于更强的通用覆盖公式，也等同于对策略和效用证书的直接风险规避优化；这种等价性产生了群体最优预测集的显式形式。第三，它承认一个两阶段过程，即策略耦合风险规避共形预测（PC-RACP），该过程以严格的有限样本覆盖近似这些最优集。模拟和真实的电子邮件营销实验证实，PC-RACP在保持有效覆盖的同时，比现有方法提供了更高的效用，并且忽视决策问题的反事实结构对于有效性和效用都是次优的。
AI.summary: 本文针对反事实决策中的不确定性问题，提出了一种新的“策略耦合覆盖”概念，构建了一个决策理论框架。通过该框架，作者开发了PC-RACP算法，在保证统计覆盖的前提下，实现了反事实决策的效用最大化，解决了传统共形预测在决策场景下的局限性。
AI.keywords: 反事实决策, 共形预测, 策略耦合覆盖, 不确定性量化, 风险规避
AI.comments: 该论文通过提出“策略耦合覆盖”（policy-coupled coverage）这一创新概念，成功弥合了不确定性量化（共形预测）与因果决策之间的鸿沟。其贡献在于不仅提供了理论上的最优性证明，还给出了实用的算法实现，对于处理高风险、反事实场景下的决策问题具有重要的指导意义。

title: An Additive MLP-GNN Framework for Characterizing Chemical and Structural Contributions to Aqueous Solubility
summary: Aqueous solubility is a key property in early-stage drug discovery, but most predictive models merge physicochemical descriptors and molecular graph information into a single representation, obscuring whether a prediction is driven by global chemistry, molecular structure, or both. We present an additive deep-learning framework that keeps these two sources of information separate throughout training: physicochemical descriptors are encoded by a multilayer perceptron (the chemical branch) and molecular graph topology by a graph neural network (the structural branch), with the two outputs combined only at the prediction stage through an additive model with an optional multiplicative interaction. This design provides a direct decomposition of chemical and structural components that can be examined separately after training. Furthermore, pretraining on the larger AqSolDB dataset and fine-tuning on the smaller BigSolDB2 dataset substantially improve accuracy and reduce run-to-run variations, indicating generalizability of the learned features from the data-rich settings. We further interpret the fitted model using best linear projections of the branch outputs, molecule-level embedding summaries across solubility classes, and atom-level GNNExplainer masks aggregated over functional groups. These analyses show that the chemical branch aligns with familiar physicochemical descriptors, while the structural branch captures graph-topological and functional-group patterns associated with solubility. Across both datasets, the framework attains competitive predictive performance while making the distinct roles of chemical and structural information more transparent.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于表征化学和结构对水溶性贡献的加性MLP-GNN框架
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种可解耦化学和结构特征的加性深度学习模型，在实现精准水溶性预测的同时，提供了关于分子特征贡献的透明解释。
AI.motivation: 现有的水溶性预测模型通常将物理化学描述符与分子图信息融合，导致无法明确区分预测结果是由全局化学属性还是分子结构特征驱动。
AI.method: 提出一种加性深度学习框架，将物理化学描述符（通过MLP处理）和分子图拓扑（通过GNN处理）保持分离，仅在预测阶段进行加性结合（可选乘性交互）；并结合预训练与微调策略及多种可解释性分析技术。
AI.result: 模型在多个数据集上取得了具有竞争力的预测性能，同时能够直观地分解并解释化学分支与结构分支对溶解度的具体贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该加性MLP-GNN框架不仅在溶解度预测任务上表现出竞争力，还通过架构设计实现了化学与结构贡献的透明化，为药物分子性质预测提供了更具解释性的新路径。
AI.translation: 水溶性是药物早期发现中的关键性质，但大多数预测模型将物理化学描述符和分子图信息合并为单一表示，从而掩盖了预测结果是由全局化学性质、分子结构还是两者共同驱动的。我们提出了一种加性深度学习框架，在整个训练过程中保持这两类信息分离：物理化学描述符由多层感知机（化学分支）编码，分子图拓扑由图神经网络（结构分支）编码，两者的输出仅在预测阶段通过具有可选乘性交互的加性模型进行结合。这种设计提供了化学和结构组件的直接分解，可以在训练后分别进行检查。此外，在较大的AqSolDB数据集上进行预训练并在较小的BigSolDB2数据集上进行微调，显著提高了准确性并减少了运行间的差异，表明了所学特征在数据丰富环境下的通用性。我们进一步利用分支输出的最佳线性投影、跨溶解度类别的分子级嵌入摘要以及跨官能团聚合的原子级GNNExplainer掩码来解释拟合模型。这些分析表明，化学分支与熟悉的物理化学描述符一致，而结构分支捕捉到了与溶解度相关的图拓扑和官能团模式。在两个数据集上，该框架在保持竞争性预测性能的同时，使化学和结构信息的作用更加透明。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新型的加性MLP-GNN框架，通过在训练过程中保持化学描述符与分子图结构的分离，实现了对水溶性预测中化学和结构贡献的解耦，并结合预训练策略提升了预测精度与可解释性。
AI.keywords: 水溶性预测, 深度学习, 图神经网络, 多层感知机, 可解释性AI
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于引入了一种可解释的加性架构，有效解耦了化学描述符与分子图拓扑特征，克服了传统黑盒模型难以区分不同特征贡献的局限性。这对药物发现中理解溶解度驱动因素具有重要的应用价值。

title: Aggregation with Exponential Weights is Optimal in Expectation
summary: The aggregation with exponential weights (AEW) estimator is not fully understood in the basic setting of model selection aggregation with squared loss. In particular, whether it is minimax-rate optimal in expectation for large enough fixed temperatures and under random design has been an open problem since its introduction, which was explicitly posed by Lecué and Mendelson (2013). In this paper, we settle this problem by showing that \emph{without} requiring a Bernstein-type assumption, the AEW indeed achieves the excess risk $T \log (M) / (n+1)$ in expectation, whenever the temperature $T$ satisfies $(L^2/T)\exp(B/T)\leq μ/2$. Here, the number of dictionary elements is $M$, the estimator has observed $n$ i.i.d. samples from any distribution, and the loss is assumed to be bounded by $B$, $L$-Lipschitz continuous and $μ$-strongly convex. For squared loss, we show that $T\geq 4 b^2$ suffices when the predictions and labels are $[0,b]$-valued. Because AEW is known to be suboptimal in expectation for temperatures below some constant, this shows that AEW has a sharp phase transition when the temperature is large enough but constant, as conjectured by Lecué and Mendelson.

title: Conceptual completeness for subgeometric logics
summary: We explore the notion of conceptual completeness for a fragment of geometric logic in the framework developed by the first and third author. Unlike its traditional interpretation as a reconstruction of syntax from semantics, in this paper we characterise conceptual completeness of a fixed fragment in terms of a duality between theories and topoi. We then show that conceptually complete fragments are conservatively embedded in full geometric logic, thus casting conceptual completeness in a new proof-theoretic light. We give a new proof of conceptual completeness for coherent logic, and we also show that regular, disjunctive, and essentially algebraic logic with falsum are conceptually complete. Finally, we show that our notion is equivalent to a traditional reconstruction result under the assumption of completeness with respect to set-based models: in the coherent case, we thus recover Makkai's original reconstruction theorem via ultracategories.

AI.title_translation: 次几何逻辑的概念完备性
AI.tldr: 本文通过对偶性框架重构了几何逻辑片段的“概念完备性”，证明了这些片段在几何逻辑中的保守性，并统一了多种逻辑系统的完备性结论。
AI.motivation: 旨在重新审视几何逻辑片段中的“概念完备性”，摆脱传统仅从语义中重构语法的视角，探索其在对偶性框架下的表现及其证明论意义。
AI.method: 利用理论与拓扑之间的对偶性来刻画片段的概念完备性，并利用保守嵌入分析其证明论性质。通过对比分析，证明了该定义在特定假设下与传统语义重构结果的等价性。
AI.result: 证明了概念完备的逻辑片段在几何逻辑中是保守嵌入的；证明了相干逻辑、正则逻辑、析取逻辑及本质代数逻辑（含假命题）是概念完备的；并证明了其定义在集合模型完备性假设下与传统重构定理等价。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，概念完备性可以被理解为理论与拓扑之间的对偶，且概念完备的片段在几何逻辑中是保守嵌入的。此外，该工作成功统一了多种逻辑片段的完备性，并与Makkai的经典重构定理建立了联系。
AI.translation: 我们探讨了作者此前开发的几何逻辑框架中一个片段的概念完备性概念。与将其解释为从语义中重构语法的传统方式不同，本文根据理论与拓扑之间的对偶性来刻画固定片段的概念完备性。随后我们证明，概念完备的片段在完全几何逻辑中是保守嵌入的，从而以新的证明论视角审视了概念完备性。我们给出了相干逻辑概念完备性的新证明，并证明了正则逻辑、析取逻辑以及带有假命题的本质代数逻辑也是概念完备的。最后，我们证明了在对基于集合的模型完备性假设下，我们的概念与传统的重构结果是等价的：在相干逻辑的情形下，我们通过超范畴（ultracategories）恢复了Makkai的原始重构定理。
AI.summary: 本文在几何逻辑框架下探讨了概念完备性，将其重新表述为理论与拓扑之间的对偶关系，而非传统的语义重构。研究揭示了概念完备片段在几何逻辑中的保守嵌入性，并为相干逻辑、正则逻辑等多种逻辑片段提供了统一的概念完备性证明，同时联系了Makkai的重构定理。
AI.keywords: 概念完备性, 几何逻辑, 拓扑, 对偶性, 保守嵌入
AI.comments: 该论文通过将“概念完备性”从传统的语义重构视角转向理论与拓扑之间的对偶性，为几何逻辑的片段研究提供了新的视角。其创新之处在于将这一概念与证明论中的保守扩展联系起来，并统一了多种逻辑片段的完备性证明。局限性在于该方法高度依赖于范畴论框架，对于非专业读者门槛较高。

title: Stable Self-Modulating Quantum Fast-Weight Programmers with Bounded Memory Gates
summary: Quantum Fast-Weight Programmers (QFWPs) store temporal information in dynamically programmed variational-circuit parameters rather than in nonlinear recurrent hidden states, offering a practical route to quantum sequence modeling. Self-Modulating QFWP improves this framework by using input-dependent gates for both new fast-weight updates and the accumulated fast-weight state, but its unbounded old-state multiplier can diverge in long-sequence regimes. We propose a bounded old-state modulation rule that applies a sign-preserving tanh gate only to the recurrent memory branch while leaving the additive update and new-update modulation unchanged. We evaluate standard QFWP, full Self-Modulating QFWP, Only-New, and Only-Old variants on two CUDA-Q quantum-dynamics forecasting tasks and on Milan SMS telecommunication activity prediction. The quantum-dynamics results show that old-state modulation is the most consistent source of improvement over Standard QFWP, and that bounding the old-state gate removes long-sequence divergence while improving aggregate robustness. On Milan SMS forecasting, the original unbounded Self-Modulating QFWP converges across the tested grid and shows its clearest gains at longer input windows, with behavior close to the Only-Old ablation. These findings identify accumulated-memory modulation as the key mechanism of Self-Modulating QFWP and bounded old-state gating as a targeted stabilization strategy.

title: The Dual Nature of LLM Persona: Aggregated Tendencies and Frame-Dependent Geometry
summary: Evaluations of LLM personas via psychometric questionnaires typically rely on aggregate scores, discarding within-instance correlation structure. We test whether this geometric structure is intrinsic or frame-dependent. Constructing within-instance correlation matrices from IPIP-50 responses, we analyze geometry on SPD manifolds under manipulated question orderings in GPT-4o simulating American and Chinese-American personas. We find that persona expression comprises two dissociable components: aggregated features (Big Five scores) degrade under randomization (21% drop) but are frame-robust; geometric features (SPD manifold) collapse under frame misalignment (42% drop) but recover substantially (to 84%) under shared frames, surpassing aggregated features (76%). This collapse-recovery pattern reveals that persona geometry is not intrinsic but a frame-dependent coordination pattern encoding information invisible to aggregation. Our findings establish a dual-nature framework for LLM personas, frame-dependent geometry versus frame-robust aggregates, necessitating frame-aware evaluation and challenging static trait conceptions.

title: Q-GAIN: A Python Package for Machine Learning and Physically Informed Analysis Applications
comments: Submission to SciPost, 20 pages with 4 figures
summary: Here we describe the quantum gas analysis and inference (Q-GAIN) Python package, which enables rapid deployment of machine learning (ML) and physics-informed analysis techniques for cold-atom experiments. Out of the box, Q-GAIN implements classification, object detection, and physics-informed metrics for feature detection in images of atomic Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs). Q-GAIN encourages a natural, module-based workflow: starting with data loading and preprocessing, followed by ML-based feature identification, and ending with conventional analysis techniques. We demonstrate this modularity by configuring Q-GAIN for three ML tasks. First, we demonstrate the basic workflow of the Q-GAIN framework by implementing the standard task of classifying handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset. Then, we re-implement our earlier soliton detection (SolDet) package in the Q-GAIN framework, enabling the detection and analysis of solitonic excitations in time-of-flight data. Finally, we develop an object-detection tool that identifies quantized vortices in images of ring-shaped BECs.
