AI.title_translation: 大规模基于复现的自主审查：从计算物理论文复现中涌现的批判性分析
AI.tldr: 通过自主复现计算物理论文，AI智能体能发现近半数论文中存在的方法论缺陷，且其发现问题的能力远超仅通过阅读论文的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体多在机器学习沙盒中工作，但在计算物理等依赖第一性原理且需要严格复现的科学领域，AI能否通过自主复现实现对已发表论文的有效审查仍未可知。
AI.method: 利用Claude Opus 4.6配置，构建“阅读-计划-计算-对比”的自主循环，对111篇量子计算（Quantum ESPRESSO）论文进行大规模复现，并对特定论文进行深入的批判性分析。
AI.result: 在大规模实验中，智能体对42%的论文提出了实质性方法论质疑，其中96.6%的质疑源于计算复现而非单纯阅读；在个案研究中，智能体成功发现并修正了一篇顶级期刊论文的核心数据错误，且发现了原同行评审未察觉的物理边界问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，自主智能体能够通过“阅读-计划-计算-对比”循环，在计算物理领域进行有效的、基于复现的批判性审查，发现传统人工评审难以触及的方法论漏洞。
AI.translation: 自主大语言模型智能体现在可以在机器学习沙盒中生成完整的科研成果，但真实的计算物理要困难得多：实验是针对可复现的物理真理进行的第一性原理计算，且有意义的新工作几乎总是建立在关键的现有论文之上。我们探讨了这种智能体是否可以对已发表的计算物理论文进行有根据的审查——即阅读论文、从零开始复现，并通过执行过程提出方法论上的担忧。我们在两个互补的范围内部署了一个Claude Opus 4.6配置。在大规模范围内，智能体对111篇开放获取的Quantum ESPRESSO论文运行“阅读-计划-计算-对比”循环，尽管从未被要求进行批判，但对约42%的论文提出了实质性的方法论担忧；这些批判中有85/88（96.6%）是在智能体实际运行计算后才出现的，而仅通过阅读的发现率上限仅为1.8%。批判源于复现，而非阅读。在深入研究中，针对一篇关于二维材料MOSFET多尺度器件模拟的《自然-通讯》论文，一个继承了验证过的复现流程的新智能体自主生成了一份包含14项物理审查清单，并撰写了一份完整的、符合投稿格式的六页评论，修正了该论文关于L_G = 5 nm的标题结论。其对L_G = 5 nm这一核心结论发起的两次挑战——源极退化接触电阻界限和锑掺杂退化比——在已发表的21位审稿人的同行评审中均未提及。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了自主大语言模型智能体在计算物理领域进行“基于复现的审查”的能力。通过对111篇量子计算论文的大规模复现测试，研究发现智能体能在执行计算后有效识别出方法论缺陷，其发现问题的能力远超仅通过阅读论文的水平，并能自主撰写高质量的同行评审意见。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 计算物理, 可复现性, 同行评审, 自主智能体
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入“基于复现的批判”这一范式，展示了AI在科学同行评审中的巨大潜力。其核心创新在于证明了仅靠“阅读”无法发现深层次的方法论问题，必须通过“计算复现”才能实现有效的科学审查。这项工作对于提高科学研究的严谨性和自动化同行评审具有重要意义，但也对现有的学术出版流程提出了挑战。

title: ChemGraph-XANES: An Agentic Framework for XANES Simulation and Curation
summary: Computational X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) is widely used to interpret local coordination environments, oxidation states, and electronic structure in chemically complex systems. In practice, routine computational XANES at scale is often constrained by workflow complexity rather than by the simulation method. We present ChemGraph-XANES, a large-language-model (LLM)-based agentic framework for XANES simulation and analysis that combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-assisted parameter selection from documentation, schema-constrained tool execution, deterministic FDMNES input generation, and provenance-aware data curation. The framework supports both direct scripted execution and natural-language orchestration, with both modes routed through a deterministic backend for structure handling, absorber and edge specification, input generation, execution, spectral extraction, and post-processing. We demonstrate three proof-of-capability use cases: RAG-assisted selection and propagation of FDMNES input parameters, structure-file-based execution, and chemistry-level natural-language specification of absorber and composition requests. In a recorded trace, a simulation parameter is retrieved from the FDMNES manual by the RAG-enabled agent and propagated into a schema-validated tool call, illustrating traceable parameter selection. We further show that the same execution pathway supports both explicit local structures and chemistry-level user inputs. Because XANES calculations are independent once inputs are defined, ChemGraph-XANES is designed to support task-parallel execution and the creation of structure-linked XANES collections. ChemGraph-XANES therefore serves as a practical agentic framework for computational spectroscopy and data generation, emphasizing constrained orchestration, reproducibility, and traceable outputs.

title: A Unified Lyapunov-IQC Framework for Uniform Stability of Smooth Quadratic First-Order Accelerated Optimizers
comments: Minor revisions, mostly comprised of making notation more consistent across paper and correcting a few details in some proofs
summary: We develop a unified Lyapunov-integral quadratic constraint (IQC) framework for establishing uniform stability of first-order accelerated optimization algorithms in the $β$-smooth and $γ$-strongly convex regime. Classical analyses of uniform stability, such as the work of Hardt, Recht, and Singer for stochastic gradient descent (SGD), rely on direct coupling arguments and case-by-case control of iterate differences under random sampling. Extending such arguments to accelerated methods, such as Nesterov Accelerated Gradient (NAG), is complicated by the presence of higher-order state dynamics induced by momentum. We first extend this classical approach with the use of Lyapunov functions to provide a uniform stability bound for smooth quadratic NAG, and supplement this result with small-scale numerical experiments. We then extend this framework by modeling first-order accelerated optimizers as Lur'e-type feedback interconnections between a linear dynamical system and a (non-linear) gradient operator. $β$-Smoothness and $γ$-strong convexity are encoded a sector IQC inequality. Under this representation, uniform stability is certified via the existence of a quadratic Lyapunov function satisfying a finite-dimensional linear matrix inequality (LMI) in the form of a feasibility problem, which can be solved via semi-definite programming (SDP). We instantiate this framework for NAG and show how classical uniform stability bounds can be recovered via this framework. These results underscore a structural connection between optimization dynamics and robust control theory, providing a modular methodology for reliable and reproducible numerical certification of uniform stability and generalization behavior of first-order methods via convex optimization tools that is adaptable to increasingly complex optimization algorithms.

title: See Silhouettes in Motion with Neuromorphic Vision
comments: 13 pages, 15 figures, and 5 tables. This work is under review. Project page: https://github.com/pz-even/event_binarization
summary: Quasi-bimodal objects, such as text, road signs, and barcodes, play a basic yet vital role in daily visual communication. By boiling these down to clear silhouettes, binarization uses a minimal language to convey essential vision cues for maximum downstream efficiency, especially for tasks that require simple geometric, topological reasoning rather than heavy appearance modeling. The catch is that frame-based imaging often struggles on mobile platforms like drones, self-driving cars, and underwater vehicles, in which rapid motion causes severe motion blur and harsh lighting washes out scene details. To overcome these physical limits, neuromorphic vision via event cameras, featuring microsecond time resolution and high dynamic range, steps in as a natural solution. Building upon this event-driven paradigm, we propose a simple yet effective dual-modal approach that harnesses the synergy between frames and events for training-free, real-time, high-frame-rate binarization on CPU-only devices. Extensive evaluations show that it earns competitive performance against leading techniques in reducing blur artifacts and delivers impressive improvements under challenging illumination at a lower computational cost. Besides, its asynchronous nature bypasses long-standing event-scarcity issues that break traditional time-binning reconstruction at fixed time slots, maintaining clear target shapes even at extreme kilohertz frame rates. Its binary results further serve as reliable representations to facilitate a range of downstream tasks. This work paves the way towards lightweight perception and interaction in embodied intelligence on resource-constrained edge platforms.

title: Global Convergence of Control-Based Lagrangian Flows for Non-Convex Optimization
summary: This paper studies the continuous-time dynamics generated by control-theoretic Lagrangian methods for equality-constrained optimization. In particular, we consider dynamics induced by proportional-integral and feedback linearization controllers, which have recently been proposed as alternatives to primal-dual gradient methods. Unlike global convergence results for these dynamics, which rely on strong convexity of the objective function or boundedness assumptions, we exploit the geometric structure induced by the constraints. Specifically, we show global exponential convergence for non-convex problems that satisfy a suitable convexity property when restricted to the constraint manifold.

title: Inversion of the Multiplicative Matrix Compound Operator
summary: We study the problem of determining a matrix whose $k$th multiplicative compound, with $k > 1$, is a prescribed matrix $M$. The cardinality of the set of matrices whose $k$th multiplicative compound equals $M$ is characterized in terms of $\rank(M)$. On the one hand, if $\rank(M)\le 1$, it is shown that there exist infinitely many such matrices for which a complete characterization is determined. On the other hand, if $\rank(M)>1$, then there exists a unique matrix -- up to an overall sign -- whose compound is $M$. An algorithm for finding a matrix whose compound equals $M$ is detailed, and its time complexity is analyzed.

title: Gradient-Flow Optimization as Dynamic Random-Effects Inference: Testing and Early Stopping with Applications to Deep Learning
summary: Gradient-flow optimization is usually viewed as an algorithmic procedure for minimizing empirical loss, with training duration selected by validation or heuristic early stopping rules. We develop a statistical inference framework for gradient-flow training. We show that whenever fitted values evolve through a time-invariant positive semidefinite training operator, the output at each time is equivalent to the best linear unbiased predictor under a corresponding random-effects model. Training time then becomes a variance-component parameter governing variance reallocation from residual noise to structured signal. This turns two training decisions into inferential problems: whether training is needed becomes a variance-component test for signal beyond initialization, and how long to train becomes restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimation of the training-time variance component. We show that the REML-guided early stopping rule selects the time at which optimized spectral losses become decorrelated from the training-operator eigenvalues. The asymptotic prediction optimality of the REML-guided early stopping time is established for fixed-design in-sample risk and random-design out-of-sample risk. Deep learning models in fixed-kernel gradient regimes provide canonical instantiations for our results. Numerical experiments and a UK Biobank proteomics application show competitive accuracy of the REML-guided early stopping time with reduced reliance on validation splits and repeated checkpoint evaluation.

title: Cassini's identity for k-bonacci numbers
summary: Efforts have been made to extend Cassini's identity (also known as Simson's identity) to the k-step or k-bonacci numbers for decades. These efforts have lacked both completeness of result and simplicity of proof, and this question remains open and relevant. In this note, we offer a definitive solution as well as the generalization of both Catalan's and Vajda's identities.

title: Nonlocal Mean Field Schrödinger Bridge with Learned Interactions
summary: The Schrödinger Bridge Problem connects an initial distribution to a terminal one along a minimum-energy stochastic process. Its mean-field extension, the Mean-Field Schrödinger Bridge, governs interacting populations whose dynamics and costs depend on the collective distribution. When these interactions are nonlocal, their direct evaluation scales quadratically with the population size, making large ensembles intractable within FBSDE-based solvers. We replace these terms with neural surrogates in state and time, trained on empirical interaction values along sampled trajectories and embedded in a four-stage alternating scheme that updates the forward and backward potentials and the surrogates in turn, while preserving forward--backward consistency and the prescribed endpoint marginals. We derive Grönwall-type stability bounds quantifying how surrogate errors propagate to the generated trajectories under a small-gain condition. On crowd-navigation and high-dimensional opinion-dynamics benchmarks, the surrogates reproduce the trajectories obtained with exact evaluation at reduced training cost. The advantage is most significant when the interaction is a nonlinear functional of the measure, such as the normalized bounded-confidence drift, for which random-batch subsampling is biased and unstable whereas the learned surrogate remains accurate.

title: Pointwise Complexity for Gaussian Fields: Upper Envelopes, Algorithmic Lower Bounds, and Separation
summary:
We prove a variance-aware pointwise majorizing-measure theorem for centered Gaussian processes. Classical generic chaining characterizes the scalar quantity $\mathbb E\sup_{x\in T}X_x$; the theorem here gives a simultaneous high-probability envelope for the entire field. For an ambient prior $μ$, the envelope at $x$ is governed by a pointwise Fernique-Talagrand functional \[Φ_μ(x):=\int_0^{4σ(x)}\sqrt{\log\frac{1}{μ(B_d(x,\varepsilon))}}\,d\varepsilon,\] together with the corresponding Gaussian tail term. The theorem provides a reusable field-level refinement of classical generic chaining and a Gaussian-process counterpart of pointwise empirical-process bounds for deep neural networks.
  We also record a Bayesian algorithmic lower envelope from the interactive Fano/data-processing principle. For a known prior $π$, an observation channel, and a concrete estimator $\widehat t(Y)$, the lower bound is expressed through the exact ghost small-ball mass $\mathbb E_{Y\sim Q}π(B_d(\widehat t(Y),Δ))$, rather than a worst-case covering number. In Gaussian location experiments, comparison decoders convert Bayes location error into lower bounds on decision-aligned Gaussian ranges. We then construct an elementary example separating the usual Fano relaxation, the Bayesian algorithmic lower envelope, the pointwise Gaussian envelope, and the full-class minimax risk. Together, these results show that algorithmic lower bounds provide local-geometric validations of pointwise complexity for fixed estimators in overparameterized ambient classes, precisely in regimes where classical minimax theory becomes either too coarse or oracle-dependent.
  This separation can also be recast in minimax language as penalty-range information relaxation, highlighting an important question of algorithmic robustness for classical high-dimensional models and regularized algorithms.

title: LLM can Read Spectrogram: Encoder-free Speech-Language Modeling
summary: Recent speech-aware large language models (Speech-LLMs) rely on pre-trained speech encoders to convert audio into semantic/acoustic rich representations consumable by LLM. In this work, instead, we explore: can an LLM learn to read Mel spectrogram directly without a dedicated speech encoder? We propose Mel-LLM, an encoder-free Speech-LLM that feeds lightly pre-processed Mel-spectrogram patches directly into the LLM through a linear projection, allowing the LLM to learn speech-text alignment purely through its own parameters. We focus on speech understanding tasks, including automatic speech recognition (ASR), spoken QA and audio understanding. For ASR, we evaluate on the OpenASR Leaderboard public sets and production-level scaling experiments, demonstrating that the encoder-free solution achieves competitive performance with only limited degradation compared to encoder-initialized counterparts. We find that when data is limited, initialization from a multimodal checkpoint (Phi-4-MM) is crucial for maintaining performance. We also present ablation studies suggesting which LLM layers are most involved in speech adaptation. Beyond ASR, we extend Mel-LLM with general speech/audio understanding tasks, revealing an acoustic-semantic trade-off: directly exposing the LLM to Mel-spectrogram input improves paralinguistic and non-ASR acoustic tasks, while knowledge-intensive spoken QA remains more challenging than encoder-anchored systems. We additionally include a text-to-speech (TTS) proof-of-concept with a next-token VAE decoder, showing that direct Mel generation is possible but still trails stronger latent-diffusion generation.

title: Estimating Individualized Treatment Effects in Acute Ischemic Stroke with Causal Transformation Models (TRAM-DAG): A Multi-Centre Observational Study with External RCT Validation
summary: Personalized medicine in acute ischemic stroke requires moving beyond average treatment effects (ATE) to individualized treatment effect (ITE) estimates to support treatment decisions. In acute ischemic stroke, mechanical thrombectomy has been shown to be more effective on average than lysis in randomized controlled trials (RCTs), such as the MR CLEAN study. We aim to identify which individual patients benefit most from mechanical thrombectomy compared to lysis. The outcome of interest is the modified Rankin Scale (mRS) at three months, an ordinal measure of functional disability (0: no symptoms, 6: death). We demonstrate that causal transformation models on directed acyclic graphs (TRAM-DAG) can be used for ITE estimation after being fitted on observational MAGIC multi-center stroke patient data. To ensure comparability with the MR CLEAN population, which we use for validation, we train the TRAM-DAG on a MAGIC sub-population with NIHSS at admission >= 6, corresponding to one inclusion criterion of MR CLEAN. The fitted model is then used to estimate ITEs for stroke patients in the MR CLEAN population. While these ITE estimates cannot be confirmed experimentally, we show that their average is consistent with the trial's reported ATE. Furthermore, the ITE estimates correctly rank trial patients by their observed frequency of a good outcome (mRS at three months <= 2). These findings support the use of causal models like TRAM-DAG for personalized decision-making in stroke care and highlight their ability to bridge the gap between observational evidence and clinical trials.

title: DDPO-VC: Speaker De-Identification via Diffusion Denoising Policy Optimization
summary: A key challenge of speaker de-identification is the balance between privacy and utility. Many utility variables, such as the cognitive health status of the speaker, are correlated with the privacy variable, such as the speaker identity, violating the independence assumption held by the disentanglement-based approaches, causing leakage of private information and the loss of useful information for downstream tasks. To tackle this challenge, we propose a general framework, DDPO-VC, for speaker de-identification through reinforcement learning-based post-training with diffusion models. Learning from reward signals combining knowledge from privacy-focused and utility-focused teachers, our method outperforms various strong \deid/ methods in both privacy preservation and cognitive utility on two commonly used dementia speech benchmarks. Please check out our code\footnote{\href{https://github.com/cactuswiththoughts/DDPO-VC}{https://github.com/cactuswiththoughts/DDPO-VC}} and demo\footnote{\href{https://cactuswiththoughts.github.io/SpeakerDeID-Demo/}{https://cactuswiththoughts.github.io/SpeakerDeID-Demo/}}.

title: Horizon-Uniform Sensitivity Certificates for Finite-Horizon Pontryagin Systems
summary: Finite-horizon optimal-control computations repeatedly solve two-point Pontryagin boundary value problems whose conditioning can deteriorate as the horizon grows. We give a verifiable data-level certificate under which it does not. Hyperbolicity of the reduced state--costate transition matrix, together with scaled stable--unstable boundary transversality, yields an endpoint-corrected Green inverse with horizon-independent constants and weighted contractions transfer this inverse to the nonlinear problem, so the original Pontryagin endpoint rows $x_0=x_{\rm in}$ and $p_T=r_x(x_T,y)$ carry a unique local stationary branch whose first-order expansion and Lipschitz constants are uniform in the horizon. Consequently the finite-horizon feedback map is horizon-uniformly Lipschitz, first-order expandable, and satisfies an exact shrinking-horizon consistency identity. Symplectic and Riccati criteria certify the hypotheses from matrix data: every stabilizable definite linear-quadratic system with invertible dynamics and a locally concave terminal Hessian at the reference qualifies. Reproducible computations illustrate both certificates.

AI.title_translation: 有限时域庞特里亚金系统中的时域一致敏感性证书
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可验证的数据级证书，用于解决有限时域最优控制中庞特里亚金边界值问题随时间增长条件恶化的问题，确保了解决方案在时域上的均匀性。
AI.motivation: 有限时域最优控制计算中，庞特里亚金两点边界值问题的条件数会随着时域的增长而恶化。
AI.method: 通过约化状态-协态转移矩阵的双曲性以及标度稳定-不稳定边界横截性，得到一个时域无关常数的端点校正格林逆。然后，加权收缩将此逆转移到非线性问题。此外，采用辛和Riccati准则从矩阵数据中验证假设。
AI.result: 得到了一个唯一的局部平稳分支，其一阶展开和Lipschitz常数在时域上是均匀的。因此，有限时域反馈映射是时域一致Lipschitz的，一阶可展开的，并满足精确的收缩时域一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个可验证的数据级证书，确保了有限时域最优控制问题中庞特里亚金边界值解的条件数不会随着时域增长而恶化，并且解决方案在时域上具有均匀的性质。
AI.translation: 有限时域最优控制计算反复求解两点庞特里亚金边值问题，其条件数可能随着时域的增长而恶化。我们给出了一个可验证的数据级证书，在该证书下，这种情况不会发生。约化状态-协态转移矩阵的双曲性，结合标度稳定-不稳定边界横截性，产生了一个具有时域无关常数的端点校正格林逆。加权收缩将此逆转移到非线性问题，因此原始庞特里亚金端点行 $x_0=x_{m in}$ 和 $p_T=r_x(x_T,y)$ 承载一个唯一的局部平稳分支，其一阶展开和Lipschitz常数在时域上是均匀的。因此，有限时域反馈映射是时域一致Lipschitz的，一阶可展开的，并满足精确的收缩时域一致性。辛和Riccati准则从矩阵数据中验证了这些假设：每个具有可逆动力学和在参考点处局部凹终端Hessian的可镇定定线性二次系统都符合条件。可重现的计算说明了这两种证书。
AI.summary: 本文针对有限时域最优控制中庞特里亚金边界值问题条件数随时间增长而恶化的问题，提出了一种可验证的数据级证书。通过利用约化状态-协态转移矩阵的双曲性和边界横截性，构造了一个时域无关的格林逆，并将其应用于非线性问题。研究表明，由此产生的解决方案具有唯一的局部平稳分支，其性质（如一阶展开和Lipschitz常数）在时域上是均匀的。这确保了有限时域反馈映射的时域一致Lipschitz特性和一阶可展开性，并满足精确的收缩时域一致性。辛和Riccati准则可用于从矩阵数据中验证这些假设。
AI.keywords: 庞特里亚金系统, 最优控制, 敏感性证书, 时域一致性, 边界值问题
AI.comments: 这项工作在最优控制领域具有重要意义，因为它解决了一个实际问题，即有限时域庞特里亚金系统在长时域下条件恶化的问题。通过引入“时域一致敏感性证书”，该研究为确保计算稳定性和解的均匀性提供了一个理论上严谨且可验证的框架。其创新点在于结合了约化状态-协态转移矩阵的双曲性、边界横截性以及加权收缩技术，将理论结果推广到非线性问题，并提供了明确的验证标准。

title: Patnaik-Pearson intrinsic dimension for internal representations of neural networks
comments: 35 pages, 19 figures. Version Two : Minor edits and corrections
summary: We define a new measure of intrinsic dimension of a data manifold, which we call the Patnaik-Pearson dimension, and apply this to internal representations of neural networks, in particular transformers. The inspiration for this comes from the HTSR and SETOL work of Martin, Mahoney and Hinrichs, combined with the TwoNN intrinsic dimension estimator of Facco et al. We prove various properties of this intrinsic dimension estimator. Treating weight matrices of neural networks as data manifolds, for weight matrices whose Empirical Spectral Density follows a Pareto (Power Law) distribution, we relate the Patnaik-Pearson dimension to the HTSR and SETOL analysis, and show that critical values of the tail exponent coincide for the two approaches. Using a combination of theoretical and numerical techniques, we study the behaviour of the Patnaik-Pearson dimension of a data manifold under the transformations typical to neural networks. We apply this machinery to the BERT-base and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1 models, to investigate first the Patnaik-Pearson dimension of the initial data manifold of token embeddings, and second the evolution of the Patnaik-Pearson dimension as token embeddings pass through the layers of the model. Code and notebooks used for the numerical results presented here is available at https://github.com/tdhadfield/PatnaikPearson

AI.title_translation: 神经网络内部表示的Patnaik-Pearson内在维度
AI.tldr: 本文定义了一种新的数据流形内在维度度量方法，称为Patnaik-Pearson维度，并将其应用于神经网络（特别是Transformer）的内部表示，研究其性质、与现有方法的联系以及在模型层级中的演变。
AI.motivation: 作者的灵感来源于Martin、Mahoney和Hinrichs的HTSR和SETOL工作，并结合了Facco等人的TwoNN内在维度估计器，旨在定义和应用一种新的内在维度度量方法来分析神经网络的内部表示。
AI.method: 本文定义了Patnaik-Pearson维度，并证明了其各种性质。将神经网络的权重矩阵视为数据流形，对于其经验谱密度遵循Pareto分布的情况，将Patnaik-Pearson维度与HTSR和SETOL分析联系起来。通过理论和数值技术结合，研究了数据流形在神经网络典型变换下的Patnaik-Pearson维度行为。将该方法应用于BERT-base和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1模型，分析了初始令牌嵌入的Patnaik-Pearson维度以及其在模型层级中的演变。
AI.result: 本文定义了Patnaik-Pearson维度并证明了其各种性质。对于经验谱密度遵循Pareto分布的权重矩阵，Patnaik-Pearson维度与HTSR和SETOL分析相关联，并表明尾部指数的临界值在这两种方法中是一致的。研究了Patnaik-Pearson维度在神经网络典型变换下的行为。在BERT-base和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1模型上，分析了令牌嵌入的Patnaik-Pearson维度及其在模型层级中的演变。
AI.translation: 我们定义了一种新的数据流形内在维度度量方法，我们称之为Patnaik-Pearson维度，并将其应用于神经网络，特别是Transformer的内部表示。其灵感来源于Martin、Mahoney和Hinrichs的HTSR和SETOL工作，并结合了Facco等人的TwoNN内在维度估计器。我们证明了这种内在维度估计器的各种性质。将神经网络的权重矩阵视为数据流形，对于其经验谱密度遵循Pareto（幂律）分布的权重矩阵，我们将Patnaik-Pearson维度与HTSR和SETOL分析联系起来，并表明尾部指数的临界值在这两种方法中是一致的。通过理论和数值技术的结合，我们研究了数据流形在神经网络典型变换下的Patnaik-Pearson维度行为。我们将这一机制应用于BERT-base和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1模型，首先调查令牌嵌入初始数据流形的Patnaik-Pearson维度，其次调查当令牌嵌入通过模型层时Patnaik-Pearson维度的演变。用于此处数值结果的代码和笔记本可在https://github.com/tdhadfield/PatnaikPearson 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Patnaik-Pearson维度的新型内在维度度量方法，并将其应用于分析神经网络（特别是Transformer）的内部表示。该方法结合了HTSR/SETOL工作和TwoNN估计器的思想。研究证明了该维度估计器的性质，并将其与Pareto分布的权重矩阵的HTSR/SETOL分析联系起来，发现尾部指数的临界值一致。通过理论和数值方法，论文探讨了Patnaik-Pearson维度在神经网络变换下的行为，并将其应用于BERT-base和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1模型，以研究令牌嵌入的维度及其在模型层中的演变。
AI.keywords: Patnaik-Pearson维度, 内在维度, 神经网络, Transformer, 内部表示
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的内在维度度量方法，Patnaik-Pearson维度，并将其应用于神经网络内部表示的分析，这对于理解神经网络学习过程中的数据流形复杂性具有重要意义。其创新之处在于结合了现有理论，并提供了理论证明和数值验证，特别是对Transformer模型内部表示的维度演变研究，为神经网络的可解释性研究提供了新的工具和视角。

title: Orthogonal Discrepancy Kernels for Learning with Partial Physics
summary: We introduce a semi-parametric framework for nonlinear system identification, which decouples discrepancy functions from physics-based components. Orthogonal Gaussian process regression balances sparse parameter selection (the white box) with discrepancy learning (the black box) to produce interpretable models from incomplete physics.

AI.title_translation: 用于部分物理信息学习的正交差异核
AI.tldr: 通过正交高斯过程回归，将不完整的物理模型与黑盒差异学习相结合，实现既可解释又准确的非线性系统辨识。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理模型通常是不完整的，无法完全描述复杂的非线性系统，而纯数据驱动的黑盒模型缺乏可解释性，因此需要一种既能利用物理先验又能弥补物理缺失的建模方法。
AI.method: 引入了一种半参数化框架，利用正交高斯过程回归（Orthogonal Gaussian process regression）将物理模型组件与差异函数（discrepancy functions）进行解耦，并结合稀疏参数选择来构建模型。
AI.result: 成功实现了物理组件与差异函数的解耦，在不完整物理模型的基础上构建出了具有可解释性的非线性系统辨识模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功地平衡了物理模型的透明度与黑盒模型的数据拟合能力，为处理不完整物理信息系统提供了一种鲁棒且可解释的识别方案。
AI.translation: 我们引入了一种用于非线性系统辨识的半参数化框架，将差异函数与基于物理的组件进行解耦。正交高斯过程回归平衡了稀疏参数选择（白盒）与差异学习（黑盒），从而从不完整的物理信息中生成可解释的模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于非线性系统辨识的半参数化框架。该方法通过正交高斯过程回归将物理模型与差异函数分离，通过稀疏参数选择平衡物理先验与数据驱动的黑盒学习，从而在物理模型信息不完整的情况下实现高效且可解释的系统建模。
AI.keywords: 非线性系统辨识, 正交高斯过程回归, 半参数化框架, 物理信息机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的半参数化框架，将物理模型（白盒）与数据驱动的差异学习（黑盒）相结合。通过正交高斯过程回归实现稀疏参数选择，既保留了物理的可解释性，又弥补了不完整物理模型的预测能力，是解决复杂系统建模中模型失配问题的一种有效方法。

title: List $3$-coloring $C_4$-free graphs of diameter-$2$ in polynomial-time
summary: We show that list $3$-coloring a~$C_4$-free graph of diameter-$2$ can be done in polynomial-time. Our algorithm is based on a structural characterization showing that many such graphs are not~$3$-colorable. In particular, we show that~$C_4$-free graphs of diameter-$2$ without universal vertices, where the maximum degree is at least~$17$, are not~$3$-colorable.

AI.title_translation: 直径为2且无C4的图的列表3-着色问题的多项式时间解法
AI.tldr: 证明了直径为2且无C4的图的列表3-着色问题可在多项式时间内解决。
AI.motivation: 探索在特定图结构约束（无C4且直径为2）下，列表3-着色问题的计算复杂性，旨在寻找多项式时间解法。
AI.method: 通过结构化特征刻画，证明了在特定条件下（如无通用顶点且最大度数至少为17）该类图不可3-着色，并据此设计了多项式时间算法。
AI.result: 证明了C4-free且直径为2的图的列表3-着色问题是多项式时间可解的，并给出了关于该类图不可着色的结构性判据。
AI.conclusion: 直径为2且无C4的图的列表3-着色问题可以在多项式时间内完成。
AI.translation: 我们证明了直径为2且无C4的图的列表3-着色问题可以在多项式时间内完成。我们的算法基于一种结构化刻画，表明许多此类图是不可3-着色的。特别地，我们证明了在没有通用顶点且最大度数至少为17的情况下，直径为2且无C4的图是不可3-着色的。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了直径为2且不包含C4子图的图的列表3-着色问题。研究表明，此类图的列表3-着色问题可以在多项式时间内解决，并揭示了当图中不存在通用顶点且最大度数达到一定阈值（17）时，该类图通常不具备3-可着色性。
AI.keywords: 列表3-着色, C4-free图, 直径-2, 多项式时间, 图论算法
AI.comments: 该论文通过结构化分析，将一个看似困难的图论问题（列表3-着色）转化为在特定约束条件（无C4、直径为2）下的多项式时间可解问题。其创新点在于利用图的结构性质（如无通用顶点且最大度数较大时不可着色）来缩小搜索空间，具有显著的理论价值。

title: A Geometry-Adaptive Regularized Newton-Type Method for Manifold-Affine Intersection Problems
summary: We propose Regularized Newton-SLRA (RN-SLRA), a regularized Newton-type method for local manifold--affine intersection problems motivated by structured low-rank approximation. Classical Newton-SLRA achieves fast local convergence under transversality, but its tangent-space intersection step may become ill-defined, singular, or severely ill-conditioned when transversality fails. RN-SLRA overcomes this difficulty by replacing the exact tangent-space intersection step with a regularized quadratic subproblem over the affine space. Under intrinsic transversality, we prove local linear convergence to the intersection. Under transversality, we show that a residual-dependent choice of the regularization parameter yields higher-order local convergence; in particular, the method converges quadratically for the linear residual rule. We also analyze an inexact variant based on quasioptimal manifold projections. When the quasioptimality constant is sufficiently accurate, the inexact method retains local residual convergence. Numerical experiments on constructed degenerate SLRA instances and Hankel-structured examples illustrate the robustness of RN-SLRA in settings where Newton-SLRA may fail, and show that the inexact variant can reduce the projection cost in large-scale problems.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于流形-仿射交集问题的几何自适应正则化牛顿型方法
AI.tldr: RN-SLRA 通过正则化策略解决了传统牛顿法在流形-仿射交集问题中因横截性失效导致的数值不稳定问题，并保证了高效的收敛性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的 Newton-SLRA 方法在横截性失效时，其切空间交集步骤可能变得定义模糊、奇异或病态，导致计算失败。为了解决这一数值不稳定性问题，研究者提出了 RN-SLRA。
AI.method: 提出了一种称为 RN-SLRA 的正则化牛顿型方法。通过将传统的切空间交集步骤替换为仿射空间上的正则化二次子问题，并在不同横截性条件下分析了收敛性，同时引入了基于拟最优流形投影的不精确变体以降低计算成本。
AI.result: RN-SLRA 在横截性失效的情况下表现出良好的鲁棒性。理论上证明了在内在横截性下具有局部线性收敛，在横截性条件下具有高阶局部收敛（线性残差规则下为二次收敛）。数值实验证明了该方法在退化 SLRA 实例中的有效性，且不精确变体能显著降低大规模问题的投影成本。
AI.conclusion: RN-SLRA 是一种稳健的求解流形-仿射交集问题的数值方法，通过正则化策略有效弥补了传统牛顿法在退化情况下的缺陷，并保证了良好的收敛性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种正则化牛顿型方法（RN-SLRA），用于解决受结构化低秩近似启发产生的局部流形-仿射交集问题。经典的 Newton-SLRA 在横截性条件下可实现快速局部收敛，但当横截性失效时，其切空间交集步骤可能变得定义模糊、奇异或严重病态。RN-SLRA 通过用仿射空间上的正则化二次子问题代替精确的切空间交集步骤，克服了这一困难。在内在横截性条件下，我们证明了其对交点的局部线性收敛；在横截性条件下，我们展示了通过残差相关的正则化参数选择可以获得高阶局部收敛，特别是对于线性残差规则，该方法呈二次收敛。我们还分析了一种基于拟最优流形投影的不精确变体。当拟最优常数足够精确时，该不精确方法保留了局部残差收敛性。针对构建的退化 SLRA 实例和 Hankel 结构示例的数值实验证明了 RN-SLRA 在 Newton-SLRA 可能失效的环境下的鲁棒性，并显示不精确变体可以降低大规模问题中的投影成本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 RN-SLRA 的正则化牛顿型方法，专门用于解决流形-仿射交集问题。该方法通过引入正则化二次子问题替代传统的切空间交集步骤，有效解决了传统方法在横截性失效时的数值不稳定性，并证明了其在多种条件下的收敛性及鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 流形-仿射交集, 正则化牛顿法, 结构化低秩近似, 局部收敛, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入正则化策略，成功解决了经典牛顿法在流形-仿射交集问题中因横截性失效而导致的数值不稳定问题。其创新点在于将切空间交集步骤转化为正则化二次子问题，具有很强的理论深度和实际应用价值，特别是在处理结构化低秩近似（SLRA）等大规模问题时表现出良好的鲁棒性。

title: Spectral Geometry and Bosonic-Bloch Probes: Explorations in Quantum Learning
summary: This paper studies how spectral geometry emerges in quantum learning models and how it can be diagnosed with physically grounded probes. In graph-regularized quantum networks, training reorganizes the output similarity graph, increases the effective spectral dimension Delta S = +0.23, and reshapes the Laplacian spectrum. Edge-resolved two-boson interference directly probes this restructuring: the bosonic enhancement Delta P_uv correlates with the Fiedler edge split |Delta v_2| (r = -0.50), linking learned spectral partitions to interference signatures. A phase diagram shows a nonmonotonic dependence of performance on coupling strength gamma and noise delta, with graph regularization improving fidelity only in a restricted regime; hardware experiments confirm the predicted interference behavior within shot-noise uncertainty. We also analyze a hybrid quantum autoencoder and introduce Bloch-space drift as a geometric diagnostic of its latent representation. With an unsupervised benign-data threshold, the model achieves high ranking performance (ROC-AUC about 0.99) and negligible false-negative rates. Absolute Bloch drift strongly discriminates anomalies (ROC-AUC at least about 0.9), while consecutive drift is near random (ROC-AUC about 0.5), showing that detection arises from persistent state-space displacement rather than local fluctuations. Through the geometry of reduced single-qubit states and associated quantum Fisher information, these results show that learning-induced spectral organization appears as measurable quantum-state structure, establishing a unified spectral-geometric framework for diagnosing quantum learning systems with bosonic and Bloch probes.

AI.title_translation: 谱几何与玻色子-Bloch探针：量子学习探索
AI.tldr: 本文提出了利用玻色子干涉和Bloch空间漂移作为物理探针，通过谱几何视角诊断和理解量子学习模型的内部结构与性能。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究量子学习模型中谱几何的涌现机制，并寻找物理上可实现的探针来诊断和理解量子学习系统的内部结构与性能表现。
AI.method: 利用图正则化量子网络进行训练，通过边分辨双玻色子干涉（bosonic interference）探测拉普拉斯谱变化，并引入Bloch空间漂移（Bloch-space drift）作为混合量子自编码器潜在表示的几何诊断工具。
AI.result: 实验发现训练增加了有效谱维数，玻色子增强与Fiedler边分割存在相关性；混合量子自编码器在异常检测中表现出色（ROC-AUC约0.99），且Bloch漂移能有效区分异常。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一个统一的谱几何框架，证明了量子学习引起的谱组织表现为可测量的量子态结构，并验证了玻色子和Bloch探针在诊断量子学习系统中的有效性。
AI.translation: 本文研究了谱几何如何在量子学习模型中涌现，以及如何利用物理基础探针进行诊断。在图正则化量子网络中，训练重组了输出相似度图，增加了有效谱维数（Delta S = +0.23），并重塑了拉普拉斯谱。边分辨双玻色子干涉直接探测了这种重构：玻色子增强 Delta P_uv 与Fiedler边分割 |Delta v_2| 相关（r = -0.50），将学习到的谱分区与干涉特征联系起来。性能的相图显示了其对耦合强度 gamma 和噪声 delta 的非单调依赖性；硬件实验证实了预测的干涉行为。此外，我们分析了混合量子自编码器，并引入Bloch空间漂移作为其潜在表示的几何诊断工具。该模型在无监督良性数据阈值下实现了高性能（ROC-AUC约0.99）。绝对Bloch漂移能有效区分异常（ROC-AUC至少约0.9），表明检测源于持久的状态空间位移而非局部波动。通过约化单量子位态的几何结构及相关的量子Fisher信息，这些结果表明学习诱导的谱组织表现为可测量的量子态结构，为诊断量子学习系统建立了一个统一的谱几何框架。
AI.summary: 本文通过谱几何视角分析量子学习模型，揭示了训练过程如何重构网络谱结构。研究利用玻色子干涉和Bloch空间漂移作为物理探针，量化了学习引起的几何变化，并验证了这些几何特征在量子网络诊断和异常检测中的高度有效性。
AI.keywords: 量子学习, 谱几何, 玻色子干涉, Bloch空间漂移, 量子网络
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将谱几何理论引入量子机器学习的可解释性研究中，通过玻色子干涉和Bloch空间漂移这两种物理可观测探针，成功将抽象的量子网络学习行为与具体的几何结构变化联系起来，为量子算法的诊断提供了物理学视角。

title: Sample Complexities of Estimating Gumbel--Max Watermark Proportions with and without Reduction to Pivotal Statistics
summary: Watermarking promises statistical traceability of large language model (LLM) uses, but real documents rarely arrive as purely human-written or purely LLM-generated. This motivates a quantitative question beyond detection: what proportion of a document is generated from a pre-specified watermarked LLM? We study this watermark proportion estimation problem under the Gumbel--max watermarking mechanism, treating the next-token prediction distributions as unknown and arbitrary nuisance parameters subject to a non-degeneracy condition. We compare two observation regimes: in the full observation regime, the estimator observes the pseudorandom vector and the selected token at each position; in the more prevalent setting of pivotal reduction, it observes only a scalar pivot, which follows a one-dimensional Uniform--Beta mixture distribution. Under pivotal reduction, we develop a Laguerre-polynomial estimator and establish a matching information-theoretic lower bound for the sample complexity. For full observation, we introduce an event-counting estimator and show a matching lower bound, yielding a substantially smaller sample complexity. As our results imply, although reducing to pivotal statistics is an elegant and prevalent choice, it is not always sample-efficient for estimating the proportion of watermarks.

AI.title_translation: Gumbel-Max水印比例估计的样本复杂度：关于枢轴统计量约简的分析
AI.tldr: 本文证明了在估计LLM生成内容比例时，直接利用完整观测数据比仅使用常见的枢轴统计量更具样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有水印研究多关注二分类检测，但实际场景中文档往往是人类与LLM混合生成的。因此，量化估计文档中LLM生成内容的比例成为了一个关键的统计学问题。
AI.method: 针对枢轴约简方案，开发了拉盖尔（Laguerre）多项式估计器；针对全观测方案，引入了事件计数估计器，并推导了相应的样本复杂度信息论下界。
AI.result: 研究发现，全观测方案下的样本复杂度显著低于枢轴约简方案。理论分析证明了这两种方案下的估计器均达到了各自的信息论下界。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，为了实现更高效的水印比例估计，应尽量避免仅依赖枢轴统计量，而应考虑利用全观测信息。
AI.translation: 水印技术为大语言模型（LLM）使用的统计可追溯性提供了保障，但现实中的文档很少是纯粹由人类编写或纯粹由LLM生成的。这引出了一个超越检测的定量问题：文档中有多少比例的内容是由预设的水印LLM生成的？本文研究了Gumbel-max水印机制下的水印比例估计问题，将下一个token的预测分布视为未知且任意的干扰参数，并满足非退化条件。我们比较了两种观测方案：在全观测方案中，估计器观察每个位置的伪随机向量和选定的token；在更常见的枢轴约简设置中，它仅观察一个标量枢轴，该枢轴服从一维均匀-贝塔混合分布。对于枢轴约简，我们开发了一个拉盖尔（Laguerre）多项式估计器，并建立了匹配的信息论样本复杂度下界。对于全观测，我们引入了一个事件计数估计器并展示了匹配的下界，这产生了显著更小的样本复杂度。正如我们的结果所暗示的那样，尽管约简为枢轴统计量是一种优雅且普遍的选择，但在估计水印比例时，它并不总是样本高效的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在Gumbel-max水印机制下，估计文档中LLM生成内容比例的问题。作者比较了两种观测方案：仅观测枢轴统计量和观测完整信息。研究发现，虽然枢轴约简方法很常见，但其在样本效率上逊色于全观测方法，并为两者分别推导了相应的样本复杂度下界。
AI.keywords: LLM水印, Gumbel-Max机制, 样本复杂度, 比例估计, 枢轴统计量
AI.comments: 该论文通过理论分析揭示了在LLM水印比例估计中，常见的“枢轴统计量（pivotal statistics）”简化方法虽然优雅，但在样本效率上往往不如直接利用完整观测数据。这一发现对水印追踪系统的设计具有重要的理论指导意义。

title: Alternating Optimization for Joint Resource Allocation in Full-Duplex Multi-Sector Fluid Antenna-Enabled Near-Field Systems
summary: This paper proposes a full duplex fluid antenna near field system (FD-FANS) with a multi-sector antenna array that jointly exploits resource allocation, antenna mobility, and group-based transmitting (TX) and receiving (RX) partitioning. A spherical wave uplink downlink channel is established that accounts for residual self interference (SI), wireless energy transfer (WET), and geometric constraints on antenna motion. Within the FD-FANS framework, an efficient protocol is devised to enable simultaneous downlink energy transmission (DET) and uplink data transmission (UDT) at the base station (BS). Furthermore, we formulate, for both perfect and imperfect SI cancellation (SIC), a weighted sum rate (WSR) maximization problem over time power allocation, antenna positions, and binary group selection, under practical average and peak power limits, per antenna box constraints, minimum spacing, and a half TX half RX balance. To tackle the resulting non convex mixed integer design, we develop an efficient alternating optimization (AO) framework based on majorization minimization successive convex approximation (MM SCA). The proposed algorithm monotonically improves the objective and converges to a stationary solution of a continuous relaxation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves consistent performance gains over several benchmark designs, including half duplex FANS (HD FANS), FD fixed position antenna near field system (FD FPANS), non-grouped FD FANS, and far field counterparts, in terms of average sum rate (ASR), energy efficiency (EE), and user fairness, while exhibiting robustness to residual SI and channel uncertainty.

title: Generalizable framework of eating episode detection on free-living wrist-worn wearable data
comments: This manuscript has been submitted to a peer-reviewed journal and is currently under review
summary: Accurate assessment of eating behavior is essential for understanding and managing conditions such as eating disorders, obesity, and diabetes. Wearable-based food intake detection has shown considerable promise; however, most existing approaches are trained and evaluated using internal validation on a single dataset with fixed sensor orientation and known wearing hand, which limits their generalizability to real-world settings. Furthermore, many existing approaches rely on both accelerometer (acc) and gyroscope (gyro) signals to achieve strong performance. However, gyro measurements may be unavailable in some real-world deployments due to battery constraints, and performance often degrades when only acc data are used. We propose a generalizable framework for orientation-invariant eating episode detection, with an acc2gyro module to improve performance in acc-only settings. The framework is trained using fine-grained wrist-worn datasets and externally validated across three heterogeneous datasets: the Clemson All-Day (CAD) and Capture-24 datasets, as well as Physio-ED, a dataset collected from individuals with eating disorders. Across external evaluations, the proposed framework demonstrates robust performance despite substantial variations in sensor modality, wearing hand, participant population, and annotation protocols. Specifically, the framework achieved F1-scores of 0.751, 0.592, and 0.793 on CAD, Capture-24, and Physio-ED, respectively, with CAD performance exceeding recent state-of-the-art methods evaluated using internal validation only. This study provides the first external validation of eating episode detection in an eating disorder population. Additionally, the acc2gyro module improves the performance in acc-only settings. These findings demonstrate the potential of orientation-invariant wearable sensing for scalable and clinically applicable assessment of eating behavior.
comment: This manuscript has been submitted to a peer-reviewed journal and is currently under review

title: Channel Knowledge Map Reconstruction From Sparse Measurements via Pilot-Anchored Layout-Conditioned Fourier Refinement
comments: 13 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications
summary: Channel knowledge maps (CKMs) enable environment-aware wireless systems by providing location-specific channel knowledge, but long-term environmental variations, such as construction, traffic redistribution, and foliage changes, require periodic map refresh. In practice, channel measurements are often sparse and irregular, while environmental knowledge may be limited to coarse layout or topology descriptors. This paper studies CKM reconstruction from sparse measurements. We show that reconstruction pipelines that apply local aggregation or spectral operators directly to a zero-filled pilot grid can entangle the sampling mask with the channel field, allowing structural priors to act on mask-induced distortions before the measurements define a supported radio field. To address this issue, we propose Anchor-CKM, a measurement-first, knowledge-aided reconstruction framework. Anchor-CKM first uses support-aware partial convolutions to construct a pilot-supported representation, and then performs layout-conditioned dual-path Fourier refinement followed by coordinate-based heteroscedastic prediction of the CKM mean and per-location predictive variance. Experiments on transmitter-disjoint DeepMIMO scenarios cover missing ratios from 0.3 to 0.95, including stringent 5% to 10% pilot-coverage settings. In explicit-layout outdoor scenarios, Anchor-CKM reduces received-power root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 0.79 to 1.33 dB relative to the strongest reproduced baseline, while ablations identify pilot-support stabilization as the largest contributor and layout conditioning as beneficial for line-of-sight/non-line-of-sight (LOS/NLOS) boundary fidelity.
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications

AI.title_translation: 基于飞行员锚定布局条件傅里叶细化的稀疏测量信道知识图谱重建
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Anchor-CKM的新框架，通过飞行员锚定和布局条件下的傅里叶细化，有效解决了稀疏测量下信道知识图谱重建不准确的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的CKM重建方法在处理稀疏、不规则测量时，容易将采样掩码与信道场混淆，导致重建出的信道场包含由采样引起的失真，且难以有效利用有限的环境布局信息。
AI.method: 提出Anchor-CKM框架：首先利用支持感知的部分卷积构建飞行员支持表示，随后执行布局条件的双路径傅里叶细化，最后通过基于坐标的异方差预测来估计CKM均值和位置预测方差。
AI.result: 在DeepMIMO场景中，即使在5%到10%的极低飞行员覆盖率下，Anchor-CKM仍能将接收功率的均方根误差（RMSE）较最优基线降低0.79至1.33 dB，并显著提升了视距/非视距（LOS/NLOS）边界的重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: Anchor-CKM框架通过飞行员支持的卷积和布局条件傅里叶细化，在稀疏测量条件下实现了高效、高精度的CKM重建，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.translation: 信道知识图谱（CKM）通过提供特定位置的信道知识，实现了环境感知无线系统，但诸如施工、交通重分配和植被变化等长期环境变化需要定期刷新地图。在实践中，信道测量往往是稀疏且不规则的，而环境知识可能仅限于粗略的布局或拓扑描述。本文研究了从稀疏测量中重建CKM的问题。我们发现，直接将局部聚合或谱算子应用于零填充飞行员网格的重建流水线，会将采样掩码与信道场纠缠在一起，使得结构先验在测量定义支持的无线电场之前，作用于掩码引起的失真。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Anchor-CKM，这是一个测量优先、知识辅助的重建框架。Anchor-CKM首先使用支持感知的部分卷积来构建飞行员支持的表示，然后执行布局条件的双路径傅里叶细化，随后进行基于坐标的CKM均值和每位置预测方差的异方差预测。在发射机不相交的DeepMIMO场景上的实验涵盖了0.3到0.95的缺失率，包括严格的5%到10%的飞行员覆盖设置。在显式布局的室外场景中，Anchor-CKM相对于最强的复现基线，将接收功率均方根误差（RMSE）降低了0.79至1.33 dB，而消融实验确定了飞行员支持稳定化是最大的贡献因素，布局条件对视距/非视距（LOS/NLOS）边界保真度有益。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Anchor-CKM的新型框架，旨在从稀疏且不规则的测量数据中重建信道知识图谱。该方法通过飞行员锚定和布局条件下的傅里叶细化技术，成功解耦了采样掩码与信道场，并在极低测量覆盖率下实现了高精度的信道特征预测。实验证明，该方法在复杂环境下的重建质量和边界识别能力均优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 信道知识图谱, 稀疏测量, 傅里叶细化, 环境感知, 无线通信
AI.comments: 该研究针对信道知识图谱（CKM）在稀疏测量下的重建难题，提出了一种创新的“测量优先、知识辅助”框架。其核心贡献在于通过飞行员锚定和布局条件傅里叶细化，有效解耦了采样掩码与信道场，解决了传统方法中因采样不规则导致的伪影问题。该方法在极度稀疏（5%-10%覆盖率）的场景下表现出极强的鲁棒性，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Beyond Words: Towards Effective Modeling of Non-Verbal Vocalizations in ASR
summary: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems excel at transcribing lexical content but often omit nonverbal vocalizations (NVs), such as laughter, breaths, coughs, and cries, that carry conversational and affective information. Modeling NVs in ASR is challenging because NV annotations are sparse and highly long-tailed, with frequent categories such as breaths and laughter dominating rarer events such as cries and coughs. We study three data-centric strategies for improving low-resource NV recognition: (1) a two-stage curriculum that first maps all NV events to a generic token and then fine-tunes on target categories; (2) inter-token transfer from high-resource events, such as laughter and breath, to rare events, such as crying; and (3) voice-conversion augmentation with class balancing. Experiments show that shared acoustic structure across vocal events can be exploited to improve rare-category detection while preserving lexical ASR quality.

title: Waveform Design for Underwater Simultaneous Acoustic Information and Power Transfer
summary: Simultaneous acoustic information and power transfer (SAIPT) plays a crucial role in enabling self-sustainable and maintenance-free Internet of Underwater Things (IoUT) networks. This paper studies a multicarrier underwater SAIPT system that jointly considers the frequency-dependent characteristics of acoustic transducers and the nonlinear behavior of rectifier circuits. The waveform vector is firstly optimized using the successive convex approximation (SCA) method under constraints on average and peak transmit power for acoustic power transfer (APT). Then, in the SAIPT scenario, both the power splitting factor and waveform vectors are jointly optimized through an alternating optimization (AO) framework based on SCA, subject to transmit power and achievable rate constraints. Simulation results demonstrate that incorporating the transducer's frequency response, rectifier nonlinearity, and the high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of multicarrier waveforms leads to a significant improvement in acoustic energy transfer efficiency. The results also show that the energy harvesting DC output can be further enhanced by properly choosing system parameters, such as the number of subcarriers and subcarrier spacing.

title: Enhancing Acoustic-to-Articulatory Inversion with Multi-Target Pretraining for Low-Resource Settings
summary: Acoustic-to-Articulatory Inversion (AAI) estimates vocal tract articulator movements from speech, benefiting tasks like ASR, speech synthesis, and speaker verification. While deep learning-based methods (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers) have advanced AAI, recent studies show that Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) features further enhance performance, particularly in low-resource settings. However, SSL feature extractors introduce inference latency and computational overhead. To address this, we propose a novel pretraining method leveraging three target representations-Phoneme Labels, Articulatory Feature Labels, and Critical-articulator Labels-eliminating the need for an SSL extractor during inference. We evaluate our approach against both baseline and SSL-based models across various data conditions. Results demonstrate that our method consistently improves AAI performance, particularly in low-resource scenarios, while significantly reducing inference costs without sacrificing accuracy.

title: Rethinking Fractional Programming for Joint Uplink Scheduling and Power Control in Multicell Wireless Networks
summary: This paper investigates the joint uplink scheduling and power control problem in a coordinated multicell wireless network, where at most one single-antenna user is allowed to access the single-antenna base station in each cell simultaneously. The resulting weighted sum-rate (WSR) maximization problem is a mixed discrete-continuous, nonconvex optimization problem that is notoriously difficult to solve directly. Classical fractional programming (FP) methods tackle this problem by leveraging the Lagrangian dual transform (LDT) followed by the quadratic transform (QT), yielding a tractable closed-form solution for scheduling and power control, with the LDT playing a crucial role in handling discrete variables. In this paper, we revisit the LDT from a minorization-maximization (MM) perspective and observe that its induced surrogate is somehow conservative due to the reciprocal-coordinate construction. Motivated by this observation, we propose a novel reciprocal-inversion transform (RIT) that constructs a tighter first-order Taylor expansion lower bound for the logarithmic rate function. The proposed RIT remains fully compatible with the QT, leading to a surrogate-enhanced FP (SEFP) algorithm for joint uplink scheduling and power control. The proposed SEFP algorithm retains the desirable per-cell separability of the classical FP framework and admits closed-form updates for the auxiliary variables, scheduling decisions, and transmit powers. Simulation results demonstrate that the SEFP algorithm consistently outperforms the classical FP method and other baselines for different network utilities.

title: Integrated Wake-Up Radio and MIMO Solution for Cellular IoT Networks
comments: To appear in the IEEE Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC) Fall 2026
summary: Wake-up radio (WUR) is a technology designed to enhance the energy efficiency of Internet of Things (IoT) networks and extend device battery life. While most studies focus on WUR performance with single-antenna base stations, this paper investigates the multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technology to improve device energy saving and extend the coverage of wake-up signals. By leveraging MIMO beamforming, the transmitted energy can be spatially focused toward the intended IoT devices, with high beamforming gain and minimal inter-device interference. We develop a preliminary analytical framework using stochastic geometry to evaluate the wake-up success probability of WUR-MIMO in multi-cell cellular IoT networks, when the number of antennas equals $2 \times (\text{number of devices}) - 1$. Monte Carlo simulations show that, relative to a single-antenna WUR baseline, MIMO beamforming significantly enhances wake-up reliability when this antenna configuration is applied, mitigates more than 50% of false activations across all settings, and thereby prolongs the lifetime of IoT devices.
comment: To appear in the IEEE Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC) Fall 2026

title: Antenna System for Simultaneous Wireless Power and Information Transfer to Brain Implants
comments: Published at IMBioC 2024. Part of the B-CRATOS project, Horizon 2020 FET-OPEN, grant 965044
summary: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) have revolutionized neuroscience applications, from motor rehabilitation to neuroergonomics. Traditional implantable BCIs with invasive microelectrode arrays pose challenges, notably the need for wired connections and inherent implantation risks. This paper introduces a battery-free wireless BCI system, consolidating an implant and its external supporting system. Our design centers on a dual-function antenna system: firstly, an inductive coupling mechanism enables wireless power transfer, sufficiently powering the implant's Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) for stimulation and readout without an implant battery. Secondly, a backscatter antenna in the implant facilitates battery-free, high-data-rate wireless connectivity (up to 32 Mbps). This system not only enhances the BCI experience by eliminating wires but also retains data fidelity and energy efficiency, promising a safer, more efficient interface for tasks like robotic arm control.

title: LMPAN: A Lightweight Multi-Path Alignment Network for Joint Full-Duplex Acoustic Echo Cancellation and Noise Suppression
summary: We propose a lightweight multi-path alignment network (LMPAN) for on-device joint acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) and noise suppression (NS) in full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. To address hardware-induced distortions and dynamic acoustic conditions, we introduce three core innovations: (1) a multi-path alignment stage correcting temporal and energy mismatches across reference, linear AEC (LAEC) output, and microphone signals; (2) an attention-based mechanism that dynamically integrates enhanced LAEC and microphone features under varying acoustic scenarios; (3) a post-filtering module with a dynamic target generation strategy for downstream tasks (ASR, VAD). Furthermore, we adopt a two-stage training framework leveraging self-supervised learning representations to enhance perceptual quality. Experiments show that LMPAN, with only 480K parameters and 126 MACs, achieves performance comparable to the state-of-the-art lightweight model DeepVQE-S, while ensuring real-time inference capability.

title: Three-Dimensional Spatial Correlation Modeling for Cylindrical mMIMO Arrays in HAPS
summary: High-altitude platform stations (HAPS) are envisioned as a key component of future wireless networks, enabling ultra-wide coverage and providing direct connectivity to users with cylindrical massive multiple-input multiple-output (mMIMO) systems. Exploiting the channel degrees of freedom necessitates accurate modeling and characterization of three-dimensional (3D) channels in the presence of spatial correlation functions (SCFs). However, existing spatial correlation models are primarily developed for planar or linear antenna arrays and cannot be directly applied to cylindrical geometries commonly adopted by HAPS platforms. To address this limitation, this paper derives an exact closed-form expression for the SCF of 3D MIMO channels with antenna elements arranged in a cylindrical array. The proposed formulation is based on the spherical harmonic expansion (SHE) of plane waves and accommodates arbitrary antenna radiation patterns and angular distributions through the Fourier series (FS) coefficients of the power azimuth and zenith spectra. The derived SCF is validated through Monte Carlo simulations under standard-compliant settings.

AI.title_translation: 高空平台站中圆柱形大规模MIMO阵列的三维空间相关性建模
AI.tldr: 本文推导了适用于HAPS圆柱形大规模MIMO阵列的3D信道空间相关函数（SCF）的精确闭合表达式，并通过仿真验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间相关性模型主要针对平面或线性天线阵列设计，无法直接应用于高空平台站（HAPS）通常采用的圆柱形几何结构，因此需要建立精确的圆柱形大规模MIMO阵列三维（3D）信道空间相关性模型。
AI.method: 基于平面波的球面谐波展开（SHE），并结合功率方位角和仰角谱的傅里叶级数（FS）系数，推导出适用于圆柱形天线阵列的3D MIMO信道空间相关函数（SCF）的精确闭合形式表达式。该方法能够适应任意的天线辐射方向图和角度分布。
AI.result: 成功推导出了圆柱形大规模MIMO阵列3D信道SCF的精确闭合形式表达式，并在符合标准的设置下通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了该公式的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 本文推导出的圆柱形阵列3D MIMO信道空间相关函数（SCF）的精确闭合表达式，为高空平台站（HAPS）通信系统中的信道表征和自由度挖掘提供了重要的理论基础。
AI.translation: 高空平台站（HAPS）被视为未来无线网络的重要组成部分，能够通过圆柱形大规模多输入多输出（mMIMO）系统实现超宽覆盖并为用户提供直接连接。利用信道自由度需要存在空间相关函数（SCF）时对三维（3D）信道进行精确建模和表征。然而，现有的空间相关模型主要针对平面或线性天线阵列开发，无法直接应用于HAPS平台通常采用的圆柱形几何结构。为了解决这一限制，本文推导了天线单元排列为圆柱形阵列的3D MIMO信道SCF的精确闭合形式表达式。所提出的公式基于平面波的球面谐波展开（SHE），并通过功率方位角和仰角谱的傅里叶级数（FS）系数来适应任意天线辐射方向图和角度分布。通过在符合标准的设置下进行蒙特卡洛模拟，验证了所推导的SCF。
AI.summary: 本文针对高空平台站（HAPS）中常用的圆柱形大规模MIMO系统，提出了一种精确的三维信道空间相关函数（SCF）闭合形式表达式。该方法利用球面谐波展开和傅里叶级数，能够兼容任意天线辐射方向图及角度分布，填补了现有平面或线性天线阵列模型的局限，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 高空平台站 (HAPS), 圆柱形大规模MIMO, 空间相关函数 (SCF), 球面谐波展开, 三维信道建模
AI.comments: 该研究成功填补了圆柱形大规模MIMO阵列在3D信道空间相关性建模领域的空白，突破了传统平面或线性阵列模型的局限性。其创新的地方在于利用球面谐波展开（SHE）和傅里叶级数（FS）系数，推导出了一种能够适应任意天线辐射方向图和角度分布的精确闭合表达式，对于未来高空平台站（HAPS）通信系统的设计和优化具有重要的理论和实用价值。

title: Complexity-Scalable Direct Geolocation and Cancellation of Terrestrial GNSS Jammers: Single-Satellite and Multi-Antenna Experiments in Low Earth Orbit
comments: 15 pages, 15 figures, submitted to ION GNSS+ 2026
summary: Monitoring the radio-frequency (RF) spectrum from space imposes demanding requirements to satellite platforms in terms of communication bandwidth and computational resources, which are necessary for the downlink, the storage, and the processing of high-throughput I/Q samples. This paper analyzes in depth the quasi-direct geolocation (QDG) as a technique to enable the exploitation of satellites of opportunity in low Earth orbit (LEO) to sense the spectrum in the bands of global navigation satellite systems (GNSS). This is a technique of passive RF geolocation and consists of an ensemble of signal processing algorithms, which compress the I/Q samples and process the compressed data through fast delay-Doppler shift matching and interferometry in a quantized time-frequency domain. These algorithms speed up the exhaustive search of multiple RF sources in the position domain. The efficiency gain addresses the bottleneck that prevents the employment of satellites, which are limited in downlink capacity and on-board computational power. These satellites are usually constrained in size, weight and power (SWaP) and represent most of the spacecrafts in LEO. The ability to exploit assets as such for the geolocation of terrestrial GNSS jammers in near real time is instrumental the performance of a multi-constellation GNSS RFI monitoring system. The present work describes the mathematical framework and precision bounds, introduces single- and multi-antenna uses cases, combines different compression methods, and evaluates the geolocation accuracy with real data. The I/Q samples were collected by a repurposed GNSS reflectometry (GNSS-R) satellite, OPS-SAT PRETTY, in a dedicated test session during Jammertest 2025. The experimental results demonstrate the capability to geolocate GNSS jammers with different signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) with extremely high compression ratios.
comment: 15 pages, 15 figures, submitted to ION GNSS+ 2026

AI.title_translation: 低地球轨道单卫星和多天线实验：面向复杂性可扩展的地面GNSS干扰源的直接地理定位和消除
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为准直接地理定位（QDG）的技术，利用低地球轨道（LEO）的“机会卫星”来监测GNSS频谱。QDG通过压缩IQ样本并进行时频域处理，提高了处理效率，解决了卫星平台带宽和计算能力的限制。实验证明，该技术能够高压缩比地定位不同信噪比的GNSS干扰源。
AI.motivation: 监测射频频谱需要大量的通信带宽和计算资源，这对受限于尺寸、重量和功率（SWaP）的低地球轨道（LEO）卫星构成了挑战。利用这些卫星进行GNSS干扰源的地理定位，对于多星座GNSS射频干扰（RFI）监测系统至关重要。
AI.method: 该论文深入分析了准直接地理定位（QDG）技术，这是一种被动的射频地理定位技术。它包括一系列信号处理算法，能在量化时频域中压缩IQ样本，并通过快速延迟-多普勒频移匹配和干涉测量来处理压缩数据。这种方法可以加速在位置域中对多个射频源的穷举搜索。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该技术能够以极高的压缩比精确定位具有不同信噪比（SNR）的GNSS干扰源。IQ样本由改装的GNSS反射测量（GNSS-R）卫星OPS-SAT PRETTY在Jammertest 2025期间收集。
AI.conclusion: 准直接地理定位（QDG）技术能够有效地利用受限于带宽和计算能力的低地球轨道（LEO）卫星平台，实现对地面GNSS干扰源的复杂性可扩展的直接地理定位和消除。
AI.translation: 从太空监测射频（RF）频谱对卫星平台在通信带宽和计算资源方面提出了严苛的要求，这些资源对于高吞吐量IQ样本的下行链路、存储和处理是必需的。本文深入分析了准直接地理定位（QDG）技术，作为一种能够利用低地球轨道（LEO）上的机会卫星来传感全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）频段频谱的技术。这是一种被动的射频地理定位技术，它包含一系列信号处理算法，这些算法能在量化的时频域中压缩IQ样本，并通过快速延迟-多普勒频移匹配和干涉测量来处理压缩数据。这些算法可以加速在位置域中对多个射频源的穷举搜索。效率的提升解决了阻碍使用卫星的瓶颈，这些卫星的下行链路容量和在轨计算能力有限。这些卫星通常在尺寸、重量和功率（SWaP）方面受到限制，并且是LEO中绝大多数的航天器。利用此类资产近乎实时地进行地面GNSS干扰源地理定位的能力，对于多星座GNSS射频干扰（RFI）监测系统的性能至关重要。本工作描述了数学框架和精度边界，介绍了单天线和多天线用例，结合了不同的压缩方法，并用真实数据评估了地理定位精度。IQ样本由一颗改装的GNSS反射测量（GNSS-R）卫星OPS-SAT PRETTY在Jammertest 2025期间的专用测试会话中收集。实验结果证明了以极高的压缩比对具有不同信噪比（SNR）的GNSS干扰源进行地理定位的能力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出并评估了一种名为准直接地理定位（QDG）的被动射频地理定位技术，旨在利用低地球轨道（LEO）上的机会卫星来监测全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）频段的射频频谱。该技术通过在量化时频域中压缩IQ样本并进行快速匹配和干涉测量，显著提高了处理效率，克服了LEO卫星有限的带宽和计算能力的限制。通过使用改装的GNSS-R卫星OPS-SAT PRETTY进行的实验验证，证明了QDG技术能够以极高的压缩比和高精度定位地面GNSS干扰源，为未来的GNSS射频干扰监测系统提供了关键支持。
AI.keywords: 准直接地理定位, 低地球轨道卫星, GNSS干扰源, 射频频谱监测, 压缩感知
AI.comments: 该研究在利用低成本、资源受限的LEO卫星进行射频频谱监测方面取得了重要进展。QDG技术的提出和实验验证，为解决卫星平台计算能力和带宽瓶颈提供了有效的解决方案。然而，文章未详细说明不同压缩方法对精度的具体影响，以及在更复杂的电磁环境下（如多径效应、信号遮挡）的鲁棒性。

title: Cross Domain Few-Shot Class-Incremental Audio Classification Via Adversarial Contrastive Learning
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, accepted for publication in Interspeech 2026
summary: Current Few-shot Class-incremental Audio Classification (FCAC) methods assume that samples of base and incremental classes are in the same domain (following the same distribution). However, there is generally a domain shift between the above two types of samples. In this paper, we explore the problem of Cross Domain FCAC where samples of base and incremental classes have domain shift. We propose a strategy of adversarial contrastive training which enables the model to effectively classify samples of different classes from unseen domains. The model consists of an encoder and a classifier. The encoder is trained in base session but frozen in incremental sessions, whereas the classifier is trained in all sessions. Experiments are done on six pairs of cross-domain datasets. Results show that our method exceeds state-of-the-art methods in average accuracy. The code is at https://github.com/YongjieSi/ACL.
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, accepted for publication in Interspeech 2026

AI.title_translation: 基于对抗对比学习的跨域少样本类增量音频分类
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种对抗对比训练策略，通过冻结编码器和持续训练分类器，有效解决了少样本类增量音频分类中因基础类和增量类样本分布不同而导致的跨域分类难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的少样本类增量音频分类（FCAC）方法通常假设基础类和增量类的样本处于同一领域（即遵循相同的分布），但在实际应用中，这两类样本之间通常存在领域偏移（domain shift），导致现有方法性能下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种对抗对比训练（adversarial contrastive training）策略。该模型由编码器和分类器组成：编码器在基础阶段（base session）进行训练，但在增量阶段（incremental sessions）被冻结；而分类器则在所有阶段都进行训练。
AI.result: 在六对跨域数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在平均准确率上超越了现有的最先进（state-of-the-art）方法。
AI.conclusion: 对抗对比训练策略能够使模型有效地对来自未见领域的不同类别音频进行分类，成功解决了跨域少样本类增量音频分类中的领域偏移问题，并取得了领先的分类准确率。
AI.translation: 目前的少样本类增量音频分类（FCAC）方法假设基础类和增量类的样本处于同一领域（遵循相同的分布）。然而，上述两类样本之间通常存在领域偏移。在本文中，我们探索了跨域FCAC问题，即基础类和增量类的样本存在领域偏移。我们提出了一种对抗对比训练策略，使模型能够有效地对来自未见领域的不同类别的样本进行分类。该模型由一个编码器和一个分类器组成。编码器在基础阶段进行训练，但在增量阶段被冻结，而分类器在所有阶段都进行训练。在六对跨域数据集上进行了实验。结果表明，我们的方法在平均准确率上超过了最先进的方法。代码开源在 https://github.com/YongjieSi/ACL。
AI.summary: 本文针对少样本类增量音频分类（FCAC）中基础类与增量类样本存在领域偏移的问题，研究了“跨域FCAC”任务。作者提出了一种对抗对比训练策略，通过在基础阶段训练并冻结编码器、在所有阶段持续训练分类器的方式，提升了模型对未见领域样本的分类能力。实验表明，该方法在六个跨域数据集上均取得了领先的平均准确率。
AI.keywords: 跨域少样本类增量音频分类, 对抗对比学习, 领域偏移, 音频分类
AI.comments: 本文针对少样本类增量音频分类中实际存在的领域偏移问题，提出了跨域FCAC这一更具挑战性和现实意义的任务。所提出的对抗对比训练策略以及“冻结编码器+持续训练分类器”的设计简单而有效，在六个跨域数据集上取得了出色的表现。此外，开源代码也增强了该研究的实用性和可复现性。

title: Spatial Speech Perception Systems: A Survey of Sound Source Localization, Directional Enhancement, and Speech Recognition
summary:
Robust speech understanding in real-world acoustic environments remains a fundamental challenge for intelligent auditory systems such as robot audition, hearing aids, teleconferencing systems, smart speakers, and voice-controlled assistants. These systems must operate under background noise, reverberation, competing speakers, and dynamic acoustic conditions. Spatial speech perception addresses this challenge by exploiting microphone-array information to localize, enhance, and interpret target speech in complex acoustic scenes.
  This paper surveys spatial speech perception systems with emphasis on the roles of sound source localization (SSL), directional speech enhancement (DSE), and automatic speech recognition (ASR), both individually and within integrated processing pipelines. We review classical signal-processing approaches and recent learning-based methods for microphone-array localization, beamforming, neural enhancement, speech separation, and modern recognition architectures. Beyond component-level analysis, we discuss robustness to noise and reverberation, multi-speaker operation, real-time constraints, and computational efficiency. We also examine representative applications in robot audition, hearing assistance, smart speakers, and teleconferencing, and identify open challenges and future directions toward robust, low-latency, and perception-aware speech systems for complex acoustic environments.

AI.title_translation: 空间语音感知系统：声源定位、方向增强和语音识别的综述
AI.tldr: 本文综述了空间语音感知系统，重点关注声源定位、方向语音增强和自动语音识别在复杂声学环境下的作用、方法、应用及未来挑战。
AI.motivation: 智能听觉系统（如机器人听觉、助听器、电话会议系统、智能音箱、语音控制助手）在真实世界的声学环境中实现鲁棒的语音理解面临背景噪声、混响、竞争说话人及动态声学条件等根本性挑战。空间语音感知通过利用麦克风阵列信息来定位、增强和解释复杂声学场景中的目标语音，以应对这些挑战。
AI.method: 本文综述了空间语音感知系统，重点关注声源定位（SSL）、方向语音增强（DSE）和自动语音识别（ASR）各自以及在集成处理管道中的作用。回顾了麦克风阵列定位、波束形成、神经增强、语音分离和现代识别架构的经典信号处理方法和近期学习方法。除了组件级分析，还讨论了对噪声和混响的鲁棒性、多说话人操作、实时约束和计算效率。
AI.result: 综述了经典信号处理方法和近期学习方法，讨论了系统的鲁棒性、多说话人操作、实时约束和计算效率。审查了机器人听觉、助听、智能音箱和电话会议中的代表性应用。
AI.conclusion: 识别了在复杂声学环境中实现鲁棒、低延迟和感知感知语音系统所面临的开放挑战和未来方向。
AI.translation:
在真实世界的声学环境中实现鲁棒的语音理解对于智能听觉系统（如机器人听觉、助听器、电话会议系统、智能音箱和语音控制助手）来说仍然是一个根本性挑战。这些系统必须在背景噪声、混响、竞争说话人以及动态声学条件下运行。空间语音感知通过利用麦克风阵列信息来定位、增强和解释复杂声学场景中的目标语音，从而应对这一挑战。
本文综述了空间语音感知系统，重点关注声源定位（SSL）、方向语音增强（DSE）和自动语音识别（ASR）各自以及在集成处理管道中的作用。我们回顾了麦克风阵列定位、波束形成、神经增强、语音分离和现代识别架构的经典信号处理方法和近期学习方法。除了组件级分析，我们还讨论了对噪声和混响的鲁棒性、多说话人操作、实时约束和计算效率。我们还审查了机器人听觉、助听、智能音箱和电话会议中的代表性应用，并指出了在复杂声学环境中实现鲁棒、低延迟和感知感知语音系统所面临的开放挑战和未来方向。
AI.summary: 本文对空间语音感知系统进行了全面综述，旨在解决智能听觉系统在复杂真实声学环境下（如噪声、混响和多说话人）的语音理解挑战。文章详细审视了声源定位、方向语音增强和自动语音识别在系统中的关键作用，并比较了传统信号处理方法与新兴学习方法。此外，还探讨了系统的鲁棒性、多说话人处理能力、实时性及计算效率，并分析了其在机器人听觉、助听等领域的应用，最终指出了未来的研究方向和开放性挑战。
AI.keywords: 空间语音感知, 声源定位, 语音增强, 自动语音识别, 麦克风阵列
AI.comments: 这篇综述为空间语音感知领域提供了一个全面的概览，涵盖了从基础理论到实际应用的关键技术和挑战。其价值在于系统地梳理了现有方法，并指明了未来研究的重点，对于研究人员和工程师了解该领域的发展现状和趋势具有重要指导意义。

title: Beyond Beamforming: Phase-and-Gain Channel Shaping via Rotatable Antenna Arrays
comments: 13 Pages, 9 figures. Submitted to an IEEE journal for possible publication
summary: This paper investigates geometry-reconfigurable transmission for multiuser communication systems enabled by a rotatable antenna array. In contrast to conventional fixed arrays, the proposed architecture jointly exploits array pose adjustment and element-level boresight steering, thereby reshaping both the array-induced phase responses and the direction-dependent channel gains. We formulate a weighted sum-rate maximization problem that jointly optimizes the transmit beamformers, array pose, and element boresights under practical visibility and steering constraints. To reveal the underlying design principles, we first provide a geometric interpretation via zero-forcing analysis, showing that the resulting rates stem from both channel-strength enhancement and spatial-separability improvement. Specifically, array-pose rotation improves inter-user channel orthogonality even with isotropic elements, whereas directional elements introduce a tradeoff between phase-based spatial separation and boresight-dependent gain alignment. Motivated by these insights, we develop an efficient optimization framework that jointly coordinates transmit beamforming, array-pose adaptation, and element-boresight steering to exploit the geometry-induced phase-and-gain channel-shaping capability. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed joint design outperforms fixed-array, pose-only, and boresight-only benchmarks, with larger gains achieved under more directive element patterns and tighter boresight-steering constraints.
comment: 13 Pages, 9 figures. Submitted to an IEEE journal for possible publication

AI.title_translation: 超越波束赋形：基于可旋转天线阵列的相位与增益信道整形
AI.tldr: 提出一种利用可旋转天线阵列进行几何重构的通信架构，通过联合优化阵列姿态和单元视轴，在物理层实现信道相位与增益的动态整形，从而显著提升多用户系统性能。
AI.motivation: 传统固定阵列在应对复杂多用户信道环境时灵活性不足，难以在信道强度和空间可分离性之间取得最优平衡，因此需要引入几何可重构技术来扩展信道塑造能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种联合优化框架，通过建模阵列姿态调整和单元级视轴转向，在考虑实际可见性和转向约束的条件下，以加权和速率最大化为目标进行求解；并利用零强制分析揭示了增强信道强度和改善空间正交性的设计原理。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的联合设计方案在速率表现上显著优于仅固定阵列、仅姿态调整或仅视轴转向的基准方案，且在天线方向性更强及转向约束更紧时增益尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化阵列姿态、单元视轴和传输波束赋形，该架构能有效增强信道强度并改善空间可分离性，显著优于传统固定阵列系统。
AI.translation: 本文研究了一种由可旋转天线阵列支持的多用户通信系统中的几何可重构传输。与传统的固定阵列不同，所提出的架构联合利用了阵列姿态调整和单元级视轴转向，从而重新塑造了阵列引起的相位响应和方向相关的信道增益。我们在实际可见性和转向约束下，制定了一个联合优化传输波束赋形器、阵列姿态和单元视轴的加权和速率最大化问题。为了揭示潜在的设计原则，我们首先通过零强制分析提供了几何解释，表明所得速率源于信道强度的增强和空间可分离性的改善。具体而言，即使在全向单元的情况下，阵列姿态旋转也能改善用户间的信道正交性，而方向性单元则在基于相位的空间分离和依赖视轴的增益对齐之间引入了权衡。基于这些见解，我们开发了一个高效的优化框架，联合协调传输波束赋形、阵列姿态自适应和单元视轴转向，以利用几何诱导的相位和增益信道整形能力。仿真结果表明，所提出的联合设计方案优于固定阵列、仅姿态调整和仅视轴转向的基准方案，在更具方向性的单元模式和更严格的视轴转向约束下获得了更大的增益。
AI.summary: 本文研究了一种基于可旋转天线阵列的几何可重构多用户通信系统。通过联合优化天线阵列姿态和单元级视轴转向，该方案能够主动改变阵列的相位响应和方向性增益。研究表明，这种方法不仅增强了信道强度，还通过提高用户间的空间正交性显著提升了系统和速率。
AI.keywords: 可旋转天线阵列, 几何可重构传输, 信道整形, 多用户通信, 波束赋形
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入可旋转天线阵列，从物理几何层面重新定义了信道塑造的可能性。其创新点在于将机械维度的阵列姿态调整与电磁维度的单元视轴控制相结合，为解决多用户干扰和信道正交性问题提供了全新的硬件自由度。局限性在于机械旋转的响应速度可能限制其在高动态场景下的应用。

title: Robust Transmission Design for RIS-Assisted RSMA-SWIPT Systems With Movable Antennas Under Hardware Distortions
summary: This paper investigates a robust transmission design for a multi-user rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA)-based simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) system empowered by movable antennas (MAs) and a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) under channel state information (CSI) uncertainty and residual hardware impairments (HIs). The effective channels in MAs-enabled systems depend on antenna positions, causing CSI uncertainty to affect not only active and passive beamforming but also antenna position optimization. Furthermore, residual HIs distort the effective SINRs, creating additional coupling among beamforming, RIS reflection control, common-rate allocation, power-splitting ratio optimization, and antenna position optimization. Consequently, the joint impact of CSI uncertainty and HIs leads to a highly coupled and challenging resource allocation problem. To address this challenge, we propose a robust resource allocation framework that jointly optimizes common-rate allocation, transmit beamforming, RIS reflection coefficients, power-splitting ratios, and MAs positions to maximize the achievable sum-rate while satisfying practical system constraints. To obtain an efficient solution, the original problem is decomposed into active beamforming, RIS reflection design, power-splitting ratio optimization, and MAs position optimization subproblems, where tractable convex surrogate functions are constructed to handle the non-convex objective and constraints. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework and demonstrate substantial improvements in achievable sum-rate, robustness against CSI uncertainty and hardware impairments, and convergence performance compared with benchmark schemes.

AI.title_translation: 具有可移动天线且存在硬件失真的RIS辅助RSMA-SWIPT系统的鲁棒传输设计
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在信道状态信息不确定性和硬件损伤下，RIS辅助、可移动天线增强的RSMA-SWIPT系统的鲁棒传输设计，通过联合优化资源以最大化和速率。
AI.motivation: 在可移动天线、RIS辅助的RSMA-SWIPT系统中，信道状态信息不确定性和残余硬件损伤会共同导致资源分配问题高度耦合且具有挑战性，需要鲁棒的传输设计。
AI.method: 提出了一种鲁棒资源分配框架，联合优化公共速率分配、发射波束成形、RIS反射系数、功率分配比和可移动天线位置，以最大化可实现和速率。将原问题分解为多个子问题，并构建可处理的凸替代函数来处理非凸目标和约束。
AI.result: 仿真结果验证了所提出框架的有效性，并表明与基准方案相比，在可实现和速率、对CSI不确定性和硬件损伤的鲁棒性以及收敛性能方面都有显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的鲁棒资源分配框架能有效解决在信道状态信息不确定性和硬件损伤下，RIS辅助RSMA-SWIPT系统中的传输设计问题，显著提高了系统性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 本文研究了一种在信道状态信息（CSI）不确定性和残余硬件损伤（HIs）下，由可移动天线（MAs）和可重构智能表面（RIS）赋能的多用户速率分裂多址（RSMA）同步无线信息和功率传输（SWIPT）系统的鲁棒传输设计。启用可移动天线系统的有效信道取决于天线位置，导致CSI不确定性不仅影响主动和被动波束成形，还影响天线位置优化。此外，残余硬件损伤会扭曲有效信噪比，在波束成形、RIS反射控制、公共速率分配、功率分裂比优化和天线位置优化之间产生额外的耦合。因此，CSI不确定性和硬件损伤的共同影响导致了一个高度耦合且具有挑战性的资源分配问题。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种鲁棒资源分配框架，该框架联合优化公共速率分配、发射波束成形、RIS反射系数、功率分裂比和可移动天线位置，以最大化可实现和速率，同时满足实际系统约束。为了获得高效的解决方案，将原始问题分解为主动波束成形、RIS反射设计、功率分裂比优化和可移动天线位置优化子问题，其中构建了可处理的凸替代函数来处理非凸目标和约束。仿真结果验证了所提出框架的有效性，并表明与基准方案相比，在可实现和速率、对CSI不确定性和硬件损伤的鲁棒性以及收敛性能方面都有显著改善。
AI.summary: 本文针对存在信道状态信息不确定性和硬件损伤的RIS辅助RSMA-SWIPT系统，在引入可移动天线后，提出了一种鲁棒传输设计框架。该框架通过联合优化多种系统参数，包括公共速率分配、波束成形、RIS反射系数、功率分配比和可移动天线位置，旨在最大化系统和速率。为解决高度耦合的非凸优化问题，研究将原问题分解为多个子问题，并利用凸替代函数进行处理。仿真结果验证了该框架在提升和速率、增强鲁棒性和收敛性方面的优越性。
AI.keywords: RIS, RSMA, SWIPT, 可移动天线, 鲁棒传输设计, 硬件损伤, CSI不确定性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将可移动天线引入到RIS辅助的RSMA-SWIPT系统中，并考虑了信道状态信息不确定性和硬件损伤的复杂联合影响，这使得资源分配问题更具挑战性也更贴近实际。通过将问题分解并采用凸替代函数的方法，为解决此类高度耦合的非凸问题提供了一种有效的思路。该研究对于未来6G通信系统中集成多项先进技术以提升系统性能和鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: FLAME: A Federated Learning Approach for Multi-Modal RF Fingerprinting
comments: 21 pages, 16 figures. Published in IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Authorization systems are increasingly relying on processing radio frequency (RF) waveforms at receivers to fingerprint (i.e., determine the identity of) the corresponding transmitter. Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a popular paradigm to perform RF fingerprinting in networks with multiple access points (APs), as they allow effective deep learning-based device identification without requiring the centralization of locally collected RF signals stored at multiple APs. Yet, FL algorithms that operate merely on in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) time samples incur high convergence rates, resulting in excessive training rounds and inefficient training times. In this work, we propose FLAME: an FL approach for multi-modal RF fingerprinting. Our framework consists of simultaneously representing received RF waveforms in multiple complementary modalities beyond I/Q samples in an effort to reduce training times. We theoretically demonstrate the feasibility and efficiency of our methodology and derive a convergence bound that incurs lower loss and thus higher accuracies in the same training round in comparison to single-modal FL-based RF fingerprinting. Extensive empirical evaluations validate our theoretical results and demonstrate the superiority of FLAME in comparison to multiple considered baselines.

AI.title_translation: FLAME：一种用于多模态射频指纹识别的联邦学习方法
AI.tldr: FLAME通过引入多模态射频波形表征，克服了传统联邦学习射频指纹识别中仅用I/Q数据导致收敛慢的瓶颈，显著提高了训练效率和识别精度。
AI.motivation: 在多接入点网络中，现有的基于联邦学习的射频（RF）指纹识别算法通常仅依赖于I/Q时间样本，这导致模型收敛缓慢，需要过多的训练轮数，从而造成训练时间低效。
AI.method: 提出名为FLAME的多模态联邦学习框架。该框架在传统的同相和正交（I/Q）时间样本之外，引入并同时利用多种互补的模态来表征接收到的射频波形，并推导出了相应的收敛边界。
AI.result: 理论证明了FLAME的可行性与高效性。推导出的收敛边界表明，与单模态联邦学习相比，FLAME在相同的训练轮数下能取得更低的损失和更高的准确率。广泛的实证评估也验证了其相比于多个基线方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: FLAME通过引入多模态射频波形表征，成功解决了传统单模态联邦学习在射频指纹识别中收敛慢、训练效率低的问题，实现了更快的收敛速度和更高的识别准确率。
AI.translation: 授权系统正越来越多地依赖于在接收端处理射频（RF）波形，以对相应的发射机进行指纹识别（即确定其身份）。联邦学习（FL）已成为在具有多个接入点（AP）的网络中进行射频指纹识别的一种流行范式，因为它们允许进行有效的基于深度学习的设备识别，而无需集中存储在多个AP处的本地收集的射频信号。然而，仅在同相和正交（I/Q）时间样本上运行的联邦学习算法会导致收敛缓慢，从而导致过多的训练轮数和低效的训练时间。在这项工作中，我们提出了FLAME：一种用于多模态射频指纹识别的联邦学习方法。我们的框架包括在I/Q样本之外，同时用多个互补模态表示接收到的射频波形，以减少训练时间。我们从理论上证明了我们方法的科学性和效率，并推导出了一个收敛边界，与基于单模态联邦学习的射频指纹识别相比，该边界在相同的训练轮次中产生了更低的损失，从而实现了更高的准确率。广泛的经验评估验证了我们的理论结果，并证明了FLAME与多个基线方法相比的优越性。
AI.summary: 本文针对联邦学习在射频（RF）指纹识别中因仅使用I/Q样本而导致收敛慢、训练效率低的问题，提出了FLAME框架。FLAME通过引入超越单一I/Q采样的多种互补模态来共同表征射频波形，从而加速联邦训练过程。理论分析与实验结果一致表明，该方法在保证隐私的前提下，相比传统单模态方法能显著降低训练损失并提升识别准确率。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 射频指纹识别, 多模态, 收敛边界
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将多模态数据表征引入到射频联邦学习中，打破了传统方法仅依赖单一I/Q时域采样的局限性，并提供了严谨的收敛性理论证明。其重要性在于有效解决了多接入点协同训练中隐私保护与训练效率（收敛慢）之间的矛盾。局限性在于摘要中未具体透露除I/Q之外还采用了哪些互补模态，且多模态数据的处理和传输是否会带来额外的计算或通信开销也有待在正文中进一步确认。

title: Bayesian Self-Calibration and Parametric Channel Estimation for 6G Antenna Arrays
summary: Accurate channel estimation is essential for both high-rate communication and high-precision sensing in 6G wireless systems. However, a major performance limitation arises from calibration mismatches when operating phased-array antennas under real-world conditions. To address this issue, we propose to integrate antenna element self-calibration into a variational sparse Bayesian learning (VSBL) algorithm for parametric channel estimation. We model antenna gain and phase deviations as latent variables and derive explicit update equations to jointly infer these calibration parameters and the channel parameters; the number of multipath components (MPCs) along with their complex amplitudes, delays, and angles-of-arrival (AoA), as well as the noise variance. We assess its performance in terms of the optimal subpattern-assignment (OSPA) metric, demonstrating consistent improvements over conventional VSBL without calibration. Furthermore, we show that integrating the estimation of the calibration parameters into the VSBL algorithm actually increases convergence speed, since a missing or wrong calibration results in the additional estimation of spurious components.

AI.title_translation: 6G天线阵列的贝叶斯自校准与参数化信道估计
AI.tldr: 针对6G天线阵列的校准失配问题，本文提出将天线自校准集成到变分稀疏贝叶斯学习(VSBL)算法中，以同时估计校准参数和信道参数，从而提高信道估计的准确性和收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 6G无线系统中，精确的信道估计对高速通信和高精度传感至关重要。然而，实际操作相控阵天线时，校准失配是主要的性能限制。
AI.method: 提出将天线单元自校准集成到变分稀疏贝叶斯学习（VSBL）算法中进行参数化信道估计。将天线增益和相位偏差建模为潜在变量，并推导出显式更新方程，以联合推断这些校准参数和信道参数（多径分量数量、复振幅、延迟、到达角以及噪声方差）。
AI.result: 在最优子模式分配（OSPA）度量方面，与没有校准的传统VSBL相比，展示了持续的改进。此外，将校准参数的估计集成到VSBL算法中，实际上提高了收敛速度，因为缺少或错误的校准会导致额外估计虚假分量。
AI.conclusion: 将天线自校准集成到VSBL算法中，不仅提高了6G天线阵列的信道估计准确性，还在校准失配条件下提升了算法的收敛速度。
AI.translation: 准确的信道估计对于6G无线系统中的高速通信和高精度传感都至关重要。然而，在实际条件下操作相控阵天线时，校准失配会带来主要的性能限制。为了解决这个问题，我们建议将天线单元自校准集成到变分稀疏贝叶斯学习（VSBL）算法中，用于参数化信道估计。我们将天线增益和相位偏差建模为潜在变量，并推导出显式更新方程，以联合推断这些校准参数和信道参数；包括多径分量（MPC）的数量及其复振幅、延迟和到达角（AoA），以及噪声方差。我们通过最优子模式分配（OSPA）度量评估其性能，结果表明与没有校准的传统VSBL相比，该方法表现出持续的改进。此外，我们发现将校准参数的估计集成到VSBL算法中实际上提高了收敛速度，因为缺少或错误的校准会导致额外估计虚假分量。
AI.summary: 本文针对6G无线系统中相控阵天线校准失配导致的信道估计性能问题，提出了一种将天线单元自校准集成到变分稀疏贝叶斯学习（VSBL）算法中的新方法。该方法将天线增益和相位偏差作为潜在变量，与多径分量、复振幅、延迟、到达角及噪声方差等信道参数联合估计。实验结果表明，该方法在OSPA度量上优于传统VSBL，并能提高算法收敛速度，有效解决了校准失配带来的挑战。
AI.keywords: 6G, 信道估计, 贝叶斯自校准, 天线阵列, VSBL
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将天线自校准与参数化信道估计紧密结合，通过贝叶斯学习框架同时解决这两个问题。这种联合推断方法不仅提高了信道估计的准确性，还出人意料地提升了算法的收敛速度，这对于实时系统具有重要意义。该方法对6G及未来无线通信系统中相控阵天线在实际部署中的性能提升具有重要的实践价值。

title: A mixed-signal analogue front-end for brain-implantable neural interfaces using a digital fixed-point IIR filter and bulk offset cancellation
comments: IEEE style, to be presented in MWSCAS 2026, 4 pages + 1 References
summary: Advances in miniaturised implantable neural electronics have paved the way for therapeutic brain-computer interfaces with clinical potential for movement disorders, epilepsy, and broader neurological applications. This paper presents a mixed-signal analogue front end (AFE) designed to record simultaneously both extracellular action potentials (EAPs) and local field potentials (LFPs). The feedforward path integrates a low-noise amplifier (LNA) and a successive-approximation-register (SAR) analogue-to-digital converter (ADC), while the feedback path employs a fixed-point infinite-impulse-response (IIR) Chebyshev Type II low-pass filter to suppress sub-mHz components via bulk-voltage control of the LNA input differential pair using two R-2R pseudo-resistor digital-to-analogue converters (DACs). The proposed AFE employs a low-power (LP) mode and an offset-cancellation high-performance (HP) mode. The proposed AFE achieves 40.55 dB gain and supports neural recording from 0.1 Hz to 5.705 / 9.66 kHz (LP / HP), with typical input-referred noise of 3.9 / 6.615 uVrms in the LFP band and 11.42 / 11.11 uVrms in the EAP band (LP / HP). Its typical power per channel is 5.44 uW (LP) and 11.35 uW (HP), while it occupies 0.198 mm2.
